5.228.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare śambhurgaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ..
indrādyaiśca suraiḥ sarveḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ..
jagāma vṛṣamāruhya purīṃ caivāmarāvatīm .. 1 ..
5.228.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शम्भुर्गणैः सर्वैः समावृतः ..
इन्द्राद्यैश्च सुरैः सर्वेः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ..
जगाम वृषमारुह्य पुरीं चैवामरावतीम् .. 1 ..
5.228.m: Sūta said: / In the meantime, Śambhu, surrounded by all his attendants / and all the gods headed by Indra, his eyes reddened with rage, / mounted his bull and went to the city of Amarāvatī. 1

5.228.s:
aṃdhako'pi samālokya saṃprāptāṃ devavāhinīm ..
sagaṇāṃ ca mahādevaṃ paritoṣaṃ paraṃ gataḥ .. 2 ..
5.228.d:
अंधकोऽपि समालोक्य संप्राप्तां देववाहिनीम् ..
सगणां च महादेवं परितोषं परं गतः .. 2 ..
5.228.m: Andhaka, too, seeing the army of gods arrived, / and Mahādeva with his attendants, attained the highest joy. 2

5.228.s:
niścakrāmātha yuddhāya balena caturaṃgiṇā ..
varaṃ syaṃdanamāruhya suśvetāśvavahaṃ śubham .. 3 ..
5.228.d:
निश्चक्रामाथ युद्धाय बलेन चतुरंगिणा ..
वरं स्यंदनमारुह्य सुश्वेताश्ववहं शुभम् .. 3 ..
5.228.m: He came out to battle with a fourfold army, / mounted upon an excellent chariot drawn by pure white horses. 3

5.228.s:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ..
gaṇaiśca vikṛtākārairmṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam .. 4 ..
5.228.d:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह ..
गणैश्च विकृताकारैर्मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् .. 4 ..
5.228.m: Then a battle took place between the gods and the Dānavas, / and with the monstrous-formed attendants, turning back death [itself]. 4

5.228.s:
ekavarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ yāvadyuddhamavartata ..
dinedine kṣayaṃ yāṃti tatra devā na dānavāḥ ..
tato varṣasahasrāṃte saṃkruddhaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ..
triśūlena samudyamya svahastena vyabhedayat .. 6 ..
5.228.d:
एकवर्षसहस्रांतं यावद्युद्धमवर्तत ..
दिनेदिने क्षयं यांति तत्र देवा न दानवाः ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते संक्रुद्धः शशिशेखरः..
त्रिशूलेन समुद्यम्य स्वहस्तेन व्यभेदयत् .. 6 ..
5.228.m: The battle continued until the end of a thousand years; / day by day the gods perished there, not the Dānavas. / Then, at the end of the thousand years, the moon-crested god, greatly enraged, / raised up his trident with his own hand and impaled [him]. 6

5.228.s:
sa viddho'pi svayaṃ tena triśūlena mahāsuraḥ..
brahmaṇo varamāhātmyānnaiva prāṇaiviryujyate .. 7 ..
5.228.d:
स विद्धोऽपि स्वयं तेन त्रिशूलेन महासुरः..
ब्रह्मणो वरमाहात्म्यान्नैव प्राणैविर्युज्यते .. 7 ..
5.228.m: Though himself pierced with that trident, the great Asura / did not lose his life, by virtue of the power of Brahmā's boon. 7

5.228.s:
tato bhūyo'pi cotthāya cakre yuddhaṃ mahātmanā ..
jaghāna ca sa saṃkruddho viśeṣeṇa bahūngaṇān .. 8 ..
5.228.d:
ततो भूयोऽपि चोत्थाय चक्रे युद्धं महात्मना ..
जघान च स संक्रुद्धो विशेषेण बहून्गणान् .. 8 ..
5.228.m: Rising up yet again, he fought with that great-souled one; / and enraged, he struck down many attendants in particular. 8

5.228.s: śaṃkaraṃ tāḍayāmāsa gadāghātairmuhurmuhuḥ .. 9 ..
5.228.d: शंकरं ताडयामास गदाघातैर्मुहुर्मुहुः .. 9 ..
5.228.m: He struck Śaṃkara again and again with mace-blows. 9

5.228.s:
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṃtamabhūtsārddhaṃ pinākinā ..
raudraṃ yuddhamandhakasya sarvalokabhayāvaham .. 6.229.10 ..
5.228.d:
एवं वर्षसहस्रांतमभूत्सार्द्धं पिनाकिना ..
रौद्रं युद्धमन्धकस्य सर्वलोकभयावहम् .. 6.229.10 ..
5.228.m: Thus, until the end of a thousand years, there was with Pinākin / a dreadful battle of Andhaka, terrifying to all the worlds. 10

5.228.s:
triśūlabhinno daityaḥ sa yadā mṛtyuṃ na gacchati ..
utthāyotthāya kurute prahārāngadayā balī .. 11 ..
5.228.d:
त्रिशूलभिन्नो दैत्यः स यदा मृत्युं न गच्छति ..
उत्थायोत्थाय कुरुते प्रहारान्गदया बली .. 11 ..
5.228.m: When that Daitya, pierced by the trident, did not die, / rising again and again, the powerful one dealt blows with his mace. 11

5.228.s:
tathā taṃ śaṃkaro jñātvā mṛtyunā parivarjitam..
brahmaṇo varadānena sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām.. 12 ..
5.228.d:
तथा तं शंकरो ज्ञात्वा मृत्युना परिवर्जितम्..
ब्रह्मणो वरदानेन सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम्.. 12 ..
5.228.m: Knowing him to be thus exempt from death / on account of the granting of the boon by Brahmā and all the gods, 12

5.228.s:
tato nirbhidya śūlāgraiḥ protkṣipya gaganāṃgaṇe ..
chatravaddhārayāmāsa laṃbamānamadhomukham ..
akṣaradrudhiraṃ bhūmau gātrebhyo varṣmasaṃbhavam .. 13 ..
5.228.d:
ततो निर्भिद्य शूलाग्रैः प्रोत्क्षिप्य गगनांगणे ..
छत्रवद्धारयामास लंबमानमधोमुखम् ..
अक्षरद्रुधिरं भूमौ गात्रेभ्यो वर्ष्मसंभवम् .. 13 ..
5.228.m: Śaṃkara then pierced him with the trident points and tossed him up in the courtyard of the sky, / holding him like a parasol, hanging head down; / blood issuing from his body poured onto the earth. 13

5.228.s:
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃte carmāsthi snāyureva ca ..
dhātutrayaṃ sthitaṃ tasya naṣṭamanyaccatuṣṭayam .. 14 ..
5.228.d:
यावद्वर्षसहस्रांते चर्मास्थि स्नायुरेव च ..
धातुत्रयं स्थितं तस्य नष्टमन्यच्चतुष्टयम् .. 14 ..
5.228.m: Until, at the end of a thousand years, only skin, bone, and sinew— / three bodily elements—remained of him, and the other four were destroyed. 14

5.228.s:
sa jñātvā bala saṃhīnamātmānaṃ dhātusaṃkṣayāt ..
sāmopāyaṃ tataścake stutvā sārdhaṃ pinākinā .. 15 ..
5.228.d:
स ज्ञात्वा बल संहीनमात्मानं धातुसंक्षयात् ..
सामोपायं ततश्चके स्तुत्वा सार्धं पिनाकिना .. 15 ..
5.228.m: Perceiving himself devoid of strength due to the loss of his bodily elements, / he then adopted the means of conciliation with Pinākin by praising him. 15

5.228.s:
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
na tvaṃ devo mayā jñāto vāgduṣṭena durātmanā ..
īdṛgvīryasamopetastadyuktaṃ bhavatā kṛtam .. 16 ..
5.228.d:
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
न त्वं देवो मया ज्ञातो वाग्दुष्टेन दुरात्मना ..
ईदृग्वीर्यसमोपेतस्तद्युक्तं भवता कृतम् .. 16 ..
5.228.m: Andhaka said: / You were not recognized as God by me, wicked-spoken and vile-souled, / endowed with such prowess; therefore, what you have done is just. 16

5.228.s:
anurūpaṃ madāṃdhasyāvivekasya surottama ..
svavīryamadayuktasya viveka rahitasya ca .. 17 ..
5.228.d:
अनुरूपं मदांधस्याविवेकस्य सुरोत्तम ..
स्ववीर्यमदयुक्तस्य विवेक रहितस्य च .. 17 ..
5.228.m: It is fitting for one blind with arrogance, devoid of discrimination, O best of gods, / filled with arrogance of his own prowess, and lacking judgment. 17

5.228.s:
durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryamevaca ..
na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ kālaṃ yathā'haṃ madagarvitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.228.d:
दुर्विनीतः श्रियं प्राप्य विद्यामैश्वर्यमेवच ..
न तिष्ठति चिरं कालं यथाऽहं मदगर्वितः .. 18 ..
5.228.m: One who is ill-behaved, having obtained fortune, learning, and sovereignty, / does not remain for a long time, just like me, haughty with arrogance. 18

5.228.s:
pāpo'haṃ pāpakarmā'haṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ..
trāhi māṃ deva īśāna sarvapāpaharo bhava .. 19 ..
5.228.d:
पापोऽहं पापकर्माऽहं पापात्मा पापसंभवः ..
त्राहि मां देव ईशान सर्वपापहरो भव .. 19 ..
5.228.m: I am a sinner, I am an evil-doer, an evil soul, born of sin. / Save me, O God, Īśāna; be the remover of all my sins! 19

5.228.s:
duḥkhito'haṃ varāko'haṃ dīno'haṃ śaktivarjitaḥ ..
trātumarhasi māṃ deva prapannaṃ śaraṇaṃ vibho .. 6.229.20 ..
5.228.d:
दुःखितोऽहं वराकोऽहं दीनोऽहं शक्तिवर्जितः ..
त्रातुमर्हसि मां देव प्रपन्नं शरणं विभो .. 6.229.20 ..
5.228.m: I am miserable, I am wretched, I am pitiable, devoid of strength. / You ought to protect me, O God, who have fled to you for refuge, O omnipresent Lord! 20

5.228.s:
duṣṭo'haṃ pāpayukto'haṃ sāṃprataṃ parameśvara ..
tena buddhiriyaṃ jātā tavopari mamānagha .. 21 ..
5.228.d:
दुष्टोऽहं पापयुक्तोऽहं सांप्रतं परमेश्वर ..
तेन बुद्धिरियं जाता तवोपरि ममानघ .. 21 ..
5.228.m: I was wicked, I was conjoined with sin, O Supreme Lord; / because of that, such a mindset toward you arose in me, O sinless one. 21

5.228.s: sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā .. 22 ..
5.228.d: सर्वपापक्षये जाते शिवे भवति भावना .. 22 ..
5.228.m: When all sins are destroyed, devotion to Śiva comes to be. 22

5.228.s:
nāmamātramapi tryakṣa yaste kīrtayati prabho ..
so'pi muktimavāpnoti kiṃ punaḥ pūjane rataḥ .. 23 ..
5.228.d:
नाममात्रमपि त्र्यक्ष यस्ते कीर्तयति प्रभो ..
सोऽपि मुक्तिमवाप्नोति किं पुनः पूजने रतः .. 23 ..
5.228.m: Even he who recites only your name, O three-eyed Lord, / even he attains liberation; what then of one devoted to your worship? 23

5.228.s:
tava pūjā vihīnānāṃ dinānyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ..
yāni deva mṛtānāṃ ca tāni yāṃti na jīvatām .. 24 ..
5.228.d:
तव पूजा विहीनानां दिनान्यायांति यांति च ..
यानि देव मृतानां च तानि यांति न जीवताम् .. 24 ..
5.228.m: The days that come and go for those devoid of worship of you, / O God, are like the days of the dead; they do not belong to the living. 24

5.228.s:
kuṣṭhī vā rogayukto vā paṃgurvā badhiro'pi vā ..
mā bhūttasya kule janma śaṃbhuryatra na devatā .. 25 ..
5.228.d:
कुष्ठी वा रोगयुक्तो वा पंगुर्वा बधिरोऽपि वा ..
मा भूत्तस्य कुले जन्म शंभुर्यत्र न देवता .. 25 ..
5.228.m: Whether leprous, afflicted with illness, lame, or deaf, / let not one be born into a family where Śambhu is not the deity! 25

5.228.s:
tasmānmocaya māṃ deva svāgataṃ kuru sāṃpratam ..
gato me dānavo bhāvastyaktaṃ rājyaṃ tathā vibho .. . 26 ..
5.228.d:
तस्मान्मोचय मां देव स्वागतं कुरु सांप्रतम् ..
गतो मे दानवो भावस्त्यक्तं राज्यं तथा विभो .. . 26 ..
5.228.m: Therefore, deliver me, O God; welcome me now. / My demoniac nature has departed, and my kingdom has been abandoned, O Lord. 26

5.228.s:
tyaktāḥ putrāśca pautrāśca patnyaśca vibhavaiḥ saha ..
triḥ satyena suraśreṣṭha tava pādau spṛśāmyaham .. 27 ..
5.228.d:
त्यक्ताः पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च पत्न्यश्च विभवैः सह ..
त्रिः सत्येन सुरश्रेष्ठ तव पादौ स्पृशाम्यहम् .. 27 ..
5.228.m: My sons, grandsons, and wives have been abandoned along with my riches. / Truly three times, O best of gods, I touch your feet! 27

5.228.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā taṃ gatakalmaṣam..
uttārya śanakaiḥ śūlādvinayāvanataṃ sthitam..28..
5.228.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ज्ञात्वा तं गतकल्मषम्..
उत्तार्य शनकैः शूलाद्विनयावनतं स्थितम्..28..
5.228.m: Hearing his speech and knowing him to be freed of sin, / [Śambhu] slowly took him down from the trident as he stood bowed with humility. 28

5.228.s:
tato nāma svayaṃ cakre bhṛṃgirīṭiriti prabhuḥ..
abravīcca sadā me tvaṃ vallabhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi..29..
5.228.d:
ततो नाम स्वयं चक्रे भृंगिरीटिरिति प्रभुः..
अब्रवीच्च सदा मे त्वं वल्लभः संभविष्यसि..29..
5.228.m: Then the Lord himself gave him the name Bhṛṅgirīṭi, / and said: "You will always be dear to me, 29

5.228.s:
nandino'pi gajāsyasya mahākālasya putraka..
tiṣṭha saumya mayā saukhyaṃ na smariṣyasi bāṃdhavān..6.229.30...
5.228.d:
नन्दिनोऽपि गजास्यस्य महाकालस्य पुत्रक..
तिष्ठ सौम्य मया सौख्यं न स्मरिष्यसि बांधवान्..6.229.30...
5.228.m: as are Nandin, Gajāsya, and Mahākāla, my son. / Stay, gentle one; with me, in happiness, you will not remember your kinsmen." 30

5.228.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya praṇamya śaśiśekharam ..
tasthau sarvagaṇairyuktaḥ prabhusaṃśrayasaṃyutaḥ .. 31 ..
5.228.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय प्रणम्य शशिशेखरम् ..
तस्थौ सर्वगणैर्युक्तः प्रभुसंश्रयसंयुतः .. 31 ..
5.228.m: Consenting with "So be it," and bowing down to the moon-crested god, / he remained along with all the attendants, taking refuge in the Lord. 31

5.228.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye bhṛṃgīriṭyutpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 229 ..
5.228.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वर क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भृंगीरिट्युत्पत्तिवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 229 ..
5.228.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Origin of Bhṛṅgīriṭi," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the sixth [section], the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 229

5.229.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ gaṇatvamāpanne hyandhake dānavottame ..
tasya putro vṛkonāma nirutsāho dviṣajjaye .. 1 ..
5.229.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं गणत्वमापन्ने ह्यन्धके दानवोत्तमे ..
तस्य पुत्रो वृकोनाम निरुत्साहो द्विषज्जये .. 1 ..
5.229.m: Sūta said: / When that best of Dānavas, Andhaka, had thus attained the state of an attendant, / his son named Vṛka, devoid of enthusiasm for conquering enemies, 1

5.229.s:
bhayena mahatā yukto hataśeṣaiśca dānavaiḥ ..
praviveśa samudrāṃtaṃ sudurgaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.229.d:
भयेन महता युक्तो हतशेषैश्च दानवैः ..
प्रविवेश समुद्रांतं सुदुर्गं ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.229.m: filled with great fear, entered within the ocean, an inaccessible fortress, / along with the surviving Dānavas, O best of brahmins. 2

5.229.s:
tataḥ śakraḥ prahṛṣṭātmā praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
tasyādeśaṃ samāsādya praviveśāmarāvatīm .. 3 ..
5.229.d:
ततः शक्रः प्रहृष्टात्मा प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् ..
तस्यादेशं समासाद्य प्रविवेशामरावतीम् .. 3 ..
5.229.m: Then Śakra, joyful in soul, bowed down to the bull-bannered Lord, / and having obtained his command, entered Amarāvatī. 3

5.229.s:
cakāra ca sukhī rājyaṃ trailokye'pi dvijottamāḥ..
yajñabhāgānpunarlebhe yathārthaṃ ca dharātale .. 4 ..
5.229.d:
चकार च सुखी राज्यं त्रैलोक्येऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः..
यज्ञभागान्पुनर्लेभे यथार्थं च धरातले .. 4 ..
5.229.m: And he ruled happily over the three worlds as well, O best of the twice-born; / and on the surface of the earth he once again received his sacrificial shares as was his due.

5.229.s:
etasminneva kāle tu hyaṃdhakasya suto vṛkaḥ ..
niṣkramya sāgarāttūrṇaṃ jaṃbudvīpaṃ samāgataḥ ..5..
5.229.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ह्यंधकस्य सुतो वृकः ..
निष्क्रम्य सागरात्तूर्णं जंबुद्वीपं समागतः ..5..
5.229.m: At that very time, however, Andhaka's son Vṛka / emerged swiftly from the ocean and came to Jambudvīpa,

5.229.s:
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ matvā puṇyaṃ susiddhidam ..
pitrā yatra tapastaptamaṃdhakena durātmanā .. 6 ..
5.229.d:
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं मत्वा पुण्यं सुसिद्धिदम् ..
पित्रा यत्र तपस्तप्तमंधकेन दुरात्मना .. 6 ..
5.229.m: considering the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara to be holy and granting great success, / where austerity had been performed by his father, the wicked Andhaka.

5.229.s:
saguptastu tapastepe'yathā vetti na kaścana ..
dhyāyamānaḥ suraśreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā kamalasaṃbhavam ..7..
5.229.d:
सगुप्तस्तु तपस्तेपेऽयथा वेत्ति न कश्चन ..
ध्यायमानः सुरश्रेष्ठं भक्त्या कमलसंभवम् ..7..
5.229.m: He performed hidden austerity so that no one might know, / meditating with devotion upon the lotus-born [Brahmā], the best of gods.

5.229.s:
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ jalāhāro dvitīyakam ..
tapastepe sa daityendro dhyāyamānaḥ pitāmaham .. 8 ..
5.229.d:
यावद्वर्षसहस्रांतं जलाहारो द्वितीयकम् ..
तपस्तेपे स दैत्येन्द्रो ध्यायमानः पितामहम् .. 8 ..
5.229.m: For a thousand years he lived on water alone; for a second [thousand] / that lord of Daityas performed austerity while meditating on the Grandfather.

5.229.s:
vāyubhakṣastato jātastāvatkālaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa bhūpṛṣṭhaṃ sparśamāno jitendriyaḥ .. 9 ..
5.229.d:
वायुभक्षस्ततो जातस्तावत्कालं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अंगुष्ठाग्रेण भूपृष्ठं स्पर्शमानो जितेन्द्रियः .. 9 ..
5.229.m: Then he became one who feeds on air for the same length of time, O best of the twice-born, / touching the surface of the earth only with the tip of his big toe, with senses conquered.

5.229.s:
evaṃ ca pañcame prāpte sahasre dvijasattamāḥ ..
brahmā tasya gatastuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya tapo mahat .. 6.230.10 ..
5.229.d:
एवं च पञ्चमे प्राप्ते सहस्रे द्विजसत्तमाः ..
ब्रह्मा तस्य गतस्तुष्टिं दृष्ट्वा तस्य तपो महत् .. 6.230.10 ..
5.229.m: And when the fifth thousand was reached in this manner, O best of the twice-born, / Brahmā became pleased with him upon seeing his great austerity.

5.229.s:
tato'bravīttamāgatya tāṃ gartāṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
bhobho vṛka nivartasva tapaso'smātsudāruṇāt .. 11 ..
5.229.d:
ततोऽब्रवीत्तमागत्य तां गर्तां ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
भोभो वृक निवर्तस्व तपसोऽस्मात्सुदारुणात् .. 11 ..
5.229.m: Then, having come to that pit, he said to him, O best of brahmins: / 'Hail, hail, Vṛka! Desist from this exceedingly fierce austerity!

5.229.s: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yo nityaṃ mana si sthitaḥ .. 12 ..
5.229.d: वरं वरय भद्रं ते यो नित्यं मन सि स्थितः .. 12 ..
5.229.m: Choose a boon, may good betide you, that is constantly in your mind.'

5.229.s:
.. vṛka uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
jarāmaraṇahīnaṃ māṃ tatkuruṣva pitāmaha .. 13 ..
5.229.d:
.. वृक उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
जरामरणहीनं मां तत्कुरुष्व पितामह .. 13 ..
5.229.m: Vṛka said: / 'If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be granted to me, / then make me free from old age and death, O Grandfather!'

5.229.s:
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
mama prasādato vatsa jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ..
bhaviṣyasi na sandehaḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 14 ..
5.229.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मम प्रसादतो वत्स जरामरणवर्जितः ..
भविष्यसि न सन्देहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 14 ..
5.229.m: Holy Brahmā said: / 'By my grace, my child, free from old age and death / you shall become, there is no doubt; this that I have spoken is true.'

5.229.s:
evamuktvā tato brahmā tatraivāṃtaradhī yata ..
vṛko'pi kṛtakṛtyastvāgataśca svagṛhaṃ pituḥ .. 15 ..
5.229.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो ब्रह्मा तत्रैवांतरधी यत ..
वृकोऽपि कृतकृत्यस्त्वागतश्च स्वगृहं पितुः .. 15 ..
5.229.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā vanished right there. / Vṛka too, his purpose accomplished, went to the home of his father,

5.229.s:
giriṃ raivatakaṃ nāma sarvartukusumojjvalam ..
tatra gatvā nijāmātyaiḥ samaṃ mantrya ca satva ram ..
indropari tataścakre yānaṃ yuddhaparīpsayā .. 16 ..
5.229.d:
गिरिं रैवतकं नाम सर्वर्तुकुसुमोज्ज्वलम् ..
तत्र गत्वा निजामात्यैः समं मन्त्र्य च सत्व रम् ..
इन्द्रोपरि ततश्चक्रे यानं युद्धपरीप्सया .. 16 ..
5.229.m: to the mountain named Raivataka, radiant with the flowers of all seasons. / Going there and quickly holding counsel with his own ministers, / he then made a march against Indra, wishing for battle.

5.229.s:
iṃdro'pi ca parijñāya dānavaṃ taṃ mahābalam ..
jarāmṛtyuparityaktaṃ prabhāvātparameṣṭhinaḥ .. 17 ..
5.229.d:
इंद्रोऽपि च परिज्ञाय दानवं तं महाबलम् ..
जरामृत्युपरित्यक्तं प्रभावात्परमेष्ठिनः .. 17 ..
5.229.m: Indra too, learning of that mighty Dānava, / free from old age and death through the power of the Supreme Lord [Brahmā],

5.229.s:
parityajya bhayāccaiva purīṃ caivāmarāvatīm ..
brahmalokaṃ gatastūrṇaṃ devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.229.d:
परित्यज्य भयाच्चैव पुरीं चैवामरावतीम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गतस्तूर्णं देवैः सर्वैः समन्वितः .. 18 ..
5.229.m: abandoned the city of Amarāvatī out of fear / and went swiftly to the world of Brahmā together with all the gods.

5.229.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto vṛkaśca tridaśālaye ..
sasainyaparivāreṇa prahṛṣṭena samanvitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.229.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो वृकश्च त्रिदशालये ..
ससैन्यपरिवारेण प्रहृष्टेन समन्वितः .. 19 ..
5.229.m: In the meantime, Vṛka arrived at the abode of the thirty [gods], / accompanied by his joyful army and retinue.

5.229.s:
tataścaiṃdrapade tasminsvayameva vyavasthitaḥ ..
śukrātprāpyābhiṣekaṃ ca puṣpasnānasamudbhavam .. 6.230.20 ..
5.229.d:
ततश्चैंद्रपदे तस्मिन्स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः ..
शुक्रात्प्राप्याभिषेकं च पुष्पस्नानसमुद्भवम् .. 6.230.20 ..
5.229.m: Then he took his place by himself upon that throne of Indra, / having received consecration from Śukra through a bath of flowers.

5.229.s:
so'bhiṣiktastu śukreṇa devarājyapade vṛkaḥ..
sthāpayāmāsa daiteyāndevatānāṃ padeṣu ca.. 21..
5.229.d:
सोऽभिषिक्तस्तु शुक्रेण देवराज्यपदे वृकः..
स्थापयामास दैतेयान्देवतानां पदेषु च.. 21..
5.229.m: Consecrated by Śukra in the position of king of the gods, Vṛka / installed Daityas in the positions of the deities,

5.229.s:
ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ ca rudrāṇāṃ marutāmapi..
yajñabhāgakṛte viprāḥ śukraśāsanamāśritāḥ..22..
5.229.d:
आदित्यानां वसूनां च रुद्राणां मरुतामपि..
यज्ञभागकृते विप्राः शुक्रशासनमाश्रिताः..22..
5.229.m: of the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Maruts as well, / for the sake of the sacrificial shares, O brahmins, adhering to Śukra's command.

5.229.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāne vṛkendrarājyalaṃbhanavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..230..
5.229.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलशाय्युपाख्याने वृकेन्द्रराज्यलंभनवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः..230..
5.229.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled "The Description of King Vṛka's Acquisition of Sovereignty," in the narrative of the One Who Lies on the Waters, in the section on the greatness of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.230.s:
..sūta uvāca..
vṛko'pi tatsamāsādya rājyaṃ trailokyasaṃbhavam..
yadṛcchayā jagatsarvaṃ samājñāpayattadā..1..
5.230.d:
..सूत उवाच..
वृकोऽपि तत्समासाद्य राज्यं त्रैलोक्यसंभवम्..
यदृच्छया जगत्सर्वं समाज्ञापयत्तदा..1..
5.230.m: Sūta said: / Having obtained that sovereignty over the three worlds, Vṛka, / at his own will, commanded the entire world at that time.

5.230.s:
soṃ'dhakasya bale vīrye dhairye kope ca dānavaḥ..
sahasraguṇitaścāsīdraudraḥ paramadāruṇaḥ..2..
5.230.d:
सोंऽधकस्य बले वीर्ये धैर्ये कोपे च दानवः..
सहस्रगुणितश्चासीद्रौद्रः परमदारुणः..2..
5.230.m: In strength, prowess, fortitude, and wrath, that Dānava / was a thousandfold greater than Andhaka, terrible and exceedingly fierce.

5.230.s:
etasminnaṃtare kaścinna martyo yajati kṣitau..
na homaṃ naiva jāpyaṃ ca daityāñjñātvā surāspade..3..
5.230.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कश्चिन्न मर्त्यो यजति क्षितौ..
न होमं नैव जाप्यं च दैत्याञ्ज्ञात्वा सुरास्पदे..3..
5.230.m: During this time, no mortal on earth performed sacrifice, / nor burnt offering, nor recitation, knowing that Daityas occupied the abode of the gods.

5.230.s:
atha yaḥ kurute dharmaṃ homaṃ vā japameva vā.
suguptasthānamāsādya karotyamaratuṣṭaye..4..
5.230.d:
अथ यः कुरुते धर्मं होमं वा जपमेव वा.
सुगुप्तस्थानमासाद्य करोत्यमरतुष्टये..4..
5.230.m: Now, whoever performed pious duty, or burnt offering, or recitation, / did so finding a well-hidden place, for the pleasure of the immortals.

5.230.s:
atha svargasthitā daityā yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ..
tathā martyodbhavairbhāgaiḥ saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ..5..
5.230.d:
अथ स्वर्गस्थिता दैत्या यज्ञभागविवर्जिताः..
तथा मर्त्योद्भवैर्भागैः संदेहं परमं गताः..5..
5.230.m: Then the Daityas stationed in heaven, deprived of sacrificial shares / and likewise of the portions arising from mortals, fell into great doubt.

5.230.s:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā preṣayāmāsa dānavaḥ..
martyaloke carānguptānnipuṇāṃścābravīttataḥ..6..
5.230.d:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा प्रेषयामास दानवः..
मर्त्यलोके चरान्गुप्तान्निपुणांश्चाब्रवीत्ततः..6..
5.230.m: Then, his mind filled with rage, the Dānava dispatched / hidden and clever spies to the mortal world, and said to them:

5.230.s:
yaḥ kaściddevatānāṃ ca pragṛhṇāti karoti ca..
tadarthaṃ yajanaṃ homaṃ dānaṃ vā pṛthivītale..
sa ca vadhyaśca yuṣmābhirmama vākyādasaṃśayam..7..
5.230.d:
यः कश्चिद्देवतानां च प्रगृह्णाति करोति च..
तदर्थं यजनं होमं दानं वा पृथिवीतले..
स च वध्यश्च युष्माभिर्मम वाक्यादसंशयम्..7..
5.230.m: 'Whoever undertakes or performs sacrifice, / burnt offering, or gift for the sake of the deities on the surface of the earth, / he must without doubt be slain by you at my command.'

5.230.s:
atha te tadvacaḥ śrutvā dānavā balavattarāḥ..
gatvā ca medinīpṛṣṭhaṃ guptāḥ sarpaṃti sarvataḥ..8..
5.230.d:
अथ ते तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दानवा बलवत्तराः..
गत्वा च मेदिनीपृष्ठं गुप्ताः सर्पंति सर्वतः..8..
5.230.m: Hearing his word, those exceedingly strong Dānavas / went to the surface of the earth and crept about in secret everywhere.

5.230.s:
yaṃ kañcidvīkṣayaṃtisma japahomaparāyaṇama..
svādhyāyaṃ vā prakurvāṇaṃ taṃ nighnaṃti śitāsibhiḥ.. 9..
5.230.d:
यं कञ्चिद्वीक्षयंतिस्म जपहोमपरायणम..
स्वाध्यायं वा प्रकुर्वाणं तं निघ्नंति शितासिभिः.. 9..
5.230.m: Whomever they saw devoted to recitation and burnt offerings, / or performing Vedic study, him they struck down with sharp swords.

5.230.s:
etasminneva kāle tu sāṃkṛtirmunisattamaḥ..
guptaścakre tatastasyāṃ gartāyāṃ channavarṣmakaḥ..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ vṛkeṇa ca dvijāḥ purā..6.231.10..
5.230.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सांकृतिर्मुनिसत्तमः..
गुप्तश्चक्रे ततस्तस्यां गर्तायां छन्नवर्ष्मकः..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं वृकेण च द्विजाः पुरा..6.231.10..
5.230.m: At that very time, Sāṅkṛti, the best of sages, / stayed in secret with his body concealed in that pit / where previously austerity had been performed by Vṛka, O twice-born.

5.230.s:
atha te taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā tadguhāyāṃ vyavasthitam..
bhartsamānāstapastacca procuśca paruṣākṣaraiḥ..11..
5.230.d:
अथ ते तं तदा दृष्ट्वा तद्गुहायां व्यवस्थितम्..
भर्त्समानास्तपस्तच्च प्रोचुश्च परुषाक्षरैः..11..
5.230.m: Then, seeing him stationed in that cave, / reviling that austerity, they spoke in harsh words,

5.230.s:
dṛṣṭvā tasyāgrataḥ saṃsthāṃ gandhapuṣpaiśca pūjitām..
vāsudevātmikāṃ mūrtiṃ caturhastāṃ dvijottamāḥ..12..
5.230.d:
दृष्ट्वा तस्याग्रतः संस्थां गन्धपुष्पैश्च पूजिताम्..
वासुदेवात्मिकां मूर्तिं चतुर्हस्तां द्विजोत्तमाः..12..
5.230.m: having seen standing before him, worshipped with perfumes and flowers, / the four-armed image embodying Vāsudeva, O best of the twice-born.

5.230.s:
tataste śastramudyamya nirjaghnustaṃ krudhānvitāḥ..
na śekuste yadā haṃtuṃ saṃvṛtaṃ viṣṇutejasā..
kuṇṭhatāṃ sarvaśastrāṇi gatāni vimalānyapi..13..
5.230.d:
ततस्ते शस्त्रमुद्यम्य निर्जघ्नुस्तं क्रुधान्विताः..
न शेकुस्ते यदा हंतुं संवृतं विष्णुतेजसा..
कुण्ठतां सर्वशस्त्राणि गतानि विमलान्यपि..13..
5.230.m: Then, lifting their weapons, they struck him in anger. / When they could not kill him who was shielded by Viṣṇu's splendor, / all their weapons, though spotless, became blunted.

5.230.s:
atha vailakṣyamāpannā nirviṇṇāḥ sarva eva te..
tāṃ vārtāṃ dānavendrāya vṛkāyocuśca te tadā..14..
5.230.d:
अथ वैलक्ष्यमापन्ना निर्विण्णाः सर्व एव ते..
तां वार्तां दानवेन्द्राय वृकायोचुश्च ते तदा..14..
5.230.m: Then, overwhelmed with embarrassment and dejected, all of them / related that news to Vṛka, the lord of Dānavas:

5.230.s:
kaścidvipraḥ samādhāya vaiṣṇavīṃ pratimāṃ puraḥ..
tapastepe mahābhāga kṣetre vai hāṭakeśvare..15..
5.230.d:
कश्चिद्विप्रः समाधाय वैष्णवीं प्रतिमां पुरः..
तपस्तेपे महाभाग क्षेत्रे वै हाटकेश्वरे..15..
5.230.m: 'A certain brahmin, having set an image of Viṣṇu before him, / performed austerity, O noble one, in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara,

5.230.s:
yatra tvayā tapastaptaṃ bhītyā sarvadivaukasām..
api cauryeṇa cāsmākaṃ tapastapati tādṛśam.. 16..
5.230.d:
यत्र त्वया तपस्तप्तं भीत्या सर्वदिवौकसाम्..
अपि चौर्येण चास्माकं तपस्तपति तादृशम्.. 16..
5.230.m: where austerity was performed by you out of fear of all the gods. / He too performs such austerity in secret from us,

5.230.s:
yena sarvāṇi śastrāṇi kuṇṭhatāṃ pragatāni ca..
tasya gātre prahāraiśca tasmātkuru yathocitam.. 17..
5.230.d:
येन सर्वाणि शस्त्राणि कुण्ठतां प्रगतानि च..
तस्य गात्रे प्रहारैश्च तस्मात्कुरु यथोचितम्.. 17..
5.230.m: by which all weapons have become blunted / through blows upon his body. Therefore, do as is fitting!'

5.230.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛkaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ..
jagāma satvaṃ tatra yatrāsau sāṃkṛtiḥ sthitaḥ..18..
5.230.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वृकः कोपसमन्वितः..
जगाम सत्वं तत्र यत्रासौ सांकृतिः स्थितः..18..
5.230.m: Hearing that word of theirs, Vṛka, filled with wrath, / quickly went there where that Sāṅkṛti was staying.

5.230.s:
sa gatvā vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtiṃ tāmutkṣipya sudūrataḥ..
śvabhrādbahiḥ pracikṣepa bhartsamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ..19..
5.230.d:
स गत्वा वैष्णवीं मूर्तिं तामुत्क्षिप्य सुदूरतः..
श्वभ्राद्बहिः प्रचिक्षेप भर्त्समानः पुनः पुनः..19..
5.230.m: Going there, he lifted that image of Viṣṇu and hurled it far away, / casting it out of the chasm, reviling him again and again.

5.230.s:
jaghāna pādaghātena dakṣiṇenetareṇa tam..
abravīnmama vadhyastvaṃ yanmacchatruṃ janārdanam..6.231.20..
5.230.d:
जघान पादघातेन दक्षिणेनेतरेण तम्..
अब्रवीन्मम वध्यस्त्वं यन्मच्छत्रुं जनार्दनम्..6.231.20..
5.230.m: He struck him with kicks of his right foot and the other, / and said: 'You are to be killed by me, since Janārdana, my enemy,

5.230.s:
saṃpūjayasi cauryeṇa tena prāṇānharāmyaham..
evamuktvātha khaḍgena taṃ jaghāna sa daityapaḥ..21..
5.230.d:
संपूजयसि चौर्येण तेन प्राणान्हराम्यहम्..
एवमुक्त्वाथ खड्गेन तं जघान स दैत्यपः..21..
5.230.m: you worship in secret; therefore I will take your life!' / Having spoken thus, the Daitya ruler struck him with a sword.

5.230.s:
tatastasya sa khaḍgastu tīkṣṇo'pi dvijasattamāḥ..
tasya kāye prahīṇastu śatadhā samapadyata..22..
5.230.d:
ततस्तस्य स खड्गस्तु तीक्ष्णोऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः..
तस्य काये प्रहीणस्तु शतधा समपद्यत..22..
5.230.m: Then his sword, although sharp, O best of the twice-born, / broke into a hundred pieces when struck against his body.

5.230.s: tataḥ kopaparītātmā taṃ śaśāpa sa sāṃkṛtiḥ..23..
5.230.d: ततः कोपपरीतात्मा तं शशाप स सांकृतिः..23..
5.230.m: Then Sāṃkṛti, his mind seized by rage, cursed him:

5.230.s:
yasmātpāpa tvayāhaṃ ca pādaghātaiḥ pratāḍitaḥ ..
tasmātte patatāṃ pādau sadya eva dharātale .. 24 ..
5.230.d:
यस्मात्पाप त्वयाहं च पादघातैः प्रताडितः ..
तस्मात्ते पततां पादौ सद्य एव धरातले .. 24 ..
5.230.m: "Since I have been struck by you with kicks, O sinner, / therefore let both your feet fall immediately to the earth's surface!"

5.230.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
uktamātre tatastena pādau tasya dvijottamāḥ ..
patitau medinīpṛṣṭhe paṃcaśīrṣāvivoragau .. 25 ..
5.230.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
उक्तमात्रे ततस्तेन पादौ तस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पतितौ मेदिनीपृष्ठे पंचशीर्षाविवोरगौ .. 25 ..
5.230.m: Sūta said: / No sooner was that spoken by him, O best of brahmins, / than his two feet fell upon the surface of the earth like five-headed serpents.

5.230.s:
etasminneva kāle tu ākrandaḥ sumahānabhūt ..
vṛkasya sainikānāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. .. 26 ..
5.230.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु आक्रन्दः सुमहानभूत् ..
वृकस्य सैनिकानां च नारीणां च विशेषतः .. .. 26 ..
5.230.m: At that very moment, a very great wailing arose, / particularly from Vṛka's soldiers and women.

5.230.s:
atha devāḥ parijñāya taṃ tadā paṃgutāṃ gatam .
āgatya merupṛṣṭhaṃ ca nijaghnustatparigraham .. 27 ..
5.230.d:
अथ देवाः परिज्ञाय तं तदा पंगुतां गतम् .
आगत्य मेरुपृष्ठं च निजघ्नुस्तत्परिग्रहम् .. 27 ..
5.230.m: Then the gods, learning that he had become lame, / came to the summit of Meru and killed his retinue.

5.230.s:
hataśeṣāśca daityāste pātālāṃtaḥsamā gatāḥ ..
vṛko'pi paṃgutāṃ prāptastasthau tapasi susthiram .. 28 ..
5.230.d:
हतशेषाश्च दैत्यास्ते पातालांतःसमा गताः ..
वृकोऽपि पंगुतां प्राप्तस्तस्थौ तपसि सुस्थिरम् .. 28 ..
5.230.m: And the remaining daityas fled into the depths of Pātāla; / Vṛka also, having become lame, remained firmly settled in austerity.

5.230.s:
sarvairaṃtaḥpuraiḥ sārdhaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ ..
indro'pi prāptavānrājyaṃ tadā nihata kaṃṭakam .. 29 ..
5.230.d:
सर्वैरंतःपुरैः सार्धं दुःखशोकसमन्वितः ..
इन्द्रोऽपि प्राप्तवान्राज्यं तदा निहत कंटकम् .. 29 ..
5.230.m: Together with all his inner quarters, filled with grief and sorrow, / Indra too regained his kingdom, its obstacles now removed.

5.230.s: dharmakriyāḥ pravṛttāśca tato bhūyo rasātale .. 6.231.30 ..
5.230.d: धर्मक्रियाः प्रवृत्ताश्च ततो भूयो रसातले .. 6.231.30 ..
5.230.m: And righteous acts commenced once again in Rasātala.

5.230.s:
atha dīrgheṇa kālena tasya tuṣṭaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
uvāca tatra cāgatya garttāmadhye dvijottamāḥ .. 31 ..
5.230.d:
अथ दीर्घेण कालेन तस्य तुष्टः पितामहः ..
उवाच तत्र चागत्य गर्त्तामध्ये द्विजोत्तमाः .. 31 ..
5.230.m: Then after a long time, the Grandfather [Brahmā] was pleased with him, / and coming there into the pit, O best of brahmins, he said:

5.230.s:
vṛka tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
ahaṃ dāsyāmi te nūnaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 32 ..
5.230.d:
वृक तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
अहं दास्यामि ते नूनं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 32 ..
5.230.m: "Vṛka, I am pleased with you, dear child. Choose a boon, O one of good vows! / I shall surely give it to you, even if it be extremely difficult to attain."

5.230.s:
.. vṛka uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
pādadānaṃ tadā deva mama brahmansamācara ..
paṃgutā yāti śīghraṃ me yeneyaṃ te prasādataḥ .. 33 ..
5.230.d:
.. वृक उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
पाददानं तदा देव मम ब्रह्मन्समाचर ..
पंगुता याति शीघ्रं मे येनेयं ते प्रसादतः .. 33 ..
5.230.m: Vṛka said: / "If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be given to me, / then, O god, O Brahmā, grant me feet, / so that through your grace this lameness of mine departs quickly."

5.230.s:
tacchrutvā taṃ samānīya sāṃkṛtiṃ tatra padmajaḥ ..
provāca sāṃtvapūrvaṃ ca vṛkasyāsya dvijottama .. 34 ..
5.230.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तं समानीय सांकृतिं तत्र पद्मजः ..
प्रोवाच सांत्वपूर्वं च वृकस्यास्य द्विजोत्तम .. 34 ..
5.230.m: Hearing that, the Lotus-born [Brahmā] brought Sāṃkṛti there, / and spoke gently to him for the sake of this Vṛka, O best of brahmins:

5.230.s: madvākyātpaṃgutā yāti yenāsya tvaṃ tathā kuru .. 35 .. ..
5.230.d: मद्वाक्यात्पंगुता याति येनास्य त्वं तथा कुरु .. 35 .. ..
5.230.m: "Act so that by my word his lameness may depart."

5.230.s:
.. sāṃkṛtiruvāca .. ..
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me svaireṣvapi pitāmaha ..
jñāyate devadeveśa tatkathaṃ tatkaromyaham .. 36 ..
5.230.d:
.. सांकृतिरुवाच .. ..
अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे स्वैरेष्वपि पितामह ..
ज्ञायते देवदेवेश तत्कथं तत्करोम्यहम् .. 36 ..
5.230.m: Sāṃkṛti said: / "Untruth has never been spoken by me, even in jest, O Grandfather; / it is known, O Lord of the gods of gods! How then may I do that?"

5.230.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
mama bhaktiparo nityaṃ vṛko'yaṃ daityasattamaḥ ..
pautrastvaṃ dayito nityaṃ tena tvāṃ prārthayāmyaham .. 37 ..
5.230.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मम भक्तिपरो नित्यं वृकोऽयं दैत्यसत्तमः ..
पौत्रस्त्वं दयितो नित्यं तेन त्वां प्रार्थयाम्यहम् .. 37 ..
5.230.m: Brahmā said: / "This Vṛka, the best of daityas, is always dedicated to my devotion; / and you, my grandson, are ever beloved. Therefore do I entreat you.

5.230.s: tava vākyaṃ ca no mithyā kartuṃ śaknomi sanmune .. 38 ..
5.230.d: तव वाक्यं च नो मिथ्या कर्तुं शक्नोमि सन्मुने .. 38 ..
5.230.m: Nor can I make your word false, O good sage."

5.230.s:
.. sāṃkṛtiruvāca .. ..
eṣa daityaḥ suduṣṭātmā devānāmahite sthitaḥ ..
viśeṣādvāsudevasya purormama mahātmanaḥ .. 39 ..
5.230.d:
.. सांकृतिरुवाच .. ..
एष दैत्यः सुदुष्टात्मा देवानामहिते स्थितः ..
विशेषाद्वासुदेवस्य पुरोर्मम महात्मनः .. 39 ..
5.230.m: Sāṃkṛti said: / "This daitya is very wicked, bent on harming the gods, / especially the noble Vāsudeva, my elder.

5.230.s:
paṃgutāmarhati prāyaḥ pāpātmā dvijadūṣakaḥ ..
balena mahatā yukto jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ .. 6.231.40 ..
5.230.d:
पंगुतामर्हति प्रायः पापात्मा द्विजदूषकः ..
बलेन महता युक्तो जरामरणवर्जितः .. 6.231.40 ..
5.230.m: This sinner, abuser of brahmins, fully deserves lameness; / endowed with great strength, he was freed from old age and death

5.230.s:
purā kṛtastvayā deva sa cetpādāvavāpsyati ..
haniṣyati jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam .. 41 ..
5.230.d:
पुरा कृतस्त्वया देव स चेत्पादाववाप्स्यति ..
हनिष्यति जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् .. 41 ..
5.230.m: by you formerly, O god. If he obtains two feet, / he will destroy the entire world, including gods, asuras, and mortals.

5.230.s:
tasmāttiṣṭhatu tadrūpo na kalpaṃ kartumarhasi ..
tvayāpi cintā kartavyā trailokyasya yataḥ prabho .. .. 42 ..
5.230.d:
तस्मात्तिष्ठतु तद्रूपो न कल्पं कर्तुमर्हसि ..
त्वयापि चिन्ता कर्तव्या त्रैलोक्यस्य यतः प्रभो .. .. 42 ..
5.230.m: Therefore let him remain as he is; you ought not to alter it. / For concern for the three worlds must be taken by you as well, O Lord."

5.230.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
prāvṛṭkāle tu sañjāte yānaṃ kartuṃ na yujyate ..
vijigīṣorviśeṣeṇa muktvā śītātapāgamam .. 43 ..
5.230.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
प्रावृट्काले तु सञ्जाते यानं कर्तुं न युज्यते ..
विजिगीषोर्विशेषेण मुक्त्वा शीतातपागमम् .. 43 ..
5.230.m: Brahmā said: / "When the rainy season has arrived, it is not fit to undertake a march, / especially for one who wishes to conquer, leaving aside the arrival of cold and heat.

5.230.s:
tasmācca caturo māsānvārṣikānpādasaṃyutaḥ ..
agamyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ kuryātkarmāṇi dhairyataḥ .. 44 ..
5.230.d:
तस्माच्च चतुरो मासान्वार्षिकान्पादसंयुतः ..
अगम्यः सर्वलोकानां कुर्यात्कर्माणि धैर्यतः .. 44 ..
5.230.m: Therefore, for the four rainy months, endowed with feet, / inaccessible to all the worlds, let him perform actions steadfastly.

5.230.s:
tadbhūyātpādasaṃyuktaḥ sa vṛko dāna vottamaḥ ..
yena kṣemaṃ ca devānāṃ dvijānāṃ jāyate dvija .. 45 ..
5.230.d:
तद्भूयात्पादसंयुक्तः स वृको दान वोत्तमः ..
येन क्षेमं च देवानां द्विजानां जायते द्विज .. 45 ..
5.230.m: Thus let that Vṛka, the foremost of dānavas, be endowed with feet, / in such a way that safety is secured for the gods and brahmins, O brahmin.

5.230.s:
evaṃ kṛte na mithyā te vākyaṃ vipra bhaviṣyati ..
phalaṃ ca tapasastasya na vṛthā saṃbhaviṣyati .. 46 ..
5.230.d:
एवं कृते न मिथ्या ते वाक्यं विप्र भविष्यति ..
फलं च तपसस्तस्य न वृथा संभविष्यति .. 46 ..
5.230.m: When it is done thus, your word will not become false, O brahmin, / and the fruit of his austerity will not be in vain."

5.230.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamityeva tenokte sāṃkṛtena mahātmanā ..
utthitau sahasā pādau tasya gātrātpunarnavau.. 47 ..
5.230.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्येव तेनोक्ते सांकृतेन महात्मना ..
उत्थितौ सहसा पादौ तस्य गात्रात्पुनर्नवौ.. 47 ..
5.230.m: Sūta said: / When the noble Sāṃkṛti said, 'So be it,' / two fresh feet immediately arose from his body.

5.230.s:
punaśca dānavo raudraḥ paśutvaṃ samapadyata..
tasyāmeva tu gartāyāṃ saṃtiṣṭhati dvijottamāḥ..48..
5.230.d:
पुनश्च दानवो रौद्रः पशुत्वं समपद्यत..
तस्यामेव तु गर्तायां संतिष्ठति द्विजोत्तमाः..48..
5.230.m: And again the dreadful dānava attained a beast-like state [for eight months]; / he stayed in that very pit, O best of brahmins,

5.230.s:
māsānaṣṭau sa duḥkhena sakalatraḥ sabāṃdhavaḥ ..
smaramāṇo mahadvairaṃ daivaiḥ sārdhaṃ divāniśam..49..
anyāṃśca caturo māsānniṣkramya sa ruṣānvitaḥ..
sadā pīḍayate devānsaheṃdrānmānuṣānapi ..6.231.5...
5.230.d:
मासानष्टौ स दुःखेन सकलत्रः सबांधवः ..
स्मरमाणो महद्वैरं दैवैः सार्धं दिवानिशम्..49..
अन्यांश्च चतुरो मासान्निष्क्रम्य स रुषान्वितः..
सदा पीडयते देवान्सहेंद्रान्मानुषानपि ..6.231.5...
5.230.m:
for eight months in misery, together with his wife and relatives, / remembering day and night his great enmity with the gods.
And during the other four months, having emerged filled with fury, / he continually harassed the gods along with Indra, and humans as well;

5.230.s: vidhvaṃsayati sarvāṇi dharmasthānāni yāni ca ..51..
5.230.d: विध्वंसयति सर्वाणि धर्मस्थानानि यानि च ..51..
5.230.m: and he wrecked all righteous places.

5.230.s:
vidhvaṃsayati devānāṃ striyo māsacatuṣṭayam ..
udyānāni ca sarvāṇi sapurāṇi gṛhāṇi ca ..52..
5.230.d:
विध्वंसयति देवानां स्त्रियो मासचतुष्टयम् ..
उद्यानानि च सर्वाणि सपुराणि गृहाणि च ..52..
5.230.m: For the period of four months he violated the women of the gods, / and all the gardens along with cities and homes.

5.230.s:
tato devāḥ samabhyetya devadevaṃ janārdanam ..
kṣīrābdhau saṃsthitaṃ nityaṃ śeṣaparyaṃkaśāyinam..53..
5.230.d:
ततो देवाः समभ्येत्य देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ..
क्षीराब्धौ संस्थितं नित्यं शेषपर्यंकशायिनम्..53..
5.230.m: Then the gods, having approached Janārdana, the god of gods, / who constantly dwells in the Ocean of Milk, reclining on the couch of Śeṣa,

5.230.s:
caturo vārṣikānmāsāṃstatra sthitvā tadaṃtike ..
māsānaṣṭau punarjagmustridivaṃ prati nirbhayāḥ .. 54 ..
5.230.d:
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासांस्तत्र स्थित्वा तदंतिके ..
मासानष्टौ पुनर्जग्मुस्त्रिदिवं प्रति निर्भयाः .. 54 ..
5.230.m: and having stayed there near him for the four rainy months, / returned once more without fear to heaven for the eight months.

5.230.s:
tasminpaṃgutvamāpanne daitye paramadāruṇe ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya devarājo bṛhaspatim ..
provāca duḥkhasaṃtapta āṣāḍhāṃte suro ttamaḥ .. 55 ..
5.230.d:
तस्मिन्पंगुत्वमापन्ने दैत्ये परमदारुणे ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य देवराजो बृहस्पतिम् ..
प्रोवाच दुःखसंतप्त आषाढांते सुरो त्तमः .. 55 ..
5.230.m: While that exceedingly cruel daitya had fallen into lameness, / after some time the king of the gods, scorched by sorrow at the end of Āṣāḍha, said to Bṛhaspati:

5.230.s:
guro sa māsaḥ saṃprāptaḥ prāvṛṭkālo bhayāvahaḥ ..
āgamiṣyati yatrāsau labdhapādo vṛkāsuraḥ ..56..
5.230.d:
गुरो स मासः संप्राप्तः प्रावृट्कालो भयावहः ..
आगमिष्यति यत्रासौ लब्धपादो वृकासुरः ..56..
5.230.m: "O Guru, that terrifying month of the rainy season has arrived, / when this Vṛkāsura, having obtained feet, will come.

5.230.s:
gantavyaṃ ca tato'smābhiḥ kṣīrode keśavālaye ..
maivaṃ dīnaistathā bhāvyaṃ parāśrayanivāsibhiḥ .. 57 ..
5.230.d:
गन्तव्यं च ततोऽस्माभिः क्षीरोदे केशवालये ..
मैवं दीनैस्तथा भाव्यं पराश्रयनिवासिभिः .. 57 ..
5.230.m: And we must then go to the Ocean of Milk, to Keśava's abode. / We must not continue thus, miserable, dwelling in another's refuge,

5.230.s:
svagṛhāṇi parityajya śayanānyāsanāni ca ..
vāhanāni vicitrāṇi yaccānya ddayitaṃ gṛhe .. 58 ..
5.230.d:
स्वगृहाणि परित्यज्य शयनान्यासनानि च ..
वाहनानि विचित्राणि यच्चान्य द्दयितं गृहे .. 58 ..
5.230.m: abandoning our homes, our beds, our seats, / our diverse mounts, and whatever else is dear in the house.

5.230.s:
tasmātkathaya cāsmākamupāyaṃ kañcideva hi ..
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vātha homaṃ vā munisattama .. 59 ..
5.230.d:
तस्मात्कथय चास्माकमुपायं कञ्चिदेव हि ..
व्रतं वा नियमं वाथ होमं वा मुनिसत्तम .. 59 ..
5.230.m: Therefore tell us some means indeed, / whether a vow, an observance, or an oblation, O best of sages,

5.230.s:
aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ yena svakalatreṇa jāyate ..
tathā na gṛhasaṃtyāgaḥ svakīyasya prajāyate .. 6.231.60 ..
5.230.d:
अशून्यं शयनं येन स्वकलत्रेण जायते ..
तथा न गृहसंत्यागः स्वकीयस्य प्रजायते .. 6.231.60 ..
5.230.m: by which the bed may not be empty of one's wife, / and likewise the abandonment of one's own home does not occur.

5.230.s:
nirviṇṇo'haṃ nijasthānabhraṃśāddvijavarottama ..
varṣevarṣe ca samprāpte sthānakasya cyutirbhavet .. 61 ..
5.230.d:
निर्विण्णोऽहं निजस्थानभ्रंशाद्द्विजवरोत्तम ..
वर्षेवर्षे च सम्प्राप्ते स्थानकस्य च्युतिर्भवेत् .. 61 ..
5.230.m: I am despondent from being displaced from my own realm, O best of foremost brahmins; / and every year that arrives, the fall from my position occurs.

5.230.s:
punarbhūmau śayiṣyāmi yāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ..
niṣkalatro bhayodvigno brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ .. 62 ..
5.230.d:
पुनर्भूमौ शयिष्यामि यावन्मासचतुष्टयम् ..
निष्कलत्रो भयोद्विग्नो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः .. 62 ..
5.230.m: Again I shall lie upon the ground for the duration of four months, / without my wife, agitated by fear, devoted to celibacy."

5.230.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhayārtasya bṛhaspatiḥ ..
provāca suciraṃ dhyātvā tato devaṃ śatakratum .. 63 ..
5.230.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भयार्तस्य बृहस्पतिः ..
प्रोवाच सुचिरं ध्यात्वा ततो देवं शतक्रतुम् .. 63 ..
5.230.m: Hearing those words of his, who was afflicted by fear, / Bṛhaspati meditated for a long time and then said to god Śatakratu [Indra]:

5.230.s:
aśūnyaśayanaṃnāma vratamasti mahattapaḥ ..
viṣṇorārādhanārthāya tatkuruṣva samā hitaḥ .. 64 ..
5.230.d:
अशून्यशयनंनाम व्रतमस्ति महत्तपः ..
विष्णोराराधनार्थाय तत्कुरुष्व समा हितः .. 64 ..
5.230.m: "There is a great austerity of a vow named Aśūnyaśayana, / for the sake of worshipping Viṣṇu. Perform that with concentrated mind.

5.230.s:
devo yatrāsti viṣṇuḥ sa kṣīrābdhau madhusūdanaḥ ..
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ sa dāsyati hitaṃ ca te .. 65 ..
5.230.d:
देवो यत्रास्ति विष्णुः स क्षीराब्धौ मधुसूदनः ..
जलशायी जगद्योनिः स दास्यति हितं च ते .. 65 ..
5.230.m: Where God Viṣṇu is, that Madhusūdana / who sleeps on the waters, the source of the universe—he will grant your welfare,

5.230.s:
yathā na śūnyaṃ śayanaṃ gṛha bhaṃgaḥ prajāyate ..
sarvaśatruvināśaśca tatprasādena vāsava .. 66 ..
5.230.d:
यथा न शून्यं शयनं गृह भंगः प्रजायते ..
सर्वशत्रुविनाशश्च तत्प्रसादेन वासव .. 66 ..
5.230.m: so that your bed will not be empty, the destruction of your home will not occur, / and the destruction of all enemies will take place by his grace, O Vāsava."

5.230.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasminvrate tataścīrṇe hyaśūnyaśayanātmake ..
tutoṣa bhagavānviṣṇustataḥ provāca devapam .. 67 ..
5.230.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्व्रते ततश्चीर्णे ह्यशून्यशयनात्मके ..
तुतोष भगवान्विष्णुस्ततः प्रोवाच देवपम् .. 67 ..
5.230.m: Sūta said: / When that observance consisting of the unbroken bed was performed, / Lord Viṣṇu was pleased, and then spoke to the ruler of the gods:

5.230.s:
śakra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
vratenānena cīrṇena cāturmāsyodbhavena ca ..
tasmātprārthaya devendra nityaṃ yanmanasi sthitam .. 68 ..
5.230.d:
शक्र तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन चातुर्मास्योद्भवेन च ..
तस्मात्प्रार्थय देवेन्द्र नित्यं यन्मनसि स्थितम् .. 68 ..
5.230.m: "O Śakra, I am pleased, may it be well with you! Choose a boon, O you of noble vows! / By performing this vow pertaining to the Cāturmāsya, / therefore, O Devendra, ask for whatever is always in your mind."

5.230.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇa jānāsi tvaṃ cāpi yaśca me'tra parābhavaḥ ..
kriyate dānavendreṇa vṛkeṇa sudurātmanā .. 69 ..
5.230.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
कृष्ण जानासि त्वं चापि यश्च मेऽत्र पराभवः ..
क्रियते दानवेन्द्रेण वृकेण सुदुरात्मना .. 69 ..
5.230.m: Indra said: / "O Kṛṣṇa, you also know the defeat that is inflicted upon me here / by the lord of the Dānavas, the extremely evil Vṛka.

5.230.s:
mamāṣṭamāsikaṃ rājyaṃ trailokye'pi vyavasthitam ..
śeṣāṃśca caturo māsānvarṣevarṣe sameti saḥ .. 6.231.70 ..
5.230.d:
ममाष्टमासिकं राज्यं त्रैलोक्येऽपि व्यवस्थितम् ..
शेषांश्च चतुरो मासान्वर्षेवर्षे समेति सः .. 6.231.70 ..
5.230.m: My reign over the three worlds lasts for only eight months; / and during the remaining four months, year after year, he approaches.

5.230.s:
evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ..
tathā kuru yathā rājyaṃ mama syātsārvakālikam .. 71 ..
5.230.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा सुरश्रेष्ठ दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि ..
तथा कुरु यथा राज्यं मम स्यात्सार्वकालिकम् .. 71 ..
5.230.m: Knowing this, O best of gods, having compassion on me, / act in such a way that my kingdom may be perpetual."

5.230.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
ajaraścāmaraścāpi sa kṛtaḥ padmayoninā ..
tatkathaṃ jīvamānena tena rājyaṃ bhavettava .. 72 ..
5.230.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
अजरश्चामरश्चापि स कृतः पद्मयोनिना ..
तत्कथं जीवमानेन तेन राज्यं भवेत्तव .. 72 ..
5.230.m: Viṣṇu said: / "He was made ageless and immortal by the lotus-born [Brahmā]; / how then, while he is living, can the kingdom be yours?

5.230.s: paraṃ tathāpi devendra kariṣyāmi hitaṃ tava .. 73 ..
5.230.d: परं तथापि देवेन्द्र करिष्यामि हितं तव .. 73 ..
5.230.m: Nevertheless, O lord of gods, I will do what is beneficial to you.

5.230.s:
kṣīrārṇavaṃ parityajya hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñite ..
kṣetre gatvā samaṃ lakṣmyā tasyopari tataḥ param .. 74 ..
5.230.d:
क्षीरार्णवं परित्यज्य हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञिते ..
क्षेत्रे गत्वा समं लक्ष्म्या तस्योपरि ततः परम् .. 74 ..
5.230.m: Leaving the Ocean of Milk and going together with Lakṣmī / to the sacred field named Hāṭakeśvara, thereafter on top of him

5.230.s:
kariṣyāmi tvahaṃ śakra śayanaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ ..
yāvacca caturo māsānyathā sa na caliṣyati .. 785 ..
tasmātsthānātsahasrākṣa madbhāreṇa prapīḍitaḥ ..
varṣevarṣe sadā kāryaṃ mayā tatsuhitaṃ tava .. 76 ..
tasmādgacchādhunā svarge kuru rājyamakaṃṭakam ..
prāvṛṭ kāle tu saṃprāpte na bhīḥ kāryā tadudbhavā .. 77 ..
yo māṃ tatra śayānaṃ tu vratenānena devapa..
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā tasya dāsyāmi vāṃchitam .. 78 ...
.. sūta uvāca ..
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśo visasarja śatakratum ..
niḥśeṣabhayanirmuktaṃ svarājyaparivṛddhaye 79..
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣa ekādaśyā dine sadā..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tatrāgatya svayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 6.231.80 ..
vṛkopari tataścakre śayanaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ ..
tenākrāṃtastataḥ so'pi śaknoti calituṃ na hi .. 81 ...
5.230.d:
करिष्यामि त्वहं शक्र शयनं यत्नमास्थितः ..
यावच्च चतुरो मासान्यथा स न चलिष्यति .. 785 ..
तस्मात्स्थानात्सहस्राक्ष मद्भारेण प्रपीडितः ..
वर्षेवर्षे सदा कार्यं मया तत्सुहितं तव .. 76 ..
तस्माद्गच्छाधुना स्वर्गे कुरु राज्यमकंटकम् ..
प्रावृट् काले तु संप्राप्ते न भीः कार्या तदुद्भवा .. 77 ..
यो मां तत्र शयानं तु व्रतेनानेन देवप..
पूजयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या तस्य दास्यामि वांछितम् .. 78 ...
.. सूत उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशो विससर्ज शतक्रतुम् ..
निःशेषभयनिर्मुक्तं स्वराज्यपरिवृद्धये 79..
आषाढस्य सिते पक्ष एकादश्या दिने सदा..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे तत्रागत्य स्वयं विभुः .. 6.231.80 ..
वृकोपरि ततश्चक्रे शयनं यत्नमास्थितः ..
तेनाक्रांतस्ततः सोऽपि शक्नोति चलितुं न हि .. 81 ...
5.230.m:
I will take to lying down with effort, O Śakra, / for the duration of the four months, so that he will not move.
Oppressed by my weight, from that place, O thousand-eyed one [Indra], / every year that welfare of yours must always be accomplished by me.
Therefore, go now to heaven and rule the kingdom without thorns; / when the rainy season arrives, you should have no fear arising from him.
Whoever, O ruler of gods, worships me lying down there / with this observance and with true devotion, to him I will grant what he desires."
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, Hṛṣīkeśa sent away Śatakratu, / freed from all fear, for the prosperity of his own kingdom.
Always on the day of the eleventh [tithi] in the bright half of Āṣāḍha, / the all-pervading Lord, arriving there in person at the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara,
then took to lying down upon Vṛka with effort; / overcome by him, he was not able to move at all.

5.230.s:
mṛtaprāyastato nityaṃ tadbhāreṇa prapīḍitaḥ ..
kārtikasya site pakṣa ekādaśyā dine sthite .. 82 ..
utthānaṃ kurute viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaṃ prati gacchati ..ā.
so'pi sāṃkṛtiśāpena vṛkaḥ paṃgutvamāpnuyāt .. 83 ..
evaṃ ca caturo māsānna tyajecchayanaṃ hariḥ ..
bhayāttasyāsureṃdrasya dānavasya durātmanaḥ .. .. 84 ..
tatra martyaiḥ kriyā sarvāḥ kriyate na makhodbhavāḥ ..
yasmātsa yajñapuruṣo na supto bhāgamaśnute .. 85 ..
tathā yajñāśca ye sarve ktvayādānādi kāḥ śubhāḥ ..
te sarve na kriyaṃte ca cūḍākaraṇapūrvakāḥ .. 86 ..
muktvānnaprāśanaṃnāma sīmaṃtonnayanaṃ tathā ..
tasmātsupte jagannāthe tāḥ sarvāḥ syurvṛthā dvijāḥ .. 87 ..
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vātha tasminyaḥ kurute naraḥ ..
prasupte devadeveśe tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ..88..
5.230.d:
मृतप्रायस्ततो नित्यं तद्भारेण प्रपीडितः ..
कार्तिकस्य सिते पक्ष एकादश्या दिने स्थिते .. 82 ..
उत्थानं कुरुते विष्णुः क्षीरोदं प्रति गच्छति ..आ.
सोऽपि सांकृतिशापेन वृकः पंगुत्वमाप्नुयात् .. 83 ..
एवं च चतुरो मासान्न त्यजेच्छयनं हरिः ..
भयात्तस्यासुरेंद्रस्य दानवस्य दुरात्मनः .. .. 84 ..
तत्र मर्त्यैः क्रिया सर्वाः क्रियते न मखोद्भवाः ..
यस्मात्स यज्ञपुरुषो न सुप्तो भागमश्नुते .. 85 ..
तथा यज्ञाश्च ये सर्वे क्त्वयादानादि काः शुभाः ..
ते सर्वे न क्रियंते च चूडाकरणपूर्वकाः .. 86 ..
मुक्त्वान्नप्राशनंनाम सीमंतोन्नयनं तथा ..
तस्मात्सुप्ते जगन्नाथे ताः सर्वाः स्युर्वृथा द्विजाः .. 87 ..
व्रतं वा नियमं वाथ तस्मिन्यः कुरुते नरः ..
प्रसुप्ते देवदेवेशे तत्सर्वं निष्फलं भवेत् ..88..
5.230.m:
Nearly dead, constantly oppressed by his weight, / when the day of the eleventh [tithi] in the bright half of Kārtika arrives,
Viṣṇu rises up and departs toward the Ocean of Milk; / and that Vṛka, by the curse of Sāṅkṛti, becomes lame.
And thus Hari does not leave his couch for four months, / on account of the danger from that ruler of Asuras, the evil-minded Dānava.
During that time, mortals perform no rites born of sacrifices, / because the Lord of Sacrifice, when sleeping, does not partake of his share.
Likewise, all auspicious sacrifices, beginning with the tonsure ceremony / and the giving of daughters in marriage, are not performed;
excepting the first feeding of solid food and the parting of the hair; / therefore, while the Lord of the world is asleep, all those would be in vain, O twice-born ones.
Whatever observance or restriction a man undertakes at that time, / while the God of gods is asleep, all that becomes fruitless.

5.230.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃprasupte janārdane ..
vratasthairmānavairbhāvyaṃ tasya devasya tuṣṭaye .. 89 ..
ekādaśyāṃ dine prāpte śayane bodhane hareḥ ..
yatkiṃcitkriyate karma śreṣṭhaṃ taccākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 6.231.90 ..
kiṃvātra bahunoktena kriyate yadvrataṃ naraiḥ ..
tena tuṣṭiṃ parāṃ yāti daityopari sthito hariḥ ..91..
evaṃ sa bhagavānprāha suptastatra janārdanaḥ ..
kiṃ vā tasya jvaro jāto mahatī vedanāpi ca .. 92 ..
tasminnahani pāpātmā yonnamaśnāti mānavaḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃprāpte harivāsare .. 93 ..
anyasminnapi bhoktavyaṃ na nareṇa vijānatā ..
kiṃ punaḥ śayanaṃ yatra kurute yatra bodhanam .. 94 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijo ttamāḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yasmācchete janārdanaḥ .. 95 ..
5.230.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संप्रसुप्ते जनार्दने ..
व्रतस्थैर्मानवैर्भाव्यं तस्य देवस्य तुष्टये .. 89 ..
एकादश्यां दिने प्राप्ते शयने बोधने हरेः ..
यत्किंचित्क्रियते कर्म श्रेष्ठं तच्चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 6.231.90 ..
किंवात्र बहुनोक्तेन क्रियते यद्व्रतं नरैः ..
तेन तुष्टिं परां याति दैत्योपरि स्थितो हरिः ..91..
एवं स भगवान्प्राह सुप्तस्तत्र जनार्दनः ..
किं वा तस्य ज्वरो जातो महती वेदनापि च .. 92 ..
तस्मिन्नहनि पापात्मा योन्नमश्नाति मानवः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे .. 93 ..
अन्यस्मिन्नपि भोक्तव्यं न नरेण विजानता ..
किं पुनः शयनं यत्र कुरुते यत्र बोधनम् .. 94 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजो त्तमाः ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यस्माच्छेते जनार्दनः .. 95 ..
5.230.m:
Therefore, with every effort, while Janārdana is asleep, / men must abide by observances for the satisfaction of that god.
When the eleventh day arrives for Hari’s sleeping and for his awakening, / whatever noble act is performed becomes inexhaustible.
What need is there of saying much here? By whatever observance is performed by men, / Hari, situated on top of the Daitya, attains supreme satisfaction.
Thus the blessed Janārdana declared while sleeping there: / 'Does he have a fever or even great torment,
the sinful person who eats food on that day?' / Therefore, with every effort, when Hari's day arrives,
a wise person should not eat food on that or another [Ekādaśī]; / how much more so on the day when he sleeps and when he awakens!
Sūta said: / All this has been narrated to you, O best of the twice-born, as I was asked, / about why Janārdana sleeps in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara,

5.230.s:
kṣīrābdhiṃ saṃparityajya sadā māsacatuṣṭayam ..
śrūyatāṃ ca phalaṃ yatsyāttasminnārādhite vibho .. 96 ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānyastaṃ pūjayate vibhum ..
vratasthaḥ sa naro yāti yatra devaḥ sa saṃsthitaḥ .. 97 ..
kiṃ dānairbahubhirdattaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kimupoṣitaiḥ ..
tatra yaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ suptaṃ pūjayati dhruvam .. 98 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāna ekādaśīvratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 231 ..
5.230.d:
क्षीराब्धिं संपरित्यज्य सदा मासचतुष्टयम् ..
श्रूयतां च फलं यत्स्यात्तस्मिन्नाराधिते विभो .. 96 ..
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्यस्तं पूजयते विभुम् ..
व्रतस्थः स नरो याति यत्र देवः स संस्थितः .. 97 ..
किं दानैर्बहुभिर्दत्तैः किं व्रतैः किमुपोषितैः ..
तत्र यः पुंडरीकाक्षं सुप्तं पूजयति ध्रुवम् .. 98 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलशाय्युपाख्यान एकादशीव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः . 231 ..
5.230.m:
having left the Ocean of Milk for four months always; / and hear the fruit that accrues when that Lord is propitiated:
That person who, observing vows, worships the Lord for the four rainy months, / goes to where that god abides.
What is the use of many gifts bestowed, what of vows, what of fasts? / A person who unfailingly worships the lotus-eyed one sleeping there [attains all].
Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Ekādaśī Vow in the Narrative of the One Lying on the Waters', in the Glory of Hāṭakeśvara Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.231.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
prasupte devadeveśe śaṃkhacakragadādhare ..
yaccānyadapi kartavyaṃ niyamo vratameva vā .. 1 ..
5.231.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
प्रसुप्ते देवदेवेशे शंखचक्रगदाधरे ..
यच्चान्यदपि कर्तव्यं नियमो व्रतमेव वा .. 1 ..
5.231.m: The seers said: / When the God of gods, who bears the conch, discus, and mace, is asleep, / whatever else is to be done—a restriction or a vow,

5.231.s:
homo vātha japo vātha dānaṃ vā tadvadasva naḥ ..
.. sūta uvāca ..
yaḥ kaścinniyamo viprāḥ prasupte garuḍadhvaje .. 2 ..
5.231.d:
होमो वाथ जपो वाथ दानं वा तद्वदस्व नः ..
.. सूत उवाच ..
यः कश्चिन्नियमो विप्राः प्रसुप्ते गरुडध्वजे .. 2 ..
5.231.m: or an oblation, or recitation, or a gift—tell us that! / Sūta said: / Whatever restriction there is, O brahmins, while the garuḍa-bannered [Viṣṇu] is asleep,

5.231.s:
anaṃtaphaladaḥ sa syādityuvāca pitāmahaḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kaścidbāhyo vijānatā .. 3 ..
5.231.d:
अनंतफलदः स स्यादित्युवाच पितामहः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कश्चिद्बाह्यो विजानता .. 3 ..
5.231.m: yields infinite fruit—thus the Grandfather [Brahmā] said. / Therefore, with every effort, by a discerning person, some external

5.231.s:
niyamo vā japo homaḥ svādhyāyo vratameva vā ..
kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ .. 4 ..
5.231.d:
नियमो वा जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो व्रतमेव वा ..
कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठास्तुष्ट्यर्थं चक्रपाणिनः .. 4 ..
5.231.m: restriction, recitation, oblation, Vedic study, or vow / should be performed, O best of brahmins, for the pleasure of the discus-handed [Viṣṇu].

5.231.s:
caturo vārṣikānmāsānekabhuktena yo nayet ..
vāsudevaṃ samuddiśya sa dhanī jāyate naraḥ .. 5 ..
5.231.d:
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासानेकभुक्तेन यो नयेत् ..
वासुदेवं समुद्दिश्य स धनी जायते नरः .. 5 ..
5.231.m: The man who passes the four rainy months eating only once a day / in dedication to Vāsudeva becomes wealthy.

5.231.s:
nakṣatrairbhoṃjanaṃ kuryādyaḥ prasupte janārdane ..
sa dhanī rūpasaṃpannaḥ sumatiśca prajāyate .. 6 ..
5.231.d:
नक्षत्रैर्भोंजनं कुर्याद्यः प्रसुप्ते जनार्दने ..
स धनी रूपसंपन्नः सुमतिश्च प्रजायते .. 6 ..
5.231.m: Whoever eats only when the stars [appear], while Janārdana is asleep, / is born wealthy, handsome, and endowed with good intellect.

5.231.s:
ekāṃtaropavāsaiśca yo nayeddvijasattamāḥ ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānvaikuṃṭhe sa sadā vaset .. 7 ..
5.231.d:
एकांतरोपवासैश्च यो नयेद्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्वैकुंठे स सदा वसेत् .. 7 ..
5.231.m: And whoever passes the four rainy months with fasts on alternate days, O best of the twice-born, / will dwell forever in Vaikuṇṭha.

5.231.s:
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojī syādyaḥ prasupte janārdane ..
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sa kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnuyāt.. 8 ..
5.231.d:
षष्ठान्नकालभोजी स्याद्यः प्रसुप्ते जनार्दने ..
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां स कृत्स्नं फलमाप्नुयात्.. 8 ..
5.231.m: One who eats only at the sixth mealtime while Janārdana is asleep / obtains the entire fruit of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha sacrifices.

5.231.s:
trirātropoṣito yastu caturmāsānsadā nayet ..
na sa bhūyo'pi jāyeta saṃsāre'tra kathaṃcana .. 9 ..
5.231.d:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो यस्तु चतुर्मासान्सदा नयेत् ..
न स भूयोऽपि जायेत संसारेऽत्र कथंचन .. 9 ..
5.231.m: One who regularly spends the four months fasting for three nights at a time / shall never again be born into this worldly cycle of rebirth.

5.231.s:
sāyaṃprātaḥ paro bhūtvā caturmāsānsadā nayet..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 6.232.10 ..
5.231.d:
सायंप्रातः परो भूत्वा चतुर्मासान्सदा नयेत्..
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य स फलं लभते नरः .. 6.232.10 ..
5.231.m: Devoted to eating only in evening and morning, a man who spends the four months constantly [thus] / obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

5.231.s:
ayācitaṃ caredyastu prasupte madhusūdane ..
na vicchedo bhavettasya kadācitsaha baṃdhubhiḥ .. 11 ..
5.231.d:
अयाचितं चरेद्यस्तु प्रसुप्ते मधुसूदने ..
न विच्छेदो भवेत्तस्य कदाचित्सह बंधुभिः .. 11 ..
5.231.m: One who eats only unasked-for food while Madhusūdana is asleep / never experiences separation from his kinsmen.

5.231.s:
tailābhyaṃgaṃ ca yo jahyādghṛtābhyaṃgaṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa svarge bhogabhāgbhavet .. 12 ..
5.231.d:
तैलाभ्यंगं च यो जह्याद्घृताभ्यंगं विशेषतः ..
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्स स्वर्गे भोगभाग्भवेत् .. 12 ..
5.231.m: He who gives up rubbing with oil, and especially rubbing with ghee, / during the four rainy months, enjoys pleasures in heaven.

5.231.s:
brahmacaryeṇa yo māsāṃścaturo'pi nayennaraḥ ..
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sa svarge svecchayā vaset .. 13 ..
5.231.d:
ब्रह्मचर्येण यो मासांश्चतुरोऽपि नयेन्नरः ..
विमानवरमारूढः स स्वर्गे स्वेच्छया वसेत् .. 13 ..
5.231.m: A man who spends all four months in celibacy, / mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, dwells in heaven as he pleases.

5.231.s:
yaḥ snānaṃ caturo māsānkurute tailavarjitam ..
madhumāṃsaparityāgī sa bhavenmuktibhāksadā .. 14 ..
5.231.d:
यः स्नानं चतुरो मासान्कुरुते तैलवर्जितम् ..
मधुमांसपरित्यागी स भवेन्मुक्तिभाक्सदा .. 14 ..
5.231.m: He who takes his ritual ablution for four months without oil, / abandoning honey and meat, always attains liberation.

5.231.s:
varjayecchrāvaṇe śākaṃ dadhi bhādrapade ca yaḥ ..
kṣīramāśvayuje māsi kārtike ca sadāmiṣam.. 18 ..
na sa pāpena lipyeta saṃvatsarakṛte punaḥ ..
etatprāha dvijaśreṣṭhā manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo vacaḥ .. 16 ..
śāke saṃkramate brahmā śrāvaṇe māsi saṃsthite ..
dadhni bhādrapade viṣṇuḥ kṣīre cāśvayuje haraḥ .. 17 ..
trayo'pi kārtike māsi saṃkramaṃti tathā''miṣe ..
tasmādetānsa deveṣu sarvathā parivarjayet .. 18 ..
5.231.d:
वर्जयेच्छ्रावणे शाकं दधि भाद्रपदे च यः ..
क्षीरमाश्वयुजे मासि कार्तिके च सदामिषम्.. 18 ..
न स पापेन लिप्येत संवत्सरकृते पुनः ..
एतत्प्राह द्विजश्रेष्ठा मनुः स्वायंभुवो वचः .. 16 ..
शाके संक्रमते ब्रह्मा श्रावणे मासि संस्थिते ..
दध्नि भाद्रपदे विष्णुः क्षीरे चाश्वयुजे हरः .. 17 ..
त्रयोऽपि कार्तिके मासि संक्रमंति तथा'ऽमिषे ..
तस्मादेतान्स देवेषु सर्वथा परिवर्जयेत् .. 18 ..
5.231.m:
He who avoids leafy vegetables in Śrāvaṇa, curds in Bhādrapada, / milk in the month of Āśvayuja, and always meat in Kārtika,
is not tainted again by sin committed throughout the year; / O best of brahmins, this is the statement spoken by Manu Svāyambhuva.
Brahmā enters leafy vegetables when the month of Śrāvaṇa arrives; / Viṣṇu enters curds in Bhādrapada, and Hara milk in Āśvayuja.
All three likewise enter meat in the month of Kārtika; / therefore one must completely avoid these while the gods are in them.

5.231.s:
yaḥ kāṃsyaṃ varjayenmartyaḥ prasupte garuḍadhvaje ..
sa phalaṃ prāpnuyātkṛtsnaṃ vājapeyātirātrayoḥ .. 19 ..
5.231.d:
यः कांस्यं वर्जयेन्मर्त्यः प्रसुप्ते गरुडध्वजे ..
स फलं प्राप्नुयात्कृत्स्नं वाजपेयातिरात्रयोः .. 19 ..
5.231.m: The mortal who avoids bronze while the Garuda-bannered [Viṣṇu] is asleep / obtains the entire fruit of the Vājapeya and Atirātra [sacrifices].

5.231.s:
akṣāralavaṇāśī ca yo bhavedbrāhmaṇottamaḥ ..
tasyāpi sakalāḥ pūrtāḥ prabhavaṃti sadā tataḥ .. 6.232.20 ..
5.231.d:
अक्षारलवणाशी च यो भवेद्ब्राह्मणोत्तमः ..
तस्यापि सकलाः पूर्ताः प्रभवंति सदा ततः .. 6.232.20 ..
5.231.m: And whatever best of brahmins eats food free from alkaline salt, / from that all public works of his likewise continuously bear fruit.

5.231.s:
yo homaṃ caturo māsānprakaroti tilākṣataiḥ ..
svāhāṃtairvaiṣṇavairmaṃtrairna sa rogeṇa yujyate .. 21 ..
5.231.d:
यो होमं चतुरो मासान्प्रकरोति तिलाक्षतैः ..
स्वाहांतैर्वैष्णवैर्मंत्रैर्न स रोगेण युज्यते .. 21 ..
5.231.m: He who performs oblations for four months with sesame and unbroken grains, / using mantras dedicated to Viṣṇu ending with 'svāhā', is never afflicted with disease.

5.231.s:
yo japetpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ snātvā viṣṇoḥ sthito'grataḥ ..
matistasya vivardheta śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ .. 22 ..
5.231.d:
यो जपेत्पौरुषं सूक्तं स्नात्वा विष्णोः स्थितोऽग्रतः ..
मतिस्तस्य विवर्धेत शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् .. 22 ..
5.231.m: He who, having bathed, recites the Puruṣasūkta standing before Viṣṇu, / his intelligence increases just like the moon during the bright fortnight.

5.231.s:
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvatphalahastaḥ pradakṣiṇām ..
karoti viṣṇormaunena na sa pāpena lipyate .. 23 ..
5.231.d:
शतमष्टोत्तरं यावत्फलहस्तः प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
करोति विष्णोर्मौनेन न स पापेन लिप्यते .. 23 ..
5.231.m: As long as one makes one hundred and eight circumambulations of Viṣṇu / with fruit in hand and in silence, he is not tainted by sin.

5.231.s:
miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yo dadāti svaśaktitaḥ ..
viśeṣātkārtike māsi so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet.. 24 ..
5.231.d:
मिष्टान्नं ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां यो ददाति स्वशक्तितः ..
विशेषात्कार्तिके मासि सोऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्.. 24 ..
5.231.m: He who gives sweet food to the lords of brahmins according to his ability, / especially in the month of Kārtika, obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma [sacrifice].

5.231.s:
yaḥ svādhyāyaṃ caturvedairviṣṇorāyatane caret ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa vidvānsarvadā bhavet .. 25 ..
5.231.d:
यः स्वाध्यायं चतुर्वेदैर्विष्णोरायतने चरेत् ..
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्स विद्वान्सर्वदा भवेत् .. 25 ..
5.231.m: He who performs personal recitation of the four Vedas in an abode of Viṣṇu / during the four rainy months, will forever be a learned scholar.

5.231.s:
nṛtyagītādikaṃ yaśca kuryādviṣṇoḥ sadā gṛhe ..
apsaraso'sya kurvaṃti purataḥ svargatasya ca .. 26 ..
5.231.d:
नृत्यगीतादिकं यश्च कुर्याद्विष्णोः सदा गृहे ..
अप्सरसोऽस्य कुर्वंति पुरतः स्वर्गतस्य च .. 26 ..
5.231.m: And he who constantly performs dance, song, and the like in the house of Viṣṇu— / apsarases perform before him when he has gone to heaven.

5.231.s:
yastu rātridinaṃ vipro nṛtyagītādikaṃ dadet ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa gandharvatvamāpnuyāt .. 27 ..
5.231.d:
यस्तु रात्रिदिनं विप्रो नृत्यगीतादिकं ददेत् ..
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्स गन्धर्वत्वमाप्नुयात् .. 27 ..
5.231.m: A brahmin who offers dance, song, and the like day and night / for the four rainy months attains the status of a gandharva.

5.231.s:
ete ca niyamāḥ sarve śakyaṃte yadi bho dvijāḥ ..
kartuṃ ca caturo māsānekasminvā'pi kārttike .. 28 ..
5.231.d:
एते च नियमाः सर्वे शक्यंते यदि भो द्विजाः ..
कर्तुं च चतुरो मासानेकस्मिन्वाऽपि कार्त्तिके .. 28 ..
5.231.m: O brahmins, if all these observances can be performed / for four months, or even in the single month of Kārtika,

5.231.s:
tathāpi caiva kartavyaṃ lokadvayamabhīpsatā ..
kārtikyāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā vaiṣṇavaiḥ puruṣairiha .. 29 ..
5.231.d:
तथापि चैव कर्तव्यं लोकद्वयमभीप्सता ..
कार्तिक्यां ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा वैष्णवैः पुरुषैरिह .. 29 ..
5.231.m: even so it must certainly be done on the full moon of Kārtika / by Vaiṣṇava men here who desire both worlds, O best of brahmins.

5.231.s:
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ kṣuraṃ kṣaudraṃ punarbhojanamaithune ..
kārtike varjayedyastu ya etānbrāhmaṇaḥ sadā .. 6.232.30 ..
5.231.d:
कांस्यं मांसं क्षुरं क्षौद्रं पुनर्भोजनमैथुने ..
कार्तिके वर्जयेद्यस्तु य एतान्ब्राह्मणः सदा .. 6.232.30 ..
5.231.m: Bronze, meat, a razor, honey, eating a second time, and sexual intercourse— / whatever brahmin constantly avoids these in Kārtika,

5.231.s: pūrvoktānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niyamānāṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 31 ..
5.231.d: पूर्वोक्तानां तु सर्वेषां नियमानां फलं लभेत् .. 31 ..
5.231.m: obtains the fruit of all the previously mentioned observances.

5.231.s:
atha yaḥ kārtike māsi prāsādasyopari dvijāḥ ..
jalaśāyyākhyadevasya kalaśe dīpakaṃ dadet..
pūrvoktaniyamānāṃ ca sa ṣaṇṇāṃ phalabhāgbhavet .. 32 ..
5.231.d:
अथ यः कार्तिके मासि प्रासादस्योपरि द्विजाः ..
जलशाय्याख्यदेवस्य कलशे दीपकं ददेत्..
पूर्वोक्तनियमानां च स षण्णां फलभाग्भवेत् .. 32 ..
5.231.m: Moreover, O brahmins, he who in the month of Kārtika places a lamp / on the pot atop the temple of the god called Jalaśāyin, / partakes of the fruit of the six previously mentioned observances.

5.231.s:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃci tsuprāpyaṃ caiva yadbhavet ..
niyamastasya kartavyaścāturmāsye śubhārthibhiḥ .. 33 ..
5.231.d:
यद्यदिष्टतमं किंचि त्सुप्राप्यं चैव यद्भवेत् ..
नियमस्तस्य कर्तव्यश्चातुर्मास्ये शुभार्थिभिः .. 33 ..
5.231.m: Whatever is most beloved and readily attainable, / an observance of [giving up] that should be made during the Cāturmāsya by those desiring auspiciousness.

5.231.s:
niyame ca kṛte dadyādbrāhmaṇāya tadeva hi ..
niyamastu kṛto yasya svaśaktyā syātphalaṃ tataḥ .. 34 ..
5.231.d:
नियमे च कृते दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय तदेव हि ..
नियमस्तु कृतो यस्य स्वशक्त्या स्यात्फलं ततः .. 34 ..
5.231.m: And when the observance is completed, he should indeed give that very thing to a brahmin; / the fruit that arises comes according to his capacity from that for which the observance was made.

5.231.s:
yo vinā niyamaṃ martyo vrataṃ vā jāpyameva vā ..
caturmāsānnayenmūrkho jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ..35..
5.231.d:
यो विना नियमं मर्त्यो व्रतं वा जाप्यमेव वा ..
चतुर्मासान्नयेन्मूर्खो जीवन्नपि मृतो हि सः ..35..
5.231.m: The foolish mortal who passes the four months without an observance, / a vow, or silent recitation, is truly dead even while living.

5.231.s:
yathā kāka yavāḥ proktā yathāraṇyāstilodbhavāḥ ..
nāmamātraprasiddhāśca tathā te mānavā bhuvi .. 36 ..
5.231.d:
यथा काक यवाः प्रोक्ता यथारण्यास्तिलोद्भवाः ..
नाममात्रप्रसिद्धाश्च तथा ते मानवा भुवि .. 36 ..
5.231.m: Just as wild barley and wild sesame / are celebrated in name only, so too are those men on earth.

5.231.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryo yatnena kārtike ..
eko'pi niyamaḥ kaścitsusūkṣmo'pi dvijottamāḥ .. 37 ..
5.231.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कार्यो यत्नेन कार्तिके ..
एकोऽपि नियमः कश्चित्सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 37 ..
5.231.m: Therefore, by every effort, with exertion in Kārtika / even a single observance, however slight, must be undertaken, O best of brahmins.

5.231.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ cāturmāsīsamudbhavam..
vratānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ vistarāddvijāḥ ..38..
5.231.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं चातुर्मासीसमुद्भवम्..
व्रतानां नियमानां च माहात्म्यं विस्तराद्द्विजाः ..38..
5.231.m: All this originating from Cāturmāsya has been told to you in detail, / the greatness of the vows and observances, O brahmins.

5.231.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvāpi samāhitaḥ ..
cāturmāsī kṛtātpāpātso'pi muktimavāpnuyāt .. 39 ..
5.231.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं पठेद्वापि समाहितः ..
चातुर्मासी कृतात्पापात्सोऽपि मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 39 ..
5.231.m: And he who constantly hears this or recites it with a collected mind, / attains liberation from the sin committed during Cāturmāsya.

5.231.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāne cāturmāsyavrataniyamavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaradviśatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..232 ... ..
5.231.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलशाय्युपाख्याने चातुर्मास्यव्रतनियमवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशतमोऽध्यायः ..232 ... ..
5.231.m: Thus ends the two hundred thirty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Vows and Observances of Cāturmāsya' in the narrative of Jalaśāyin, in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.232.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sūta sūta mahābhāga śrotumicchāmahe vayam ..
cāturmāsyavratānāṃ hi tvatto māhātmyavistaram ..1..
5.232.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
सूत सूत महाभाग श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् ..
चातुर्मास्यव्रतानां हि त्वत्तो माहात्म्यविस्तरम् ..1..
5.232.m:
The seers said:
O Sūta, O fortunate Sūta, we wish to hear / from you the detailed greatness of the Cāturmāsya vows.

5.232.s:
tadasmākaṃ mahābhāga kṛpāṃ kṛtvā'dhunā vada ..
tvadvaco'mṛtapānena bhūyaḥ śraddhābhivardhate ..2..
5.232.d:
तदस्माकं महाभाग कृपां कृत्वाऽधुना वद ..
त्वद्वचोऽमृतपानेन भूयः श्रद्धाभिवर्धते ..2..
5.232.m: Therefore, O fortunate one, having shown compassion, speak to us now; / by drinking the nectar of your words, [our] faith increases further.

5.232.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve cāturmāsyavratodbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ vistareṇaiva kathayiṣyāmi vo'grataḥ ..3..
5.232.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शृणुध्वं मुनयः सर्वे चातुर्मास्यव्रतोद्भवम् ..
माहात्म्यं विस्तरेणैव कथयिष्यामि वोऽग्रतः ..3..
5.232.m:
Sūta said:
Listen, all you sages; I shall recount before you in full detail / the greatness arising from the vows of Cāturmāsya.

5.232.s:
purā brahmamukhācchrutvā nānāvratavidhānakam..
nāradaḥ paripapraccha bhūyo brahmāṇamādarāt ..4..
5.232.d:
पुरा ब्रह्ममुखाच्छ्रुत्वा नानाव्रतविधानकम्..
नारदः परिपप्रच्छ भूयो ब्रह्माणमादरात् ..4..
5.232.m: Formerly, having heard the rules of various vows from the mouth of Brahmā, / Nārada respectfully questioned Brahmā again.

5.232.s:
..nārada uvāca .. ..
devadeva mahābhāga vratāni subahūnyapi ..
śrutāni tvanmukhādbrahmanna tṛptimadhigacchati .. 5 ..
5.232.d:
..नारद उवाच .. ..
देवदेव महाभाग व्रतानि सुबहून्यपि ..
श्रुतानि त्वन्मुखाद्ब्रह्मन्न तृप्तिमधिगच्छति .. 5 ..
5.232.m:
Nārada said:
O God of gods, O highly fortunate one, though very many vows / have been heard from your mouth, O Brahmā, contentment is not reached.

5.232.s:
adhunā śrotumicchāmi cāturmāsyavrataṃ śubham.. 6 . ..
.. brahmovāca .. ..
śṛṇu devamune mattaścāturmāsyavrataṃ śubham ..
yacchrutvā bhārate khaṃḍe nṛṇāṃ muktirna durlabhā .. 7 ..
5.232.d:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि चातुर्मास्यव्रतं शुभम्.. 6 . ..
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
शृणु देवमुने मत्तश्चातुर्मास्यव्रतं शुभम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा भारते खंडे नृणां मुक्तिर्न दुर्लभा .. 7 ..
5.232.m:
Now I wish to hear the auspicious Cāturmāsya vow.
Brahmā said:
Listen from me, O divine sage, to the auspicious Cāturmāsya vow, / hearing which, liberation is not hard to obtain for men in the land of Bhārata.

5.232.s:
muktiprado'yaṃ bhagavānsaṃsārottārakāraṇam ..
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 8 ..
5.232.d:
मुक्तिप्रदोऽयं भगवान्संसारोत्तारकारणम् ..
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 8 ..
5.232.m: This Blessed Lord gives liberation, the means of crossing over worldly existence, / by the mere remembrance of whom one is freed from all sins.

5.232.s:
mānuṣye durlabhaṃ loke tatrā'pi ca kulīnatā ..
tatrāpi sadayatvaṃ ca tatra satsaṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ .. 9 ..
5.232.d:
मानुष्ये दुर्लभं लोके तत्राऽपि च कुलीनता ..
तत्रापि सदयत्वं च तत्र सत्संगमः शुभः .. 9 ..
5.232.m: Human birth is hard to attain in this world, and even there noble birth; / there too, compassion, and there auspicious association with the virtuous.

5.232.s:
satsaṃgamo na yatrāsti viṣṇubhaktirvratāni ca ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa viṣṇuvratakaraḥ śubhaḥ .. 6.233.10 ..
5.232.d:
सत्संगमो न यत्रास्ति विष्णुभक्तिर्व्रतानि च ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण विष्णुव्रतकरः शुभः .. 6.233.10 ..
5.232.m: Where there is no association with the virtuous, devotion to Viṣṇu and vows [are hard to find]; / especially during Cāturmāsya, one who performs vows to Viṣṇu is auspicious.

5.232.s:
cāturmāsye'vratī yastu tasya puṇyaṃ nirarthakam ..
sarvatīrthāni dānāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca .. 11 ..
5.232.d:
चातुर्मास्येऽव्रती यस्तु तस्य पुण्यं निरर्थकम् ..
सर्वतीर्थानि दानानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च .. 11 ..
5.232.m: He who is without vows during Cāturmāsya, his merit is useless; / all sacred fords, gifts, and holy temples

5.232.s:
viṣṇumāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti cāturmāsye samāgate ..
supuṣṭenāpi dehena jīvitaṃ tasya śobhanam .. 12 ..
5.232.d:
विष्णुमाश्रित्य तिष्ठंति चातुर्मास्ये समागते ..
सुपुष्टेनापि देहेन जीवितं तस्य शोभनम् .. 12 ..
5.232.m: abide depending upon Viṣṇu when Cāturmāsya has arrived; / even with a well-nourished body, his life is [only then truly] splendid.

5.232.s:
cāturmāsye samāyāte hariṃ yaḥ praṇamedbudhaḥ ..
kṛtārthāstasya vibudhā yāvajjīvaṃ varapradāḥ .. 13 ..
5.232.d:
चातुर्मास्ये समायाते हरिं यः प्रणमेद्बुधः ..
कृतार्थास्तस्य विबुधा यावज्जीवं वरप्रदाः .. 13 ..
5.232.m:
When Cāturmāsya arrives, the wise person who bows before Hari
finds that the gods are fulfilled [in him] and grant boons as long as he lives. (13)

5.232.s:
saṃprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma cāturmāsyaparāṅmukhaḥ ..
tasya pāpaśatānyāhurdehasthāni na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
5.232.d:
संप्राप्य मानुषं जन्म चातुर्मास्यपराङ्मुखः ..
तस्य पापशतान्याहुर्देहस्थानि न संशयः .. 14 ..
5.232.m:
Having obtained a human birth, one who turns his back on Cāturmāsya—
they say hundreds of sins reside in his body; of this there is no doubt. (14)

5.232.s:
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ loke haribhaktiśca durlabhā ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa supte deve janārdane .. 15 ..
5.232.d:
मानुष्यं दुर्लभं लोके हरिभक्तिश्च दुर्लभा ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण सुप्ते देवे जनार्दने .. 15 ..
5.232.m:
Human birth is hard to attain in this world, and devotion to Hari is hard to attain,
especially during Cāturmāsya, while the god Janārdana is asleep. (15)

5.232.s:
cāturmāsye naraḥ snānaṃ prātareva samācaret ..
sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpya devavaddivi modate .. 16 ..
5.232.d:
चातुर्मास्ये नरः स्नानं प्रातरेव समाचरेत् ..
सर्वक्रतुफलं प्राप्य देववद्दिवि मोदते .. 16 ..
5.232.m:
During Cāturmāsya, a person should perform ritual ablution at dawn itself;
obtaining the fruit of all sacrifices, he rejoices in heaven like a god. (16)

5.232.s:
cāturmāsye tu yaḥ snānaṃ kuryātsiddhimavāpnuyāt ..
tathā nirjharaṇe snāti taḍāge kūpikāsu ca .. 17 ..
5.232.d:
चातुर्मास्ये तु यः स्नानं कुर्यात्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ..
तथा निर्झरणे स्नाति तडागे कूपिकासु च .. 17 ..
5.232.m:
One who performs ritual ablution during Cāturmāsya attains perfection;
likewise, if he bathes in a waterfall, a pond, or in small wells, (17)

5.232.s:
tasya pāpasahasrāṇi vilayaṃ yāṃti tatkṣaṇāt ..
puṣkare ca prayāge vā yatra kvāpi mahājale ..
cāturmāsyeṣu yaḥ snāti puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate .. 18 ..
5.232.d:
तस्य पापसहस्राणि विलयं यांति तत्क्षणात् ..
पुष्करे च प्रयागे वा यत्र क्वापि महाजले ..
चातुर्मास्येषु यः स्नाति पुण्यसंख्या न विद्यते .. 18 ..
5.232.m:
his thousands of sins vanish in an instant.
Whether at Puṣkara, at Prayāga, or in any great body of water,
the merit of one who bathes during the Cāturmāsya months is beyond reckoning. (18)

5.232.s:
revāyāṃ bhāskarakṣetre prācyāṃ sāgarasaṃgame ..
ekāhamapi yaḥ snātaścāturmāsye na doṣabhāk .. 19 ..
5.232.d:
रेवायां भास्करक्षेत्रे प्राच्यां सागरसंगमे ..
एकाहमपि यः स्नातश्चातुर्मास्ये न दोषभाक् .. 19 ..
5.232.m:
In the Revā, in the Bhāskarakṣetra, or at the eastern confluence with the ocean,
one who has bathed even for a single day during Cāturmāsya incurs no fault. (19)

5.232.s:
dinatrayaṃ ca yaḥ snāti narmadāyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
supte deve jagannāthe pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā .. 6.233.20 ..
5.232.d:
दिनत्रयं च यः स्नाति नर्मदायां समाहितः ..
सुप्ते देवे जगन्नाथे पापं याति सहस्रधा .. 6.233.20 ..
5.232.m:
And one who, with composed mind, bathes for three days in the Narmadā
while the god, the Lord of the Universe, is asleep, his sin disperses a thousandfold. (20)

5.232.s:
pakṣamekaṃ tu yaḥ snāti godāvaryāṃ dinodaye ..
sa bhittvā karmajaṃ dehaṃ yāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām .. 21 ..
5.232.d:
पक्षमेकं तु यः स्नाति गोदावर्यां दिनोदये ..
स भित्त्वा कर्मजं देहं याति विष्णोः सलोकताम् .. 21 ..
5.232.m:
One who bathes for a single fortnight in the Godāvarī at daybreak,
breaking through the body born of karma, attains Viṣṇu's realm. (21)

5.232.s:
tilodakena yaḥ snāti tathā caivāmalodakaiḥ ..
bilvapatrodakaiścaiva cāturmāsye na doṣabhāk .. 22 ..
5.232.d:
तिलोदकेन यः स्नाति तथा चैवामलोदकैः ..
बिल्वपत्रोदकैश्चैव चातुर्मास्ये न दोषभाक् .. 22 ..
5.232.m:
One who bathes with sesame-water, or with clear water,
or with water infused with bilva leaves during Cāturmāsya, incurs no fault. (22)

5.232.s:
gaṃgāṃ smarati yo nityamudapātrasamīpataḥ ..
tadgāṃgeyaṃ jalaṃ jātaṃ tena snānaṃ samācaret .. 23 ..
5.232.d:
गंगां स्मरति यो नित्यमुदपात्रसमीपतः ..
तद्गांगेयं जलं जातं तेन स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 23 ..
5.232.m:
Whoever constantly remembers the Gaṅgā near a water jar,
that water turns into Gaṅgā water; with that he should perform his ritual ablution. (23)

5.232.s:
gaṃgā'pi devadevasya caraṇāṃguṣṭhavāhinī ..
pāpaghnī sā sadā proktā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 24 ..
5.232.d:
गंगाऽपि देवदेवस्य चरणांगुष्ठवाहिनी ..
पापघ्नी सा सदा प्रोक्ता चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः .. 24 ..
5.232.m:
Even the Gaṅgā, flowing from the big toe of the God of Gods,
is declared ever destructive of sin, especially during Cāturmāsya. (24)

5.232.s:
yataḥ pāpasahasrāṇi viṣṇurdahati saṃsmṛtaḥ ..
tasmātpādodakaṃ śīrṣe cāturmāsye dhṛtaṃ śivam ..25..
5.232.d:
यतः पापसहस्राणि विष्णुर्दहति संस्मृतः ..
तस्मात्पादोदकं शीर्षे चातुर्मास्ये धृतं शिवम् ..25..
5.232.m:
Because Viṣṇu, when remembered, burns away thousands of sins,
therefore his foot-wash water borne upon the head during Cāturmāsya brings auspiciousness. (25)

5.232.s:
cāturmāsye jalagato devo nārāyaṇo bhavet ..
sarvatīrthādhikaṃ snānaṃ viṣṇutejoṃśasaṃgatam..26..
5.232.d:
चातुर्मास्ये जलगतो देवो नारायणो भवेत् ..
सर्वतीर्थाधिकं स्नानं विष्णुतेजोंशसंगतम्..26..
5.232.m:
During Cāturmāsya, the god Nārāyaṇa enters the water;
ritual ablution imbued with a portion of Viṣṇu's fiery energy surpasses all sacred fords. (26)

5.232.s:
snānaṃ daśavidhaṃ kāryaṃ viṣṇunāma mahāphalam ..
supte deve viśeṣeṇa naro devatvamāpnuyāt ..27..
5.232.d:
स्नानं दशविधं कार्यं विष्णुनाम महाफलम् ..
सुप्ते देवे विशेषेण नरो देवत्वमाप्नुयात् ..27..
5.232.m:
The ten kinds of ritual ablution should be performed; the name of Viṣṇu brings great fruit;
especially while the god is asleep, a man attains godhood. (27)

5.232.s:
