पाद्यं तृतीयया कार्यं गंगां तत्र स्मरेद्बुधः .. 17 ..
5.238.m: Through mental contemplations joined with devotion, that becomes completely fulfilled. / Water for the feet should be offered with the third; a wise man should there remember the Gaṅgā.

5.238.s:
arghyaḥ kāryastato viṣṇoḥ saridbhiḥ saptasāgaraiḥ ..
punarācamanaṃ kāryamamṛtena jagatpateḥ ..18..
5.238.d:
अर्घ्यः कार्यस्ततो विष्णोः सरिद्भिः सप्तसागरैः ..
पुनराचमनं कार्यममृतेन जगत्पतेः ..18..
5.238.m: Then water for respect should be offered to Viṣṇu with the rivers and the seven oceans; / sipping-water should again be offered to the Lord of the world with nectar.

5.238.s:
tribhirācamanaiḥ śuddhirbrāhmaṇasya nigadyate ..
adbhistu prakṛtisthābhirhīnābhiḥ phenabudbudaiḥ ..19..
5.238.d:
त्रिभिराचमनैः शुद्धिर्ब्राह्मणस्य निगद्यते ..
अद्भिस्तु प्रकृतिस्थाभिर्हीनाभिः फेनबुद्बुदैः ..19..
5.238.m: Purification for a brahmin is said to be effected by three sippings, / with water that is in its natural state, free of foam and bubbles,

5.238.s:
hṛtkaṇṭha tālugābhiśca yathāvarṇaṃ dvijātayaḥ ..
śudhyeranstrī ca śūdraśca sakṛtspṛṣṭābhiraṃtataḥ ..6.239.20...
5.238.d:
हृत्कण्ठ तालुगाभिश्च यथावर्णं द्विजातयः ..
शुध्येरन्स्त्री च शूद्रश्च सकृत्स्पृष्टाभिरंततः ..6.239.20...
5.238.m: reaching the heart, throat, and palate according to their caste for the twice-born. / A woman and a śūdra are purified by touching [the water] once, at the tip.

5.238.s:
pañcamyā''camanaṃ kāryaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā ..
bhaktigrāhyo hṛṣīkeśo bhaktyā''tmānaṃ prayacchati .. 21 ..
5.238.d:
पञ्चम्या'ऽचमनं कार्यं भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा ..
भक्तिग्राह्यो हृषीकेशो भक्त्या'ऽत्मानं प्रयच्छति .. 21 ..
5.238.m: Sipping-water should be offered with the fifth [verse] with a heart full of devotion. / Hṛṣīkeśa is won by devotion; through devotion He gives Himself.

5.238.s:
tataḥ suvāsitaistoyaiḥ sarvoṣadhisamanvitaiḥ ..
śeṣodakaiḥ svarṇaghaṭaiḥ snānaṃ devasya kārayet .. 22 ..
5.238.d:
ततः सुवासितैस्तोयैः सर्वोषधिसमन्वितैः ..
शेषोदकैः स्वर्णघटैः स्नानं देवस्य कारयेत् .. 22 ..
5.238.m: Then, with fragrant waters mixed with all medicinal herbs, / [and] with the remaining waters in golden pitchers, he should perform the bath of the god,

5.238.s:
tīrthodakaiḥ śraddhayā ca manasā samupāhṛtaiḥ ..
aśraddhayā ratnarāśiḥ pradatto niṣphalo bhavet .. 23 ..
5.238.d:
तीर्थोदकैः श्रद्धया च मनसा समुपाहृतैः ..
अश्रद्धया रत्नराशिः प्रदत्तो निष्फलो भवेत् .. 23 ..
5.238.m: with waters from sacred fords brought along in mind with faith. / A heap of jewels presented without faith becomes fruitless;

5.238.s:
vāryapi śraddhayā dattamanaṃtatvāya kalpate ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa śraddhayā pūyate naraḥ .. 24 ..
5.238.d:
वार्यपि श्रद्धया दत्तमनंतत्वाय कल्पते ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण श्रद्धया पूयते नरः .. 24 ..
5.238.m: even water given with faith leads to infinity. / Especially during the Cāturmāsya, a person is purified through faith.

5.238.s:
ṣaṣṭhyā snānaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ punarācamanaṃ bhavet ..
dadyācca vāsasī svarṇasahite bhaktiśaktitaḥ .. 25 ..
5.238.d:
षष्ठ्या स्नानं ततः कार्यं पुनराचमनं भवेत् ..
दद्याच्च वाससी स्वर्णसहिते भक्तिशक्तितः .. 25 ..
5.238.m: The bath should then be performed with the sixth [verse]; there should be sipping-water again. / And he should give two garments accompanied with gold, according to his devotion and ability.

5.238.s:
ācchāditaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vastreṇācchādito hariḥ ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa vastradānaṃ mahāphalam .. 26 ..
5.238.d:
आच्छादितं जगत्सर्वं वस्त्रेणाच्छादितो हरिः ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण वस्त्रदानं महाफलम् .. 26 ..
5.238.m: The entire universe is covered [by Him], and Hari is covered by a garment. / Especially during the Cāturmāsya, the gift of a garment bears great fruit.

5.238.s:
punarācamanaṃ deyaṃ yataye viṣṇurūpiṇe ..
vastradānaṃ ca saptamyā kāryaṃ viṣṇormunīśvara .. 27 ..
5.238.d:
पुनराचमनं देयं यतये विष्णुरूपिणे ..
वस्त्रदानं च सप्तम्या कार्यं विष्णोर्मुनीश्वर .. 27 ..
5.238.m: Sipping-water should again be offered to the ascetic in the form of Viṣṇu. / And the presentation of the garment is to be performed with the seventh [verse] for Viṣṇu, O lord of sages.

5.238.s:
yajñopavītamaṣṭamyā taccādhyātmatayā śṛṇu ..
sūryakoṭisamasparśaṃ tejasā bhāsvaraṃ tathā .. 28 ..
5.238.d:
यज्ञोपवीतमष्टम्या तच्चाध्यात्मतया शृणु ..
सूर्यकोटिसमस्पर्शं तेजसा भास्वरं तथा .. 28 ..
5.238.m: The sacred thread [is offered] with the eighth; hear that in its esoteric sense: / it touches like ten million suns and is likewise blazing with splendour.

5.238.s:
krodhābhibhūte vipre tu taḍitkoṭisabhaprabham..
sūryenduvahnisaṃyogādguṇatrayasamanvitam .. 29 ..
5.238.d:
क्रोधाभिभूते विप्रे तु तडित्कोटिसभप्रभम्..
सूर्येन्दुवह्निसंयोगाद्गुणत्रयसमन्वितम् .. 29 ..
5.238.m: When a brahmin is overcome by anger, it shines with the radiance of ten million lightnings; / through the union of the sun, moon, and fire, it is endowed with the three qualities.

5.238.s:
trayīmayaṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrarūpaṃ triviṣṭapam ..
yasya prabhāvādvipreṃdra mānavo dvija ucyate .. 6.239.30 ..
5.238.d:
त्रयीमयं ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्ररूपं त्रिविष्टपम् ..
यस्य प्रभावाद्विप्रेंद्र मानवो द्विज उच्यते .. 6.239.30 ..
5.238.m: Consisting of the three Vedas, it embodies Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, and is the three worlds. / By its power, O chief of the twice-born, a human being is called twice-born.

5.238.s:
janmanā jāyate śūdraḥ saṃskārāddvija ucyate ..
śāpānugrahasāmarthyaṃ tathā krodhaḥ prasannatā .. 31 ..
5.238.d:
जन्मना जायते शूद्रः संस्काराद्द्विज उच्यते ..
शापानुग्रहसामर्थ्यं तथा क्रोधः प्रसन्नता .. 31 ..
5.238.m: By birth one is born a śūdra; through the rite of passage one is called twice-born. / The capacity to curse and grant grace, as well as anger and benevolence,

5.238.s:
trailokyapravaratvaṃ ca brāhmaṇādeva jāyate ..
na brāhmaṇasamo bandhurna brāhmaṇasamā gatiḥ .. 32 ..
5.238.d:
त्रैलोक्यप्रवरत्वं च ब्राह्मणादेव जायते ..
न ब्राह्मणसमो बन्धुर्न ब्राह्मणसमा गतिः .. 32 ..
5.238.m: and pre-eminence in the three worlds arises only from the brahmin. / There is no relative equal to a brahmin, there is no refuge equal to a brahmin;

5.238.s:
na brāhmaṇasamaḥ kaścittrailokye sacarācare ..
dattopavīte brahmaṇye supte deve janārdane .. .. 33 ..
5.238.d:
न ब्राह्मणसमः कश्चित्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
दत्तोपवीते ब्रह्मण्ये सुप्ते देवे जनार्दने .. .. 33 ..
5.238.m: there is none equal to a brahmin in the three worlds, moving and unmoving. / When the sacred thread has been offered to the friend of brahmins, while the god Janārdana is asleep,

5.238.s:
sarvajagadbrahmamayaṃ saṃjātaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
navamyā ca sulepaśca kartavyo yajñamūrtaye .. 34 ..
5.238.d:
सर्वजगद्ब्रह्ममयं संजातं नात्र संशयः ..
नवम्या च सुलेपश्च कर्तव्यो यज्ञमूर्तये .. 34 ..
5.238.m: the entire world becomes filled with Brahman, of this there is no doubt. / And with the ninth, anointment should be made for the embodiment of sacrifice.

5.238.s:
suyakṣakardamairlipto viṣṇuryena jagadguruḥ ..
tenā pyāyitametaddhi vāsitaṃ yaśasā jagat .. 35 ..
5.238.d:
सुयक्षकर्दमैर्लिप्तो विष्णुर्येन जगद्गुरुः ..
तेना प्यायितमेतद्धि वासितं यशसा जगत् .. 35 ..
5.238.m: By him by whom Viṣṇu, the teacher of the world, is anointed with fine yakṣa-paste, / by him indeed this world is gratified and perfumed with fame.

5.238.s:
tejasā bhāskaro loke devatvaṃ prāpya mānavaḥ ..
brahmalokādike loke modate caṃdanapradaḥ .. 36 ..
5.238.d:
तेजसा भास्करो लोके देवत्वं प्राप्य मानवः ..
ब्रह्मलोकादिके लोके मोदते चंदनप्रदः .. 36 ..
5.238.m: Attaining divinity as the sun in the world through his splendour, / the giver of sandalwood paste rejoices in the world of Brahmā and other realms.

5.238.s:
caṃdanālepasubhagaṃ viṣṇuṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
na te yamapuraṃ yāṃti cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 37 ..
5.238.d:
चंदनालेपसुभगं विष्णुं पश्यंति मानवाः ..
न ते यमपुरं यांति चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः .. 37 ..
5.238.m: Men who behold Viṣṇu delightful with sandalwood anointment / do not go to the city of Yama, especially during the Cāturmāsya.

5.238.s:
daśamyā puṣpapūjā ca bhaktipūjā tathaiva ca ..
puṣpe caiva sadā lakṣmīrvasatyeva niraṃtaram .. 38 1.
lakṣmyāḥ sarvatra gāminyā doṣo naiva prajāyate ..
yathā sarvamayo viṣṇurna doṣairanubhūyate .. 39 ..
5.238.d:
दशम्या पुष्पपूजा च भक्तिपूजा तथैव च ..
पुष्पे चैव सदा लक्ष्मीर्वसत्येव निरंतरम् .. 38 1.
लक्ष्म्याः सर्वत्र गामिन्या दोषो नैव प्रजायते ..
यथा सर्वमयो विष्णुर्न दोषैरनुभूयते .. 39 ..
5.238.m: With the tenth [verse] there is worship with flowers, and worship with devotion likewise. / And Lakṣmī always resides continuously in flowers. / No flaw arises for Lakṣmī who goes everywhere: / just as all-pervading Viṣṇu is not touched by faults,

5.238.s:
tathā sarvamayī lakṣmīḥ satītvānnaiva hīyate ..
pratimāsu ca sarvāsu sarvabhūteṣu nityadā .. 6.239.40 ..
5.238.d:
तथा सर्वमयी लक्ष्मीः सतीत्वान्नैव हीयते ..
प्रतिमासु च सर्वासु सर्वभूतेषु नित्यदा .. 6.239.40 ..
5.238.m: so Lakṣmī, all-pervasive, is never deprived of her chastity. / In all images and in all beings continually,

5.238.s:
manuṣyadevapitṛṣu puṣpapūjā vidhīyate ..
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjito yena harirekaḥ śriyā saha .. 41 ..
5.238.d:
मनुष्यदेवपितृषु पुष्पपूजा विधीयते ..
पुष्पैः संपूजितो येन हरिरेकः श्रिया सह .. 41 ..
5.238.m: worship with flowers is prescribed among humans, gods, and ancestors. / He by whom Hari alone is worshipped with flowers together with Śrī,

5.238.s:
ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ pūjitaṃ tena vai jagat ..
ataḥ suśvetakusumairviṣṇuṃ saṃpūjayetsadā ..42 ..
5.238.d:
आब्रह्मस्तंबपर्यंतं पूजितं तेन वै जगत् ..
अतः सुश्वेतकुसुमैर्विष्णुं संपूजयेत्सदा ..42 ..
5.238.m: by him the world from Brahmā down to a clump of grass has indeed been worshipped. / Therefore, one should always worship Viṣṇu with pure white flowers,

5.238.s:
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa bhaktiyuktaḥ sadā śuciḥ ..
bhaktyā suvihitā brahmanpuṣpapūjā narairyadi .. 43 ..
5.238.d:
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण भक्तियुक्तः सदा शुचिः ..
भक्त्या सुविहिता ब्रह्मन्पुष्पपूजा नरैर्यदि .. 43 ..
5.238.m: especially during the Cāturmāsya, filled with devotion and ever pure. / If worship with flowers is properly performed with devotion by men, O brahmin,

5.238.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettasya siddhirniraṃtarā ..
puṣpairupacitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yadyanye praṇamaṃti ca .. 44 ..
5.238.d:
यंयं काममभिध्यायेत्तस्य सिद्धिर्निरंतरा ..
पुष्पैरुपचितं विष्णुं यद्यन्ये प्रणमंति च .. 44 ..
5.238.m: whatever desire one meditates upon, its attainment is continuous. / If others also bow down to Viṣṇu adorned with flowers,

5.238.s:
teṣāmapyakṣayā lokāścāturmāsye'dhikaṃ phalam ..
ekādaśyā dhūpadānaṃ kartavyaṃ yataye harau .. 45 ..
5.238.d:
तेषामप्यक्षया लोकाश्चातुर्मास्येऽधिकं फलम् ..
एकादश्या धूपदानं कर्तव्यं यतये हरौ .. 45 ..
5.238.m: imperishable worlds belong to them as well; during the Cāturmāsya the fruit is greater. / With the eleventh, offering of incense should be made to Hari as an ascetic.

5.238.s:
vanaspati raso divyo gaṃdhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ..
āghreyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 46 ..
5.238.d:
वनस्पति रसो दिव्यो गंधाढ्यो गन्ध उत्तमः..
आघ्रेयः सर्वदेवानां धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 46 ..
5.238.m: 'Divine essence of trees, rich in scent, excellent fragrance, / to be inhaled by all gods: may this incense be accepted!'

5.238.s:
imaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya dhūpamāgurujaṃ śubham ..
dadyādbhagavate nityaṃ cāturmāsye mahāphalam .. 47 ..
5.238.d:
इमं मंत्रं समुच्चार्य धूपमागुरुजं शुभम् ..
दद्याद्भगवते नित्यं चातुर्मास्ये महाफलम् .. 47 ..
5.238.m: Having recited this mantra, one should daily offer auspicious incense made from aloe to the Lord; / during the Cāturmāsya it yields great fruit.

5.238.s:
karpūracandanadalaiḥ sitāmadhusamanvitam ..
māṃsījaṭābhiḥ sahitaṃ supte deve'tha sattama .. 48 ..
5.238.d:
कर्पूरचन्दनदलैः सितामधुसमन्वितम् ..
मांसीजटाभिः सहितं सुप्ते देवेऽथ सत्तम .. 48 ..
5.238.m: With camphor, sandalwood flakes, combined with sugar and honey, / accompanied by jatamansi roots, when the god is asleep, O best of men, 48

5.238.s:
devā ghrāṇena tuṣyaṃti dhūpaṃ ghrāṇaharaṃ śubham..
dvādaśyā dīpadānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ muktimicchubhiḥ .. 49 ..
5.238.d:
देवा घ्राणेन तुष्यंति धूपं घ्राणहरं शुभम्..
द्वादश्या दीपदानं तु कर्तव्यं मुक्तिमिच्छुभिः .. 49 ..
5.238.m: the gods are pleased through their sense of smell by the auspicious incense that captivates the nose. / On the twelfth lunar day, the gift of a lamp must be made by those desiring liberation. 49

5.238.s:
dīpaḥ sarveṣu kāryeṣu prathamastejasāṃ patiḥ ..
dīpastamaughanāśāya dīpaḥ kāṃtiṃ prayacchati .. 6.239.50 ..
5.238.d:
दीपः सर्वेषु कार्येषु प्रथमस्तेजसां पतिः ..
दीपस्तमौघनाशाय दीपः कांतिं प्रयच्छति .. 6.239.50 ..
5.238.m: The lamp is foremost among all rites, the lord of lights; / the lamp is for destroying masses of darkness; the lamp grants splendor. 50

5.238.s:
tasmāddīpapradānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ ..
ayaṃ paurāṇajo maṃtro vedarcena samanvitaḥ ..
dīpapradāne sakalaḥ prayukto nāśayedagham .. 51 ..
5.238.d:
तस्माद्दीपप्रदानेन प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः ..
अयं पौराणजो मंत्रो वेदर्चेन समन्वितः ..
दीपप्रदाने सकलः प्रयुक्तो नाशयेदघम् .. 51 ..
5.238.m: “Therefore, by the gift of a lamp, may Janārdana be pleased with me.” / This mantra born from the Purāṇa, combined with a Vedic verse, / employed fully in the gift of a lamp, destroys evil. 51

5.238.s:
cāturmāsye dīpadānaṃ kurute yo hareḥ puraḥ ..
tasya pāpamayo rāśirnimeṣādapi dahyate .. 52 ..
5.238.d:
चातुर्मास्ये दीपदानं कुरुते यो हरेः पुरः ..
तस्य पापमयो राशिर्निमेषादपि दह्यते .. 52 ..
5.238.m: Whoever makes the gift of a lamp in front of Hari during Cāturmāsya, / his mass of sins is burned away in the twinkling of an eye. 52

5.238.s:
tāvatpāpāni garjaṃti tāvadbibheti pātakī ..
yāvanna vihito bhāsvāndīpo nārāyaṇālaye .. 53 ..
5.238.d:
तावत्पापानि गर्जंति तावद्बिभेति पातकी ..
यावन्न विहितो भास्वान्दीपो नारायणालये .. 53 ..
5.238.m: Sins roar and the sinner fears only so long, / so long as a radiant lamp is not placed in Nārāyaṇa’s abode. 53

5.238.s: darśanādapi dīpasya sarvasiddhirnṛṇāṃ bhavet .. 54 ..
5.238.d: दर्शनादपि दीपस्य सर्वसिद्धिर्नृणां भवेत् .. 54 ..
5.238.m: Even from the sight of the lamp, every accomplishment belongs to men. 54

5.238.s:
kāmanāṃ yāṃ samuddiśya dīpaṃ kārayate harau ..
sāsā siddhyati nirvighnā supte'naṃte guṇottaram .. 55 ..
5.238.d:
कामनां यां समुद्दिश्य दीपं कारयते हरौ ..
सासा सिद्ध्यति निर्विघ्ना सुप्तेऽनंते गुणोत्तरम् .. 55 ..
5.238.m: Whatever desire one intends when having a lamp offered to Hari, / that very desire is accomplished without obstacles, with supreme virtue, while Ananta sleeps. 55

5.238.s:
paṃcāyatanasaṃstheṣu tathā deveṣu paṃcasu ..
vihitaṃ dīpadānaṃ ca cāturmāsye mahāphalam .. 56 ..
5.238.d:
पंचायतनसंस्थेषु तथा देवेषु पंचसु ..
विहितं दीपदानं च चातुर्मास्ये महाफलम् .. 56 ..
5.238.m: Likewise, for the five deities situated in a pañcāyatana, / the gift of a lamp offered during Cāturmāsya yields great fruit. 56

5.238.s:
eko viṣṇustuṣyate muktidātā nityaṃ dhyātaḥ pūjitaḥ saṃstutaśca ..
yaccābhīṣṭaṃ yacca gehe śubhaṃ vā tattaddeyaṃ muktihetornṛvaryaiḥ .. 57 ..
5.238.d:
एको विष्णुस्तुष्यते मुक्तिदाता नित्यं ध्यातः पूजितः संस्तुतश्च ..
यच्चाभीष्टं यच्च गेहे शुभं वा तत्तद्देयं मुक्तिहेतोर्नृवर्यैः .. 57 ..
5.238.m: Viṣṇu alone, the granter of liberation, is pleased when perpetually meditated upon, worshipped, and praised. / Whatever is desired and whatever is auspicious in the home should be given by the best of men for the sake of liberation. 57

5.238.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye tapo'dhikāraṣoḍaśopacāradīpamahimavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 239 ..
5.238.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शेषशाय्युपाख्याने ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे चातुर्मास्यमाहात्म्ये तपोऽधिकारषोडशोपचारदीपमहिमवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 239 ..
5.238.m: Thus ends the two hundred thirty-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Authority of Austerities, the Sixteen Upacāras, and the Greatness of the Lamp,” in the Great Purāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Greatness of the Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the narrative of Śeṣaśāyin, in the dialogue between Brahmā and Nārada, in the Greatness of Cāturmāsya. 239

5.239.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
harerdīpastu maddīpādadhiko'yaṃ prakurvataḥ ..
vaikuṇṭhavāsa eva syānmamaiśvaryamavāṃchitam .. 1 ..
5.239.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
हरेर्दीपस्तु मद्दीपादधिकोऽयं प्रकुर्वतः ..
वैकुण्ठवास एव स्यान्ममैश्वर्यमवांछितम् .. 1 ..
5.239.m: Brahmā said: / But this lamp offered to Hari is superior to a lamp offered to me; for one who offers it, / residence in Vaikuṇṭha alone shall take place; my lordship is not to be desired. 1

5.239.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
dīpo'yaṃ viṣṇubhavane mantravadvihito naraiḥ ..
sadā viśeṣaphaladaścāturmāsye'dhikaḥ katham .. 2 .. ..
5.239.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
दीपोऽयं विष्णुभवने मन्त्रवद्विहितो नरैः ..
सदा विशेषफलदश्चातुर्मास्येऽधिकः कथम् .. 2 .. ..
5.239.m: Nārada said: / This lamp, offered with mantras by men in Viṣṇu’s temple, / always yields special fruit. How is it even greater during Cāturmāsya? 2

5.239.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
viṣṇurnityādhidaivaṃ me viṣṇuḥ pūjyaḥ sadā mama ..
viṣṇumenaṃ sadā dhyāye viṣṇurmattaḥ paro hi saḥ .. 3 ..
5.239.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
विष्णुर्नित्याधिदैवं मे विष्णुः पूज्यः सदा मम ..
विष्णुमेनं सदा ध्याये विष्णुर्मत्तः परो हि सः .. 3 ..
5.239.m: Brahmā said: / Viṣṇu is my eternal tutelary deity; Viṣṇu is always to be worshipped by me. / I always meditate on this Viṣṇu; for Viṣṇu is superior to me. 3

5.239.s:
sa viṣṇu vallabho dīpaḥ sarvadā pāpahārakaḥ ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa kāmanāsiddhikārakaḥ .. 4 ..
5.239.d:
स विष्णु वल्लभो दीपः सर्वदा पापहारकः ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण कामनासिद्धिकारकः .. 4 ..
5.239.m: That lamp is dear to Viṣṇu, always removing sins, / and especially during Cāturmāsya, fulfilling all desires. 4

5.239.s:
viṣṇurdīpena saṃtuṣṭo yathā bhavati putraka ..
tathā yajñasahasraiśca varaṃ naiva prayacchati .. 5 ..
5.239.d:
विष्णुर्दीपेन संतुष्टो यथा भवति पुत्रक ..
तथा यज्ञसहस्रैश्च वरं नैव प्रयच्छति .. 5 ..
5.239.m: As Viṣṇu is pleased by a lamp, O dear son, / he does not grant such a boon even through thousands of sacrifices. 5

5.239.s:
svalpa vyayena dīpasya phalamānaṃtakaṃ nṛṇām ..
anaṃtaśayane prāpte puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate .. 6 ..
5.239.d:
स्वल्प व्ययेन दीपस्य फलमानंतकं नृणाम् ..
अनंतशयने प्राप्ते पुण्यसंख्या न विद्यते .. 6 ..
5.239.m: With little expense for the lamp, boundless is the fruit for men; / when Ananta’s sleep arrives, there is no counting the merit. 6

5.239.s:
tasmātsarvātmabhāvena śraddhayā saṃyutena ca ..
dīpapradānaṃ kurute hareḥ pāpairna lipyate .. 7 ..
5.239.d:
तस्मात्सर्वात्मभावेन श्रद्धया संयुतेन च ..
दीपप्रदानं कुरुते हरेः पापैर्न लिप्यते .. 7 ..
5.239.m: Therefore, when one offers a gift of a lamp to Hari / with wholehearted devotion and endowed with faith, one is not stained by sins. 7

5.239.s:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśakairyatirūpe harau punaḥ ..
dīpapradāne vihite sarvamuddyotitaṃ jagat .. 8 ..
5.239.d:
उपचारैः षोडशकैर्यतिरूपे हरौ पुनः ..
दीपप्रदाने विहिते सर्वमुद्द्योतितं जगत् .. 8 ..
5.239.m: Moreover, when the gift of a lamp is offered with the sixteen upacāras / to Hari in the form of an ascetic, the entire world is illuminated. 8

5.239.s:
dīpādanaṃtaraṃ brahmannannasya ca nivedanam ..
trayodaśyā bhaktiyuktaiḥ kāryaṃ mokṣapadasthitaiḥ .. 9 ..
5.239.d:
दीपादनंतरं ब्रह्मन्नन्नस्य च निवेदनम् ..
त्रयोदश्या भक्तियुक्तैः कार्यं मोक्षपदस्थितैः .. 9 ..
5.239.m: After the lamp, O Brahmā, the offering of food / must be made on the thirteenth lunar day with devotion by those established in the state of liberation. 9

5.239.s:
amṛtaṃ saṃparityajya yadannaṃ devatā api ..
spṛhayaṃti gṛhasthasya gṛhadvāragatāḥ sadā .. 6.240.10 ..
5.239.d:
अमृतं संपरित्यज्य यदन्नं देवता अपि ..
स्पृहयंति गृहस्थस्य गृहद्वारगताः सदा .. 6.240.10 ..
5.239.m: Forsaking nectar, the gods too constantly long / for the food of the householder when they arrive at his house door. 10

5.239.s:
harau supte viśeṣeṇa pradeyaḥ pratyahaṃ naraiḥ ..
phalairarghyo viṣṇutuṣṭyai tatkālasamudā hṛtaiḥ .. 11 ..
5.239.d:
हरौ सुप्ते विशेषेण प्रदेयः प्रत्यहं नरैः ..
फलैरर्घ्यो विष्णुतुष्ट्यै तत्कालसमुदा हृतैः .. 11 ..
5.239.m: Especially while Hari is asleep, an arghya offering with fruits / collected at that time should be given daily by men for Viṣṇu’s pleasure: 11

5.239.s:
tāṃbūlavallīpatraiśca tathā pūgaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
drākṣājaṃbvāmrajaphalairakroḍairdāḍimairapi .. 12 ..
5.239.d:
तांबूलवल्लीपत्रैश्च तथा पूगफलैः शुभैः ..
द्राक्षाजंब्वाम्रजफलैरक्रोडैर्दाडिमैरपि .. 12 ..
5.239.m: with betel vine leaves, and likewise with auspicious areca nuts, / with grapes, jambu fruits, and mangoes, with walnuts and pomegranates, 12

5.239.s:
bījapūraphalaiścaiva dadyādarghyaṃ subhaktitaḥ ..
śaṃkhatoyaṃ samādāya tasyopari phalaṃ śubham.. 13 ..
5.239.d:
बीजपूरफलैश्चैव दद्यादर्घ्यं सुभक्तितः ..
शंखतोयं समादाय तस्योपरि फलं शुभम्.. 13 ..
5.239.m: and indeed with citrons, one should offer the arghya with deep devotion. / Taking water in a conch shell, and an auspicious fruit placed upon it, 13

5.239.s:
maṃtreṇānena viprendra keśavāya nivedayet ..
punarācamanaṃ deyamannadānādanaṃtaram .. 14 ..
5.239.d:
मंत्रेणानेन विप्रेन्द्र केशवाय निवेदयेत् ..
पुनराचमनं देयमन्नदानादनंतरम् .. 14 ..
5.239.m: one should offer it to Keśava with this mantra, O best of brahmins. / A second sipping of water is to be offered after the gift of food. 14

5.239.s:
ārtikyaṃ ca tataḥ kuryātsarvapāpavināśanam ..
caturdaśyā namaskuryādviṣṇave yatirūpiṇe .. 15 ..
5.239.d:
आर्तिक्यं च ततः कुर्यात्सर्वपापविनाशनम् ..
चतुर्दश्या नमस्कुर्याद्विष्णवे यतिरूपिणे .. 15 ..
5.239.m: Then one should perform the waving of lights, which destroys all sins. / On the fourteenth lunar day, one should bow down to Viṣṇu in the form of an ascetic. 15

5.239.s:
paṃcadaśyā bhramaḥ kāryaḥ sarvadikṣu dvijaiḥ saha ..
saptasāgarajai stoyairdattairyatphalamāpyate .. 16 ..
5.239.d:
पंचदश्या भ्रमः कार्यः सर्वदिक्षु द्विजैः सह ..
सप्तसागरजै स्तोयैर्दत्तैर्यत्फलमाप्यते .. 16 ..
5.239.m: On the fifteenth lunar day, circumambulation should be performed in all directions together with twice-borns. / The fruit that is attained through waters born of the seven oceans offered, 16

5.239.s:
tattoyadānācca hareḥ prāpyate viṣṇuvallabhaiḥ ..
caturvārabhramībhiśca jagatsarvaṃ carācaram .. 17 ..
5.239.d:
तत्तोयदानाच्च हरेः प्राप्यते विष्णुवल्लभैः ..
चतुर्वारभ्रमीभिश्च जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् .. 17 ..
5.239.m: is attained through that offering of water to Hari by those dear to Viṣṇu. / And through four circumambulations, the whole universe, moving and unmoving, 17

5.239.s:
krāṃtaṃ bhavati viprāgrya tattīrthagamanādikam ..
ṣoḍaśyā devasāyujyaṃ cintayedyogavittamaḥ .. 18 ..
5.239.d:
क्रांतं भवति विप्राग्र्य तत्तीर्थगमनादिकम् ..
षोडश्या देवसायुज्यं चिन्तयेद्योगवित्तमः .. 18 ..
5.239.m: is traversed, O best of brahmins, along with going to those sacred fords and the like. / On the sixteenth, one who best knows yoga should contemplate union with the god. 18

5.239.s:
ātmanaśca harernityaṃ na mūrtiṃ bhāvayettadā ..
mūrtāmūrtasvarūpa tvāddṛśyo bhavati yogavit .. 19 ..
5.239.d:
आत्मनश्च हरेर्नित्यं न मूर्तिं भावयेत्तदा ..
मूर्तामूर्तस्वरूप त्वाद्दृश्यो भवति योगवित् .. 19 ..
5.239.m: He should not then contemplate any form of himself or of Hari as separate; / because he has the nature of the formed and formless, the knower of yoga becomes visible. 19

5.239.s:
tasmindṛṣṭe nivarteta sadasadrūpajā kriyā ..
ātmānaṃ tejasāṃ madhye cintayetsūryavarcasam .. 6.240.20 ..
5.239.d:
तस्मिन्दृष्टे निवर्तेत सदसद्रूपजा क्रिया ..
आत्मानं तेजसां मध्ये चिन्तयेत्सूर्यवर्चसम् .. 6.240.20 ..
5.239.m: When that is seen, action arising from real and unreal forms ceases. / He should contemplate the self in the midst of splendors, having the brilliance of the sun, 20

5.239.s:
ahameva sadā viṣṇurityātmani vicārayan ..
labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ dehaṃ jīvanmukto dvijo bhavet .. 21 ..
5.239.d:
अहमेव सदा विष्णुरित्यात्मनि विचारयन् ..
लभते वैष्णवं देहं जीवन्मुक्तो द्विजो भवेत् .. 21 ..
5.239.m: reflecting within himself: “I alone am always Viṣṇu.” / The twice-born obtains a Vaiṣṇava body and becomes liberated while living. 21

5.239.s:
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa yogayukto dvijo bhavet ..
iyaṃ bhaktiḥ samādiṣṭā mokṣamārgaprade harau .. 22 ..
5.239.d:
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण योगयुक्तो द्विजो भवेत् ..
इयं भक्तिः समादिष्टा मोक्षमार्गप्रदे हरौ .. 22 ..
5.239.m: Especially during Cāturmāsya, the twice-born should become united with yoga. / This devotion is taught toward Hari, who bestows the path to liberation. 22

5.239.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyu pākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye dīpadānādisāyujyacintanāntabhaktinirūpaṇaṃ nāma catvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..240... ..cha..
5.239.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शेषशाय्यु पाख्याने ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे चातुर्मास्यमाहात्म्ये दीपदानादिसायुज्यचिन्तनान्तभक्तिनिरूपणं नाम चत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..240... ..छ..
5.239.m: Thus ends the two hundred fortieth chapter, entitled “Exposition of Devotion Ending with the Contemplation of Union through the Gift of a Lamp and Other Rites,” in the Great Purāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Greatness of the Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the narrative of Śeṣaśāyin, in the dialogue between Brahmā and Nārada, in the Greatness of Cāturmāsya. 240

5.240.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
etatte pūjanaṃ viṣṇoḥ ṣoḍaśopāyasaṃbhavam ..
kathitaṃ yaddvijaḥ kṛtvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 1 ..
5.240.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते पूजनं विष्णोः षोडशोपायसंभवम् ..
कथितं यद्द्विजः कृत्वा प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् .. 1 ..
5.240.m: Īśvara said: / This worship of Viṣṇu consisting of sixteen steps has been told to you, / performing which a twice-born reaches the supreme state. 1

5.240.s:
tathā ca kṣatriyaviśāṃ karaṇānmuktiruttamā ..
śūdrāṇāṃ nādhikāro'sminstrīṇāṃ naiva kadācana .. 2 ..
5.240.d:
तथा च क्षत्रियविशां करणान्मुक्तिरुत्तमा ..
शूद्राणां नाधिकारोऽस्मिन्स्त्रीणां नैव कदाचन .. 2 ..
5.240.m: And likewise, through its performance, supreme liberation belongs to Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas. / Śūdras have no qualification for this, and women never at all. 2

5.240.s:
.. kārtikeya uvāca .. ..
śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā strīṇāṃ dharmaṃ vistarato vada ..
kena muktirbhavetteṣāṃ kṛṣṇasyārādhanaṃ vinā .. 3 ..
5.240.d:
.. कार्तिकेय उवाच .. ..
शूद्राणां च तथा स्त्रीणां धर्मं विस्तरतो वद ..
केन मुक्तिर्भवेत्तेषां कृष्णस्याराधनं विना .. 3 ..
5.240.m: Kārtikeya said: / Speak in detail of the dharma for Śūdras and likewise for women. / By what means would liberation come to them without the worship of Kṛṣṇa? 3

5.240.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sacchūdrairapi no kāryā vedākṣaravicāraṇā ..
na śrotavyā na paṭhyā ca paṭhannarakabhāgbhavet .. 4 ..
5.240.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सच्छूद्रैरपि नो कार्या वेदाक्षरविचारणा ..
न श्रोतव्या न पठ्या च पठन्नरकभाग्भवेत् .. 4 ..
5.240.m: Īśvara said: / Even good Śūdras must not deliberate on the syllables of the Veda; / they must not hear them nor recite them; by reciting, one would go to hell. 4

5.240.s:
purāṇānāṃ naiva pāṭhaḥ śravaṇaṃ kārayetsadā ..
smṛtyuktaṃ sugurorgrāhyaṃ na pāṭhaḥ śravaṇādikam .. 5 ..
5.240.d:
पुराणानां नैव पाठः श्रवणं कारयेत्सदा ..
स्मृत्युक्तं सुगुरोर्ग्राह्यं न पाठः श्रवणादिकम् .. 5 ..
5.240.m: No reading of the Purāṇas [is allowed for them]; one should always have them listen. / What is spoken in the Smṛti should be received from a good guru; no reading, hearing [the Vedas], or the like [is permitted]. 5

5.240.s:
.. skaṃda uvāca .. ..
sacchūdrāḥ ke samākhyātāstāṃśca vistarato vada ..
ke saṃtaḥ ke ca śūdrāśca sacchūdrā nāmataśca ke .. 6 ..
5.240.d:
.. स्कंद उवाच .. ..
सच्छूद्राः के समाख्यातास्तांश्च विस्तरतो वद ..
के संतः के च शूद्राश्च सच्छूद्रा नामतश्च के .. 6 ..
5.240.m: Skanda said: / Who are declared to be noble śūdras? Speak of them in detail: / who are the righteous, who are the śūdras, and who are noble śūdras by name?

5.240.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dharmoḍhā yasya patnī syātsa sacchūdra udāhṛtaḥ ..
samānakularūpā ca daśadoṣavivarjitā .. 7 ..
5.240.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
धर्मोढा यस्य पत्नी स्यात्स सच्छूद्र उदाहृतः ..
समानकुलरूपा च दशदोषविवर्जिता .. 7 ..
5.240.m: Īśvara said: / He who has a wife wedded according to righteousness is declared a noble śūdra: / one equal in family and appearance, free from the ten defects,

5.240.s:
udvoḍhā vedavidhinā sa sacchūdraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
aklīvā'vyaṃginī śastā mahārogādyadūṣitā .. 8 ..
5.240.d:
उद्वोढा वेदविधिना स सच्छूद्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
अक्लीवाऽव्यंगिनी शस्ता महारोगाद्यदूषिता .. 8 ..
5.240.m: wedded in accordance with the Vedic rite, he is proclaimed a noble śūdra. / She should be non-sterile, free from physical deformities, commendable, untainted by major diseases and the like,

5.240.s:
aniṃditā śubhakalā cakṣurogavivarjitā ..
bādhiryahīnā capalā kanyā madhurabhāṣiṇī .. 9 ..
5.240.d:
अनिंदिता शुभकला चक्षुरोगविवर्जिता ..
बाधिर्यहीना चपला कन्या मधुरभाषिणी .. 9 ..
5.240.m: blameless, possessed of auspicious arts, free from eye disease, / free from deafness, nimble, a young maiden speaking sweetly,

5.240.s:
dūṣaṇairdaśabhirhīnā vedoktavidhinā naraiḥ ..
vivāhitā ca sā patnī gṛhiṇī yasya sarvadā .. 6.241.10 ..
5.240.d:
दूषणैर्दशभिर्हीना वेदोक्तविधिना नरैः ..
विवाहिता च सा पत्नी गृहिणी यस्य सर्वदा .. 6.241.10 ..
5.240.m: free from the ten blemishes, and married by men according to the rite enjoined in the Veda. / He whose wife is constantly such a mistress of the house,

5.240.s:
sacchūdraḥ sa tu vijñeyo devādīnāṃ vibhāgakṛt ..
puṇyakāryeṣu sarveṣu prathamaṃ sā prakīrtitā .. 11 ..
5.240.d:
सच्छूद्रः स तु विज्ञेयो देवादीनां विभागकृत् ..
पुण्यकार्येषु सर्वेषु प्रथमं सा प्रकीर्तिता .. 11 ..
5.240.m: he should be known as a noble śūdra, one who offers shares to the gods and others. / In all meritorious acts, she is proclaimed first.

5.240.s:
tayā suvihito dharmaḥ saṃpūrṇaphaladāyakaḥ ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tayā saha guṇādhikaḥ .. 12 ..
5.240.d:
तया सुविहितो धर्मः संपूर्णफलदायकः ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण तया सह गुणाधिकः .. 12 ..
5.240.m: The duty properly performed with her yields complete fruit; / during Cāturmāsya especially, along with her, its virtue is multiplied.

5.240.s:
bhāryāratiḥ śucirbhṛtyādīnāṃ poṣaṇatatparaḥ ..
śrāddhādikārako nityamiṣṭāpūrttaprasādhakaḥ .. 13 ..
5.240.d:
भार्यारतिः शुचिर्भृत्यादीनां पोषणतत्परः ..
श्राद्धादिकारको नित्यमिष्टापूर्त्तप्रसाधकः .. 13 ..
5.240.m: Delighting in his wife, pure, intent on supporting his servants and dependents, / perpetually performing śrāddha and the like, accomplishing sacrifices and charitable works,

5.240.s:
namaskārāntamantreṇa nāmasaṃkīrtanena ca ..
devā stasya ca tuṣyanti paṃcayajñādikaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 14 ..
5.240.d:
नमस्कारान्तमन्त्रेण नामसंकीर्तनेन च ..
देवा स्तस्य च तुष्यन्ति पंचयज्ञादिकैः शुभैः .. 14 ..
5.240.m: with mantras ending in namas, and through the chanting of [the Lord's] names, / and with the auspicious five daily sacrifices and the like, the gods are pleased with him.

5.240.s:
snānaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ caiva vahnihomo'pyamaṃtrakaḥ ..
brahmayajño'titheḥ pūjā paṃcayajñānna saṃtyajet .. 15 ..
5.240.d:
स्नानं च तर्पणं चैव वह्निहोमोऽप्यमंत्रकः ..
ब्रह्मयज्ञोऽतिथेः पूजा पंचयज्ञान्न संत्यजेत् .. 15 ..
5.240.m: Ritual ablution, libation, the fire oblation without mantras, / the sacrifice to Brahmā, and the worship of guests: one should not abandon the five daily sacrifices.

5.240.s:
kāryaṃ strībhiśca śūdraiśca hyamaṃtraṃ paṃcayajñakam ..
paṃcayajñaiśca saṃtuṣṭā yathaiṣāṃ pitṛdevatāḥ .. 16 ..
5.240.d:
कार्यं स्त्रीभिश्च शूद्रैश्च ह्यमंत्रं पंचयज्ञकम् ..
पंचयज्ञैश्च संतुष्टा यथैषां पितृदेवताः .. 16 ..
5.240.m: The five daily sacrifices without mantras are to be performed by women and by śūdras; / and the gods and ancestors are pleased by their five daily sacrifices,

5.240.s:
tathā pativratāyāśca patiśuśrūṣayā sadā ..
pativratāyā dehe tu sarve devā vasaṃti hi .. 17 ..
5.240.d:
तथा पतिव्रतायाश्च पतिशुश्रूषया सदा ..
पतिव्रताया देहे तु सर्वे देवा वसंति हि .. 17 ..
5.240.m: as well as by a devoted wife's constant attendance upon her husband. / In the body of a devoted wife, indeed, all the gods dwell.

5.240.s:
atastābhyāṃ sametābhyāṃ dharmādīnāṃ samāgamaḥ ..
yadobhayormate pṛṣṭe saṃtuṣṭāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ .. 18 ..
5.240.d:
अतस्ताभ्यां समेताभ्यां धर्मादीनां समागमः ..
यदोभयोर्मते पृष्टे संतुष्टाः पितृदेवताः .. 18 ..
5.240.m: Therefore, when the two are united, there is a meeting of righteousness and the other aims of life; / when both are asked their consent, the ancestors and gods are satisfied.

5.240.s:
kāryādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ saṃgamastatra nityadā ..
cāturmāsye samāyāte viṣṇubhaktyā tayoḥ śivam .. 19 ..
5.240.d:
कार्यादीनां च सर्वेषां संगमस्तत्र नित्यदा ..
चातुर्मास्ये समायाते विष्णुभक्त्या तयोः शिवम् .. 19 ..
5.240.m: And in all duties and undertakings, there is their union at all times. / When Cāturmāsya arrives, through devotion to Viṣṇu, good fortune comes to them both.

5.240.s:
samānajātisaṃbhūtā patnī yasya dhṛtā bhavet ..
pūrvo bharttā'rddhabhāgī syāddvitīyasya na kiṃcana .. 6.241.20 ..
5.240.d:
समानजातिसंभूता पत्नी यस्य धृता भवेत् ..
पूर्वो भर्त्ताऽर्द्धभागी स्याद्द्वितीयस्य न किंचन .. 6.241.20 ..
5.240.m: If a man takes a wife born of the same caste, / the first husband receives half the share, but for a second [husband] there is none at all.

5.240.s:
arthakāryādhikāro'syāstena dharmārdhadhāriṇī ..
svaṃsvaṃ kṛtaṃ sadaiva syāttayoḥ karma śubhāśubham .. .. 21 ..
5.240.d:
अर्थकार्याधिकारोऽस्यास्तेन धर्मार्धधारिणी ..
स्वंस्वं कृतं सदैव स्यात्तयोः कर्म शुभाशुभम् .. .. 21 ..
5.240.m: She has authority over wealth and duties; therefore she upholds half of the merit. / Auspicious or inauspicious, their deed is always performed individually by each.

5.240.s:
yā'nugacchati bhartāraṃ mṛtaṃ sutapasā dvija ..
sādhvī sā hi parijñeyā tayā coddhriyate kulam .. 22 ..
5.240.d:
याऽनुगच्छति भर्तारं मृतं सुतपसा द्विज ..
साध्वी सा हि परिज्ञेया तया चोद्ध्रियते कुलम् .. 22 ..
5.240.m: A woman who follows her deceased husband through great austerity, O twice-born, / is to be recognized as a virtuous wife; by her the family is delivered.

5.240.s:
anyajātermṛtasyātha dhṛtā vāpi vivāhitā ..
vaiśvānarasya mārgeṇa sā tamuddharate patim .. 23 ..
5.240.d:
अन्यजातेर्मृतस्याथ धृता वापि विवाहिता ..
वैश्वानरस्य मार्गेण सा तमुद्धरते पतिम् .. 23 ..
5.240.m: Whether taken or wedded to one of another caste who has died, / by the path of the Fire she delivers that husband.

5.240.s:
yathā jalācca jaṃbālaḥ kṛṣyate dhārmikairnṛbhiḥ ..
evamuddharate sādhvī bharttāraṃ yā'nuga cchati .. 24 ..
5.240.d:
यथा जलाच्च जंबालः कृष्यते धार्मिकैर्नृभिः ..
एवमुद्धरते साध्वी भर्त्तारं याऽनुग च्छति .. 24 ..
5.240.m: Just as mud is pulled from the water by righteous men, / so does the virtuous wife deliver the husband whom she follows [in death].

5.240.s:
anyajātisamudbhūtā anyena vidhṛtā yadi ..
tāvubhau dharmakāryeṣu saṃtyājyau nityadā matau .. 25 ..
5.240.d:
अन्यजातिसमुद्भूता अन्येन विधृता यदि ..
तावुभौ धर्मकार्येषु संत्याज्यौ नित्यदा मतौ .. 25 ..
5.240.m: If a woman born of another caste is taken by another man, / both of them are considered always to be excluded from religious rites.

5.240.s:
svaṃsvaṃ karma prakurutaḥ satkarma jaṃ svakaṃ phalam ..
tasmādvariṣṭhā hīnā vā satkulyā śūdrasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 26 ..
5.240.d:
स्वंस्वं कर्म प्रकुरुतः सत्कर्म जं स्वकं फलम् ..
तस्माद्वरिष्ठा हीना वा सत्कुल्या शूद्रसंभवैः .. 26 ..
5.240.m: Each performs their own deed, and each obtains the fruit born of virtuous deeds. / Therefore, whether superior or inferior, a woman of good family taken by those born of śūdras

5.240.s:
dhṛtā na kāryā sā patnī yatkaroti na varddhate ..
tayā saha kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ varddhate daśadhottaram .. 27 ..
5.240.d:
धृता न कार्या सा पत्नी यत्करोति न वर्द्धते ..
तया सह कृतं पुण्यं वर्द्धते दशधोत्तरम् .. 27 ..
5.240.m: should not be made his wife; whatever she does does not increase. / The merit performed with her increases tenfold,

5.240.s:
anantatṛptidaṃ naiva tatsutairapi vā tathā ..
krayakrītā ca yā kanyā dāsī sā parikīrtitā .. 28 ..
5.240.d:
अनन्ततृप्तिदं नैव तत्सुतैरपि वा तथा ..
क्रयक्रीता च या कन्या दासी सा परिकीर्तिता .. 28 ..
5.240.m: yet it does not grant endless satisfaction, nor likewise [does that done] by her sons. / A maiden purchased with wealth is proclaimed a female slave.

5.240.s:
sacchūdrasyādhikāre sā kadācinnaiva jāyate ..
yā kanyā svayamudyamya pitrā dattā varāya ca .. 29 ..
5.240.d:
सच्छूद्रस्याधिकारे सा कदाचिन्नैव जायते ..
या कन्या स्वयमुद्यम्य पित्रा दत्ता वराय च .. 29 ..
5.240.m: She never belongs to the status of a noble śūdra. / A maiden whom a father gives to a bridegroom having exerted himself,

5.240.s:
vivāhavidhinodūḍhā pitṛdevārthasādhinī ..
sulakṣaṇā vinītā sā vivekādiguṇā śubhā .. 6.241.30 ..
5.240.d:
विवाहविधिनोदूढा पितृदेवार्थसाधिनी ..
सुलक्षणा विनीता सा विवेकादिगुणा शुभा .. 6.241.30 ..
5.240.m: wedded according to the marriage rite, fulfilling the purposes of the ancestors and gods, / possessed of auspicious marks, humble, endowed with discernment and virtues, auspicious,

5.240.s:
saccaritrā patiparā sā tebhyo dātumarhati ..
viśuddhakulajā kanyā dharmoḍhā dharmacāriṇī .. 31 ..
5.240.d:
सच्चरित्रा पतिपरा सा तेभ्यो दातुमर्हति ..
विशुद्धकुलजा कन्या धर्मोढा धर्मचारिणी .. 31 ..
5.240.m: of good conduct, devoted to her husband: such a maiden he should give to them. / A maiden born of a pure family, wedded according to righteousness, walking in righteousness,

5.240.s:
sā punāti kulaṃ sarvaṃ mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā ..
eṣa eva mayā proktaḥ sacchūdrāṇāṃ paro vidhiḥ .. 32 ..
5.240.d:
सा पुनाति कुलं सर्वं मातृतः पितृतस्तथा ..
एष एव मया प्रोक्तः सच्छूद्राणां परो विधिः .. 32 ..
5.240.m: purifies her entire family, both on the mother's side and on the father's. / This supreme rule for noble śūdras has indeed been declared by me.

5.240.s:
adhojātisamudbhūtā sacchūdrātkramahīnajā ..
vivāho daśadhā teṣāṃ daśadhā putratā bhavet .. 33 ..
5.240.d:
अधोजातिसमुद्भूता सच्छूद्रात्क्रमहीनजा ..
विवाहो दशधा तेषां दशधा पुत्रता भवेत् .. 33 ..
5.240.m: For those born of lower castes, born lower in order from a noble śūdra, / their marriage is of ten kinds, and their sonship is of ten kinds.

5.240.s:
catvāra uttamāḥ proktā vivāhā munisattama ..
śeṣāḥ sarvaprakṛtiṣu kathitāśca purāvidaiḥ . 34 ..
5.240.d:
चत्वार उत्तमाः प्रोक्ता विवाहा मुनिसत्तम ..
शेषाः सर्वप्रकृतिषु कथिताश्च पुराविदैः . 34 ..
5.240.m: Four marriages are proclaimed superior, O best of sages; / the remaining ones among all common people have been declared by knowers of the past:

5.240.s:
prājāpatyastathā brāhmo daivārṣo cātiśobhanā ..
gāṃdharvaścāsuraścaiva rākṣasaśca piśācakaḥ ..35..
5.240.d:
प्राजापत्यस्तथा ब्राह्मो दैवार्षो चातिशोभना ..
गांधर्वश्चासुरश्चैव राक्षसश्च पिशाचकः ..35..
5.240.m: the Prājāpatya, the Brāhma, the Daiva, and the Ārṣa are very auspicious; / the Gāndharva, the Āsura, the Rākṣasa, and the Paiśāca,

5.240.s:
prātibho ghātanaśceti vivāhāḥ kathitā daśa ..
ete hi hīnajātīnāṃ vivāhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..36..
5.240.d:
प्रातिभो घातनश्चेति विवाहाः कथिता दश ..
एते हि हीनजातीनां विवाहाः परिकीर्तिताः ..36..
5.240.m: the Prātibha, and the Ghātana—these ten marriages are declared. / These are indeed proclaimed as the marriages of the lower castes.

5.240.s:
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva dattaḥ kṛtrima eva ca ..
gūḍhotpanno'paviddhaśca kānīnaśca sahoḍhajaḥ ..37..
5.240.d:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश्चैव दत्तः कृत्रिम एव च ..
गूढोत्पन्नोऽपविद्धश्च कानीनश्च सहोढजः ..37..
5.240.m: The body-born (aurasa), the wife-born (kṣetraja), the adopted (datta), and the artificial (kṛtrima), / the secretly born (gūḍhotpanna), the cast-off (apaviddha), the maiden-born (kānīna), the pregnant-bride's son (sahodhaja),

5.240.s:
krītaḥ paunarbhavaścāpi putrā daśavidhāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
aurasādapi hīnāśca te'pi teṣāṃ śubhāvahāḥ .. 38 ..
5.240.d:
क्रीतः पौनर्भवश्चापि पुत्रा दशविधाः स्मृताः ..
औरसादपि हीनाश्च तेऽपि तेषां शुभावहाः .. 38 ..
5.240.m: the purchased (krīta), and the twice-married woman's son (paunarbhava): these ten kinds of sons are recorded. / Even those lower than the body-born bring auspiciousness to them.

5.240.s:
aṣṭādaśamitā nīcāḥ prakṛtānāṃ yathātathā ..
vidhinaiva kriyā naiva smṛti mārgo'pi naiva ca ..39..
tāsāṃ brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣā viṣṇudhyānaṃ śivārcanam ..
amantrātpuṇyakaraṇaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ ca vai sadā ..6.241.4...
5.240.d:
अष्टादशमिता नीचाः प्रकृतानां यथातथा ..
विधिनैव क्रिया नैव स्मृति मार्गोऽपि नैव च ..39..
तासां ब्राह्मणशुश्रूषा विष्णुध्यानं शिवार्चनम् ..
अमन्त्रात्पुण्यकरणं दानं देयं च वै सदा ..6.241.4...
5.240.m:
The low castes are eighteen in number, of the common folk as they are; / they have no rites according to Vedic rule, nor even the path of the Smṛtis.
For them, service to brahmins, meditation on Viṣṇu, worship of Śiva, / performance of meritorious deeds without mantras, and charity should always be given.

5.240.s:
na dānasya kṣayo loke śraddhayā yatpradīyate ..
aśraddhayā'śucitayā dānaṃ vairasyakāraṇam .. 41 ..
5.240.d:
न दानस्य क्षयो लोके श्रद्धया यत्प्रदीयते ..
अश्रद्धयाऽशुचितया दानं वैरस्यकारणम् .. 41 ..
5.240.m: There is no destruction of a gift in the world that is given with faith; / a gift [given] without faith or in impurity is a cause of enmity.

5.240.s:
ahiṃsādi samādiṣṭo dharmastāsāṃ mahāphalaḥ ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tridiveśādisevayā ..42..
5.240.d:
अहिंसादि समादिष्टो धर्मस्तासां महाफलः ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण त्रिदिवेशादिसेवया ..42..
5.240.m: Non-injury and the like are enjoined as their duty yielding great fruit, / especially during Cāturmāsya, by serving the Lord of heaven and others.

5.240.s:
sudarśanaistathā dharmaḥ sevyate hyavirodhibhiḥ [.
sacchūdrairdānapuṇyaiśca dvijaśuśrūṣaṇādibhiḥ..43..
5.240.d:
सुदर्शनैस्तथा धर्मः सेव्यते ह्यविरोधिभिः [.
सच्छूद्रैर्दानपुण्यैश्च द्विजशुश्रूषणादिभिः..43..
5.240.m: Likewise, duty is observed by righteous men who do not oppose [the rule], / by noble śūdras through gifts, merits, and service to the twice-born and the like.

5.240.s:
vṛttiśca satyānṛtajā vāṇijyavyava hārajā ..
aśītibhāgamāradyādvyājādvārdhuṣikaḥ śate ..44..
5.240.d:
वृत्तिश्च सत्यानृतजा वाणिज्यव्यव हारजा ..
अशीतिभागमारद्याद्व्याजाद्वार्धुषिकः शते ..44..
5.240.m: Their livelihood arises from truth and falsehood, born of trade and commerce. / An eightieth part is taken as profit by a usurer on a hundred;

5.240.s:
sapādabhāgavṛddhistu kṣattriyādiṣu gṛhyate ..
evaṃ na bandho bhavati pātakasya kadācana..45..
5.240.d:
सपादभागवृद्धिस्तु क्षत्त्रियादिषु गृह्यते ..
एवं न बन्धो भवति पातकस्य कदाचन..45..
5.240.m: an interest of one and a quarter parts is taken from kṣatriyas and others. / Thus, there is never any bondage of sin.

5.240.s:
prātaḥkarma sureśānāṃ madhyāhne dvijasevanam ..
aparāhṇe'tha kāryāṇi kurvanmartyaḥ sukhī bhavet .. 46 ..
5.240.d:
प्रातःकर्म सुरेशानां मध्याह्ने द्विजसेवनम् ..
अपराह्णेऽथ कार्याणि कुर्वन्मर्त्यः सुखी भवेत् .. 46 ..
5.240.m: Morning rites for the lord of gods, attendance upon the twice-born at midday, / and performing duties in the afternoon: a mortal doing this becomes happy.

5.240.s:
gṛhasthaiśca sadā bhāvyaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ kriyāparaiḥ ..
paṃcayajñarataiścaivātithidvijasupūjakaiḥ .. 47 ..
5.240.d:
गृहस्थैश्च सदा भाव्यं यावज्जीवं क्रियापरैः ..
पंचयज्ञरतैश्चैवातिथिद्विजसुपूजकैः .. 47 ..
5.240.m: Householders should always be intent on rites as long as life lasts, / devoted to the five daily sacrifices, honoring guests and the twice-born,

5.240.s:
viṣṇubhaktirataiścaiva vedamantravipāṭhakaiḥ ..
satataṃ dānaśīlaiśca dīnārtajanavatsalaiḥ .. 48 ..
5.240.d:
विष्णुभक्तिरतैश्चैव वेदमन्त्रविपाठकैः ..
सततं दानशीलैश्च दीनार्तजनवत्सलैः .. 48 ..
5.240.m: devoted to devotion to Viṣṇu, non-reciters of Vedic mantras, / constantly inclined to charity, compassionate toward the poor and afflicted,

5.240.s:
kṣamādiguṇasaṃyuktairdvādaśākṣarapūjakaiḥ ..
ṣaḍakṣaramahodgāraparamānandapūritaiḥ .. 49 ..
5.240.d:
क्षमादिगुणसंयुक्तैर्द्वादशाक्षरपूजकैः ..
षडक्षरमहोद्गारपरमानन्दपूरितैः .. 49 ..
5.240.m: endowed with forbearance and other virtues, worshipers of the twelve-syllable [mantra], / and filled with supreme bliss by the great utterance of the six syllables.

5.240.s:
sadapatyaiḥ sadācāraiḥ satāṃ śuśrūṣaṇairapi ..
vimatsaraiḥ sadā stheyaṃ tāpakleśavivarjitaiḥ .. 6.241.50 ..
5.240.d:
सदपत्यैः सदाचारैः सतां शुश्रूषणैरपि ..
विमत्सरैः सदा स्थेयं तापक्लेशविवर्जितैः .. 6.241.50 ..
5.240.m: With good children, of good conduct, serving the virtuous, / free from malice, they should always live free from the affliction of suffering.

5.240.s:
pravrajyāvarjanairevaṃ sacchūdrairdharmatatparaiḥ ..
toṣaṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kāryaṃ vittānusārataḥ .. 51 ..
5.240.d:
प्रव्रज्यावर्जनैरेवं सच्छूद्रैर्धर्मतत्परैः ..
तोषणं सर्वभूतानां कार्यं वित्तानुसारतः .. 51 ..
5.240.m: Thus, avoiding wandering asceticism, virtuous Śūdras devoted to dharma / should bring satisfaction to all beings according to their wealth.

5.240.s:
sadā viṣṇuśivādīnāṃ ye bhaktāste narāḥ sadā ..
devavaddivi dīvyaṃti cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 52 ..
5.240.d:
सदा विष्णुशिवादीनां ये भक्तास्ते नराः सदा ..
देववद्दिवि दीव्यंति चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः .. 52 ..
5.240.m: Those men who are constantly devoted to Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the other deities / always sport like gods in heaven, especially [by vows] during Cāturmāsya.

5.240.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāna brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye tapo'dhikāre sacchūdrakathanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 241 ..
5.240.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वर क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शेषशाय्युपाख्यान ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे चातुर्मास्यमाहात्म्ये तपोऽधिकारे सच्छूद्रकथनंनामैकचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 241 ..
5.240.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-first chapter, entitled 'Discourse on the Virtuous Śūdra' in the section on austerity, in the praise of Cāturmāsya, in the dialogue between Brahmā and Nārada in the narrative of Śeṣaśāyin, in the praise of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.241.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
nārada uvāca .. ..
aṣṭādaśa prakṛtayaḥ kā vadasva pitāmaha ..
vṛttistāsāṃ ca ko dharmaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato mama .. 1 .. ..
5.241.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
नारद उवाच .. ..
अष्टादश प्रकृतयः का वदस्व पितामह ..
वृत्तिस्तासां च को धर्मः सर्वं विस्तरतो मम .. 1 .. ..
5.241.m: The seers said: / Nārada said: / Speak, O Grandfather! What are the eighteen dependent classes, / and what is their livelihood and dharma? Tell me everything in detail.

5.241.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
majjanmābhūdbhagavato nābhipaṃkajakośataḥ ..
svakālaparimāṇena prabuddhasya jagatpateḥ .. 2 ..
5.241.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मज्जन्माभूद्भगवतो नाभिपंकजकोशतः ..
स्वकालपरिमाणेन प्रबुद्धस्य जगत्पतेः .. 2 ..
5.241.m: Brahmā said: / My birth took place from the calyx of the navel-lotus of the Lord, / the Master of the universe, who had awakened according to the measure of His own time.

5.241.s:
tato bahutithe kāle keśavena purā smṛtaḥ ..
sraṣṭukāmena vividhāḥ prajā manasi rājasīḥ .. 3 ..
5.241.d:
ततो बहुतिथे काले केशवेन पुरा स्मृतः ..
स्रष्टुकामेन विविधाः प्रजा मनसि राजसीः .. 3 ..
5.241.m: Then, long ago, after a long span of time, Keśava remembered [me], / desiring in His mind to create various creatures dominated by the quality of passion.

5.241.s:
ahaṃ kamalajastatra jātaḥ putraścaturmukhaḥ ..
udaraṃ nābhinālena praviśyātha vyalokayam .. 4 ..
5.241.d:
अहं कमलजस्तत्र जातः पुत्रश्चतुर्मुखः ..
उदरं नाभिनालेन प्रविश्याथ व्यलोकयम् .. 4 ..
5.241.m: I, the lotus-born, four-faced son, was born there. / Having entered the belly through the stalk of the navel, I then looked around.

5.241.s:
tatra brahmāṃḍakoṭīnāṃ darśanaṃ me'bhavatpunaḥ ..
vismayācciṃtayānasya sṛṣṭyarthamabhidhāvatā .. 5 ..
5.241.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मांडकोटीनां दर्शनं मेऽभवत्पुनः ..
विस्मयाच्चिंतयानस्य सृष्ट्यर्थमभिधावता .. 5 ..
5.241.m: There I had a vision of tens of millions of cosmic eggs. / Filled with wonder, running about for the purpose of creation as I contemplated,

5.241.s:
nirgamya punarevāhaṃ padmanālena yāvatā ..
bahirāgāṃ vismṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ sṛṣṭyarthakāraṇam .. 6 ..
5.241.d:
निर्गम्य पुनरेवाहं पद्मनालेन यावता ..
बहिरागां विस्मृतं तत्सर्वं सृष्ट्यर्थकारणम् .. 6 ..
5.241.m: I came out again through the lotus stalk, / but as soon as I emerged outside, I forgot all the means for the purpose of creation.

5.241.s:
punareva tato gatvā prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā caturvidhāḥ ..
nābhinālena nirgatya vismṛtenāṃtarātmanā .. 7 ..
5.241.d:
पुनरेव ततो गत्वा प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा चतुर्विधाः ..
नाभिनालेन निर्गत्य विस्मृतेनांतरात्मना .. 7 ..
5.241.m: Then, having gone once more and created the fourfold creatures, / I emerged through the navel-stalk with an inner mind that had forgotten.

5.241.s:
tadāhaṃ jaḍavajjāto vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
tapastapa mahābuddhe jaḍatvaṃ nocitaṃ tava .. 8 ..
5.241.d:
तदाहं जडवज्जातो वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
तपस्तप महाबुद्धे जडत्वं नोचितं तव .. 8 ..
5.241.m: Then I became like one inert, and a bodiless voice spoke: / 'Perform austerity, O greatly intelligent one! Inertia is not suitable for you.'

5.241.s:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tato'haṃ tapa āsthitaḥ..
punarākāśajā vāṇī māmuvācāvinaśvarā .. 9 ..
5.241.d:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि ततोऽहं तप आस्थितः..
पुनराकाशजा वाणी मामुवाचाविनश्वरा .. 9 ..
5.241.m: Thereupon I undertook austerity for ten thousand years. / Then an imperishable voice arising from the sky spoke to me again,

5.241.s:
vedarūpāśritā pūrvamāvirbhūtā tapobalāt ..
tato bhagavatā''diṣṭaḥ sṛja tvaṃ bahudhā prajāḥ .. 6.242.10 ..
5.241.d:
वेदरूपाश्रिता पूर्वमाविर्भूता तपोबलात् ..
ततो भगवता'ऽदिष्टः सृज त्वं बहुधा प्रजाः .. 6.242.10 ..
5.241.m: manifesting through the power of austerity, having previously taken refuge in the form of the Veda. / Then I was commanded by the Lord: 'Create creatures in many forms!

5.241.s:
rājasaṃ guṇamāśritya bhūtasargamakalmaṣam ..
manasā mānasī sṛṣṭiḥ prathamaṃ ciṃtitā mayā .. 11 ..
5.241.d:
राजसं गुणमाश्रित्य भूतसर्गमकल्मषम् ..
मनसा मानसी सृष्टिः प्रथमं चिंतिता मया .. 11 ..
5.241.m: Having resorted to the quality of passion, [create] the faultless creation of beings.' / At first, a mental creation was conceived by me through the mind.

5.241.s:
tato vai brāhmaṇā jātā marīcyādimunīśvarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kanīyāṃstvaṃ jāto jñānavedāṃtapāragaḥ .. 12 ..
5.241.d:
ततो वै ब्राह्मणा जाता मरीच्यादिमुनीश्वराः ..
तेषां कनीयांस्त्वं जातो ज्ञानवेदांतपारगः .. 12 ..
5.241.m: From that, indeed, brahmins were born, the lords of sages headed by Marīci. / You were born as the youngest of them, having traversed knowledge and Vedānta.

5.241.s:
karmaniṣṭhāśca te nityaṃ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ satatodyatāḥ ..
nirvyāpāro viṣṇubhakta ekāṃtabrahmasevakaḥ .. 13 ..
5.241.d:
कर्मनिष्ठाश्च ते नित्यं सृष्ट्यर्थं सततोद्यताः ..
निर्व्यापारो विष्णुभक्त एकांतब्रह्मसेवकः .. 13 ..
5.241.m: They are devoted to action and ever striving for creation; / you are free from worldly engagement, a devotee of Viṣṇu, serving Brahman in solitude,

5.241.s:
nirmamo nirahaṃkāro mama tvaṃ mānasaḥ sutaḥ ..
kramānmayā tu teṣāṃ vai vedarakṣārthameva ca .. 14 ..
5.241.d:
निर्ममो निरहंकारो मम त्वं मानसः सुतः ..
क्रमान्मया तु तेषां वै वेदरक्षार्थमेव च .. 14 ..
5.241.m: free from possessiveness, free from egotism, my mind-born son. / Then, in due order, for the purpose of protecting the Vedas for them,

5.241.s:
prathamā mānasī sṛṣṭirdvijātyādirvinirmitā ..
tatohamāṃgikīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sṛṣṭavāṃstatra nārada .. 15 ..
5.241.d:
प्रथमा मानसी सृष्टिर्द्विजात्यादिर्विनिर्मिता ..
ततोहमांगिकीं सृष्टिं सृष्टवांस्तत्र नारद .. 15 ..
5.241.m: the first mental creation of the twice-born classes and others was fashioned by me. / Then, O Nārada, I produced the bodily creation there.

5.241.s:
mukhācca brāhmaṇā jātā bāhubhyaḥ kṣatriyā mama ..
vaiśyā ūrusamudbhūtāḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrā babhūvire .. 16 ..
5.241.d:
मुखाच्च ब्राह्मणा जाता बाहुभ्यः क्षत्रिया मम ..
वैश्या ऊरुसमुद्भूताः पद्भ्यां शूद्रा बभूविरे .. 16 ..
5.241.m: Brahmins were born from my mouth, and Kṣatriyas from my arms; / Vaiśyas arose from my thighs, and Śūdras were born from my feet.

5.241.s:
anulomavilomābhya āṃkramācca kramayogataḥ ..
śūdrādadho'dho jātāśca sarve pādatalodbhavāḥ .. 17 ..
5.241.d:
अनुलोमविलोमाभ्य आंक्रमाच्च क्रमयोगतः ..
शूद्रादधोऽधो जाताश्च सर्वे पादतलोद्भवाः .. 17 ..
5.241.m: Through direct and reverse order, systematically and in due course, / those born lower and lower than the Śūdra all arose from the soles of the feet.

5.241.s:
tāḥ sarvāstu prakṛtayo mama dehāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ ..
nārada tvaṃ vijānīhi tāsāṃ nāmāni vacmi te .. 19 ..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastraya eva dvijātayaḥ ..
vedāstapo'dhyayanaṃ ca yajanaṃ dānameva ca .. 19 ..
5.241.d:
ताः सर्वास्तु प्रकृतयो मम देहांशसंभवाः ..
नारद त्वं विजानीहि तासां नामानि वच्मि ते .. 19 ..
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यस्त्रय एव द्विजातयः ..
वेदास्तपोऽध्ययनं च यजनं दानमेव च .. 19 ..
5.241.m:
All those dependent classes originated from parts of my body. / Understand this, O Nārada; I shall tell you their names.
The brahmin, the Kṣatriya, and the Vaiśya: these three are the twice-born. / Their [practices are] the Vedas, austerity, study, sacrificing, and also giving gifts.

5.241.s:
vṛttiradhyāpanāccaiva tathā svalpapratigrahāt ..
vipraḥ samarthastapasā yadyapi syātpratigrahe .. 6.242.20 ..
5.241.d:
वृत्तिरध्यापनाच्चैव तथा स्वल्पप्रतिग्रहात् ..
विप्रः समर्थस्तपसा यद्यपि स्यात्प्रतिग्रहे .. 6.242.20 ..
5.241.m: His livelihood is from teaching and from small gifts of acceptance. / Even if a brahmin is capable of receiving gifts on account of his austerity,

5.241.s:
tathāpi naiva gṛhṇīyāttaporakṣā yataḥ sadā ..
vedapāṭho viṣṇupūjā brahmadhyānamalobhatā .. 21 ..
5.241.d:
तथापि नैव गृह्णीयात्तपोरक्षा यतः सदा ..
वेदपाठो विष्णुपूजा ब्रह्मध्यानमलोभता .. 21 ..
5.241.m: he should still not accept them, since the preservation of austerity is always [paramount]. / Recitation of the Veda, worship of Viṣṇu, meditation on Brahman, freedom from greed,

5.241.s:
akrodhatā nirmalatvaṃ kṣamāsāratvamāryatā ..
kriyātatparatā dānakriyā satyādibhirguṇaiḥ .. 22 ..
5.241.d:
अक्रोधता निर्मलत्वं क्षमासारत्वमार्यता ..
क्रियातत्परता दानक्रिया सत्यादिभिर्गुणैः .. 22 ..
5.241.m: freedom from anger, purity, essential forbearance, nobility, / devotion to ritual acts, the practice of charity, and the qualities of truth and the like—

5.241.s:
bhūṣito yo bhavennityaṃ sa vipra iti kathyate ..
kṣatriyeṇa tapaḥ kāryaṃ yajanaṃ dānameva ca .. 23 ..
5.241.d:
भूषितो यो भवेन्नित्यं स विप्र इति कथ्यते ..
क्षत्रियेण तपः कार्यं यजनं दानमेव च .. 23 ..
5.241.m: he who is constantly adorned with these is called a brahmin. / By a Kṣatriya, austerity must be performed, as well as sacrificing and the giving of gifts,

5.241.s:
vedapāṭho viprabhaktireṣāṃ śastreṇa jīvanam..
strībālagobrāhmaṇārthe bhūmyarthe svāmisaṃkaṭe .. 24 ..
5.241.d:
वेदपाठो विप्रभक्तिरेषां शस्त्रेण जीवनम्..
स्त्रीबालगोब्राह्मणार्थे भूम्यर्थे स्वामिसंकटे .. 24 ..
5.241.m: recitation of the Veda, and devotion to brahmins; their livelihood is by weapons / for women, children, cows, and brahmins, for the sake of the land, and in crisis to their lord,

5.241.s:
saṃpratiśaraṇaṃ caiva pīḍitānāṃ ca śabdite ..
ārtatrāṇaparā ye ca kṣatriyā brahmaṇā kṛtāḥ .. 25 ..
5.241.d:
संप्रतिशरणं चैव पीडितानां च शब्दिते ..
आर्तत्राणपरा ये च क्षत्रिया ब्रह्मणा कृताः .. 25 ..
5.241.m: and also offering refuge at once when the cry of the afflicted sounds; / those devoted to rescuing the distressed were made Kṣatriyas by Brahmā.

5.241.s:
dhanavṛddhikaro vaiśyaḥ paśupālaḥ kṛṣīvalaḥ ..
rasādīnāṃ ca vikretā devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ .. 26 ..
5.241.d:
धनवृद्धिकरो वैश्यः पशुपालः कृषीवलः ..
रसादीनां च विक्रेता देवब्राह्मणपूजकः .. 26 ..
5.241.m: The Vaiśya increases wealth, tends cattle, practices agriculture, / sells liquids and the like, and worships gods and brahmins.

5.241.s:
arthavṛddhikaro vyājā yajñakarmādikārakaḥ ..
dānamadhyayanaṃ ceti vaiśyavṛttirudāhṛtā .. 27 ..
5.241.d:
अर्थवृद्धिकरो व्याजा यज्ञकर्मादिकारकः ..
दानमध्ययनं चेति वैश्यवृत्तिरुदाहृता .. 27 ..
5.241.m: Increasing wealth through lending, performing sacrifices and the like, / giving, and study: this is declared to be the livelihood of a Vaiśya.

5.241.s:
etānyeva hyamaṃtrāṇi śūdraḥ kārayate sadā ..
nityaṃ ṣaḍdaivataṃ śrāddhaṃ hantakāro'gni tarpaṇam.. 28 ..
5.241.d:
एतान्येव ह्यमंत्राणि शूद्रः कारयते सदा ..
नित्यं षड्दैवतं श्राद्धं हन्तकारोऽग्नि तर्पणम्.. 28 ..
5.241.m: A Śūdra always has these very acts performed without mantras: / the daily śrāddha to six deities, the portion of food given to guests, and oblations to the fire.

5.241.s:
devadvijātibhaktiśca namaskāreṇa siddhyati ..
śūdro'pi prātarutthāya kṛtvā pādābhivaṃdanam .. 29 ..
5.241.d:
देवद्विजातिभक्तिश्च नमस्कारेण सिद्ध्यति ..
शूद्रोऽपि प्रातरुत्थाय कृत्वा पादाभिवंदनम् .. 29 ..
5.241.m: Devotion to gods and twice-born persons is accomplished through prostration. / Even a Śūdra, rising early in the morning and performing salutation at the feet [of superiors],

5.241.s:
viṣṇubhaktimayāñślokānpaṭhanviṣṇutvamāpnuyāt..
vārṣikavratakṛnnityaṃ tithivārādhidaivataḥ .. 6.242.30 ..
5.241.d:
विष्णुभक्तिमयाञ्श्लोकान्पठन्विष्णुत्वमाप्नुयात्..
वार्षिकव्रतकृन्नित्यं तिथिवाराधिदैवतः .. 6.242.30 ..
5.241.m: and reciting verses full of devotion to Viṣṇu, can attain Viṣṇuhood. / Constantly observing annual vows, [honoring] the presiding deities of lunar days and days of the week,

5.241.s:
annadaḥ sarvajīvānāṃ gṛhasthaḥ śūdra īritaḥ ..
amaṃtrāṇyapi karmāṇi kurvanneva hi mucyate .. 31 ..
5.241.d:
अन्नदः सर्वजीवानां गृहस्थः शूद्र ईरितः ..
अमंत्राण्यपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्नेव हि मुच्यते .. 31 ..
5.241.m: giving food to all living beings, the householder is said to be a [virtuous] Śūdra. / Performing duties even without mantras, he is indeed liberated.

5.241.s:
cāturmāsyavratakaraḥ śūdro'pi haritāṃ vrajet ..
śilpī ca nartakaścaiva kāṣṭhakāraḥ prajāpatiḥ .. 32 ..
5.241.d:
चातुर्मास्यव्रतकरः शूद्रोऽपि हरितां व्रजेत् ..
शिल्पी च नर्तकश्चैव काष्ठकारः प्रजापतिः .. 32 ..
5.241.m: Even a Śūdra who observes vows during Cāturmāsya attains state of Hari. / An artisan, a dancer, a carpenter, a potter,

5.241.s:
vardhakiścitrakaścaiva sūtrako rajakastathā ..
gacchakastantukāraśca cakrikaścarmakārakaḥ .. 33 ..
5.241.d:
वर्धकिश्चित्रकश्चैव सूत्रको रजकस्तथा ..
गच्छकस्तन्तुकारश्च चक्रिकश्चर्मकारकः .. 33 ..
5.241.m: a woodworker, a painter, a weaver, a washerman, / a reed-worker, a spinner, an oilman, a leatherworker,

5.241.s:
sūniko dhvanikaścaiva kaulhiko matsyaghātakaḥ ..
aunāmikastu caṃḍālaḥ prakṛtyāṣṭādaśaiva te .. 34 ..
5.241.d:
सूनिको ध्वनिकश्चैव कौल्हिको मत्स्यघातकः ..
औनामिकस्तु चंडालः प्रकृत्याष्टादशैव ते .. 34 ..
5.241.m: a butcher, a musician, a potter/distiller, a fisherman, / a basket-maker, and a caṇḍāla: these are the eighteen dependent classes.

5.241.s:
śilpikaḥ svarṇakārakaśca dārukaḥ kāṃsyakārakaḥ ..
kāḍukaḥ kumbhakāraśca prakṛtyā uttamāśca ṣaṭ .. 35 ..
5.241.d:
शिल्पिकः स्वर्णकारकश्च दारुकः कांस्यकारकः ..
काडुकः कुम्भकारश्च प्रकृत्या उत्तमाश्च षट् .. 35 ..
5.241.m: The craft-artisan, goldsmith, woodcutter, brazier, / iron-worker, and potter are the six highest among the dependent classes.

5.241.s:
kharavāhyuṣṭravāhī hayavāhī tathaiva ca ..
gopāla iṣṭikākāro adhamādhamapañcakam .. 36 ..
5.241.d:
खरवाह्युष्ट्रवाही हयवाही तथैव च ..
गोपाल इष्टिकाकारो अधमाधमपञ्चकम् .. 36 ..
5.241.m: The donkey-carrier, camel-carrier, horse-carrier, / cowherd, and brickmaker are the five lowest of the low.

5.241.s:
rajakaścarmakāraśca naṭo buruḍa eva ca ..
kaivarttamedabhillāśca saptaite antyajāḥ smṛtāḥ ..37..
5.241.d:
रजकश्चर्मकारश्च नटो बुरुड एव च ..
कैवर्त्तमेदभिल्लाश्च सप्तैते अन्त्यजाः स्मृताः ..37..
5.241.m: The washerman, leatherworker, actor, reed-worker, / fisherman, Meda, and Bhilla: these seven are remembered as outcasts.

5.241.s:
yo yasya hīno varṇena sa cāṣṭādaśamo naraḥ ..
sarvāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca uttamā madhyamāḥ samāḥ ..38..
5.241.d:
यो यस्य हीनो वर्णेन स चाष्टादशमो नरः ..
सर्वासां प्रकृतीनां च उत्तमा मध्यमाः समाः ..38..
5.241.m: Whosoever is lower by caste than each is the eighteenth person. / Among all these dependent classes, there are high, middle, and equal:

5.241.s:
bhedāstrayaḥ samākhyātā vijñeyāḥ smṛtinirṇayāt ..
śilpinaḥ sapta vijñeyā uttamāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
5.241.d:
भेदास्त्रयः समाख्याता विज्ञेयाः स्मृतिनिर्णयात् ..
शिल्पिनः सप्त विज्ञेया उत्तमाः समुदाहृताः .. 39 ..
5.241.m: three divisions are declared, to be known from the determination of the Smṛtis. / Seven artisans are to be known and proclaimed as the highest.

5.241.s:
svarṇakṛtkaṃbukaścaiva tandulīpuṣpalāvakaḥ ..
tāṃbūlī nāpitaścaiva maṇikāraśca saptadhā .. 6.242.40 ..
5.241.d:
स्वर्णकृत्कंबुकश्चैव तन्दुलीपुष्पलावकः ..
तांबूली नापितश्चैव मणिकारश्च सप्तधा .. 6.242.40 ..
5.241.m: The goldsmith, the shell-cutter, the grain-cleaner, the flower-gatherer, / the betel-seller, the barber, and the jeweler—these are the sevenfold classes. [6.242.40]

5.241.s:
na snānaṃ devatāhomastaponiyama eva ca ..
na svādhyāyavaṣaṭkārau na ca śuddhirvivāhitā .. 41 ..
5.241.d:
न स्नानं देवताहोमस्तपोनियम एव च ..
न स्वाध्यायवषट्कारौ न च शुद्धिर्विवाहिता .. 41 ..
5.241.m: There is no [obligatory] ritual ablution, no oblation to deities, no austerity or religious vow, / no Vedic recitation, no vaṣaṭ-utterance, and no purification through marriage. [41]

5.241.s:
etāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca gurupūjā sadoditā ..
viprāṇāṃ prākṛto nityaṃ dānameva paro vidhiḥ .. 42 ..
5.241.d:
एतासां प्रकृतीनां च गुरुपूजा सदोदिता ..
विप्राणां प्राकृतो नित्यं दानमेव परो विधिः .. 42 ..
5.241.m: For these ordinary folks, worship of the guru is always proclaimed; / for these common people, giving gifts continually to brahmins is the supreme rule. [42]

5.241.s:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ mahāmune ..
sarvāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca viṣṇubhaktiḥ sadā śubhā .. 43 ..
5.241.d:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानामाश्रमाणां महामुने ..
सर्वासां प्रकृतीनां च विष्णुभक्तिः सदा शुभा .. 43 ..
5.241.m: For all classes and stages of life, O great sage, / and for all the common people, devotion to Viṣṇu is always auspicious. [43]

5.241.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathāprakṛtisaṃbhavam ..
kathāṃ śṛṇu mahāpuṇyāṃ śūdraḥ śuddhimagādyathā .. 44 ..
5.241.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वं यथाप्रकृतिसंभवम् ..
कथां शृणु महापुण्यां शूद्रः शुद्धिमगाद्यथा .. 44 ..
5.241.m: Thus all has been told to you according to the origin of the common folk. / Now hear the exceedingly meritorious tale of how a śūdra attained purity. [44]

5.241.s:
idaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ viśuddhadhīryastu śṛṇoti vā paṭhet ..
vidhūya pāpāni purārjitāni sa yāti viṣṇorbhavanaṃ kriyāparaḥ .. 45 ..
5.241.d:
इदं पुराणं परमं पवित्रं विशुद्धधीर्यस्तु शृणोति वा पठेत् ..
विधूय पापानि पुरार्जितानि स याति विष्णोर्भवनं क्रियापरः .. 45 ..
5.241.m: Whoever, with a purified mind, listens to or recites this supreme, holy Purāṇa, / shaking off sins accumulated in past lives and devoted to pious acts, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu. [45]

5.241.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye'ṣṭādaśaprakṛtikathanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 242 ..
5.241.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शेषशाय्युपाख्याने ब्रह्मनारदसंवादे चातुर्मास्यमाहात्म्येऽष्टादशप्रकृतिकथनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 242 ..
5.241.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-second chapter, entitled 'The Explanation of the Eighteen Folk Classes', in the context of the eulogy of the four-month vow, in the dialogue between Brahmā and Nārada, within the story of Śeṣaśāyin, in the praise of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. [242]

5.242.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
śūdraḥ paijavanonāma gārhasthyācchuddhimāptavān ..
dharmamārgāvirodhena tannibodha mahāmate .. 1 ..
5.242.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
शूद्रः पैजवनोनाम गार्हस्थ्याच्छुद्धिमाप्तवान् ..
धर्ममार्गाविरोधेन तन्निबोध महामते .. 1 ..
5.242.m: Brahmā said: / A śūdra named Paijavana attained purification through household life, / without conflicting with the path of righteousness; understand that, O wise one. [1]

5.242.s:
āsītpaijavanaḥ śūdraḥ purā tretāyuge kila ..
svadharmanirataḥ khyāto viṣṇubrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ .. 2 ..
5.242.d:
आसीत्पैजवनः शूद्रः पुरा त्रेतायुगे किल ..
स्वधर्मनिरतः ख्यातो विष्णुब्राह्मणपूजकः .. 2 ..
5.242.m: Formerly in the Tretāyuga, indeed, there was a śūdra named Paijavana, / renowned, devoted to his own duty, a worshiper of Viṣṇu and brahmins. [2]

5.242.s:
nyāyāgatadhano nityaṃ śāṃtaḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ ..
satyavādī vivekajñastasya bhāryā ca sundarī .. 3 ..
5.242.d:
न्यायागतधनो नित्यं शांतः सर्वजनप्रियः ..
सत्यवादी विवेकज्ञस्तस्य भार्या च सुन्दरी .. 3 ..
5.242.m: His wealth was always justly acquired; he was calm, dear to all people, / truthful, possessing discrimination, and his wife was beautiful. [3]

5.242.s:
dharmoḍhā vedavidhinā samānakulajā śubhā ..
pativratā mahābhāgā devadvijahite ratā .. .. 4 ..
5.242.d:
धर्मोढा वेदविधिना समानकुलजा शुभा ..
पतिव्रता महाभागा देवद्विजहिते रता .. .. 4 ..
5.242.m: She was married lawfully by the Vedic rite, born of an equal family, auspicious, / devoted to her husband, highly fortunate, and intent on the welfare of gods and brahmins. [4]

5.242.s:
kāśyāṃ saṃbaṃdhitā bālā vaijayaṃtyāṃ vivāhitā ..
sā dharmācaraṇe dakṣā vaiṣṇavavratacāriṇī .. 5 ..
5.242.d:
काश्यां संबंधिता बाला वैजयंत्यां विवाहिता ..
सा धर्माचरणे दक्षा वैष्णवव्रतचारिणी .. 5 ..
5.242.m: Betrothed in Kāśī, the maiden was married in Vaijayantī; / she was skilled in the practice of dharma and observant of the Vaiṣṇava vows. [5]

5.242.s:
bhartrā saha tathā samyakcikrīḍe suvinītavat ..
so'pi reme tayā kāle hastinyeva mahāgajaḥ ..6..
5.242.d:
भर्त्रा सह तथा सम्यक्चिक्रीडे सुविनीतवत् ..
सोऽपि रेमे तया काले हस्तिन्येव महागजः ..6..
5.242.m: She sported suitably with her husband, well-disciplined; / he too took delight in her at the proper season, like a great tusker with a female elephant. [6]

5.242.s:
arthāptiḥ pūrvapuṇyena jātā tasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vāṇijyaṃ svajanairnityaṃ svadeśaparadeśajam .. ..7..
5.242.d:
अर्थाप्तिः पूर्वपुण्येन जाता तस्य महात्मनः ..
वाणिज्यं स्वजनैर्नित्यं स्वदेशपरदेशजम् .. ..7..
5.242.m: Through his past merit, the acquisition of wealth came to that great-souled man; / through his kinsmen, he always engaged in trade, domestic and foreign. [7]

5.242.s:
kārayatyarthajātaiśca parakīyasvakīyajaiḥ ..
evamarthaśca bahudhā saṃjāto dharmadarśinaḥ .. 8 ..
5.242.d:
कारयत्यर्थजातैश्च परकीयस्वकीयजैः ..
एवमर्थश्च बहुधा संजातो धर्मदर्शिनः .. 8 ..
5.242.m: He had it carried out with properties belonging to others and to himself; / thus wealth accrued in many ways to that seer of dharma. [8]

5.242.s:
putratrayaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ pituḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratam ..
tasya putrāḥ piturbhaktā dravyādimadavarjitāḥ .. 9 ..
5.242.d:
पुत्रत्रयं च संजातं पितुः शुश्रूषणे रतम् ..
तस्य पुत्राः पितुर्भक्ता द्रव्यादिमदवर्जिताः .. 9 ..
5.242.m: Three sons were born to him, intent on serving their father; / his sons were devoted to their father, free from the arrogance of wealth and the like. [9]

5.242.s:
pitṛvākyaratāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ svadharmācāraśobhanāḥ ..
pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇādanyannābhinaṃdaṃti kiṃcana ..6.243.10..
5.242.d:
पितृवाक्यरताः श्रेष्ठाः स्वधर्माचारशोभनाः ..
पित्रोः शुश्रूषणादन्यन्नाभिनंदंति किंचन ..6.243.10..
5.242.m: They were devoted to their father's word, excellent, splendid in their adherence to their own duty; / they rejoiced in nothing other than the service of their parents. [6.243.10]

5.242.s:
te sambandhaiḥ susaṃbaddhāḥ pitrā dharmārthadarśinā ..
tatpatnyo mātṛpitrarcāṃ kārayaṃtyanivāritam .. 11 ..
5.242.d:
ते सम्बन्धैः सुसंबद्धाः पित्रा धर्मार्थदर्शिना ..
तत्पत्न्यो मातृपित्रर्चां कारयंत्यनिवारितम् .. 11 ..
5.242.m: They were well united in marriage alliances by their father, who saw dharma and wealth; / their wives incessantly saw to the veneration of their mother and father. [11]

5.242.s:
ṛddhimadbhavanaṃ tasya dhanadhānyasamanvitam ..
so'pi dharmarato nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ .. 12 ..
5.242.d:
ऋद्धिमद्भवनं तस्य धनधान्यसमन्वितम् ..
सोऽपि धर्मरतो नित्यं देवतातिथिपूजकः .. 12 ..
5.242.m: His mansion was prosperous, endowed with wealth and grain; / he too was constantly devoted to dharma, a worshiper of deities and guests. [12]

5.242.s:
gṛhāgato na vimukho yasya jātu kadācana ..
śītakāle dhanaṃ prādāduṣṇakāle jalānnadaḥ .. 13 ..
5.242.d:
गृहागतो न विमुखो यस्य जातु कदाचन ..
शीतकाले धनं प्रादादुष्णकाले जलान्नदः .. 13 ..
5.242.m: No one who came to his house was ever turned away disappointed; / in the cold season he gave money, and in the hot season he provided water and food. [13]

5.242.s:
varṣā kāle vastradaśca babhūvānnapradaḥ sadā ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgādiprapādevagṛhāṇi ca .. 14 ..
5.242.d:
वर्षा काले वस्त्रदश्च बभूवान्नप्रदः सदा ..
वापीकूपतडागादिप्रपादेवगृहाणि च .. 14 ..
5.242.m: In the rainy season he gave clothes, and he was an eternal giver of food; / stepped wells, wells, ponds, cisterns, and temples [14]

5.242.s:
kārayatyucite kāle śivaviṣṇuvratasthitaḥ ..
iṣṭadharmastu varṇānāṃ samācīrṇo mahāphalaḥ .. 15 ..
5.242.d:
कारयत्युचिते काले शिवविष्णुव्रतस्थितः ..
इष्टधर्मस्तु वर्णानां समाचीर्णो महाफलः .. 15 ..
5.242.m: he caused to be built at the appropriate time, steadfast in vows to Śiva and Viṣṇu. / The sacrificial duty practiced by the classes yields great fruit; [15]

5.242.s:
anyeṣāṃ pūrtadharmāṇāṃ teṣāṃ pūrtakaraḥ sadā ..
sa babhūva dhanāḍhyopi vyasanairna samāśritaḥ .. 16 ..
5.242.d:
अन्येषां पूर्तधर्माणां तेषां पूर्तकरः सदा ..
स बभूव धनाढ्योपि व्यसनैर्न समाश्रितः .. 16 ..
5.242.m: he was always the performer of the acts of public charity for those other duties of that kind. / Even though rich, he was not afflicted by vices. [16]

5.242.s:
viṣṇubhaktirato nityaṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ..18..
ekadā gālavamuniḥ śiṣyairbahubhirāvṛtaḥ .. 17 ..
brahmajñānarataḥ śāṃtastaponiṣṭho mahāvaśī ..
abhyājagāma śūdrasya gehe paijavanasya saḥ .. 18 ..
5.242.d:
विष्णुभक्तिरतो नित्यं चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः ..18..
एकदा गालवमुनिः शिष्यैर्बहुभिरावृतः .. 17 ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानरतः शांतस्तपोनिष्ठो महावशी ..
अभ्याजगाम शूद्रस्य गेहे पैजवनस्य सः .. 18 ..
5.242.m:
He was continually devoted to devotion to Viṣṇu, especially during the four-month observance. [18]
Once the sage Gālava, surrounded by many disciples, [17]
delighting in knowledge of Brahman, calm, steadfast in austerity, of great self-control, / arrived at the house of the śūdra Paijavana. [18]

5.242.s:
sa vāgbhirmadhubhistasya abhyutthānāsanādibhiḥ ..
upacāraiḥ punaryuktaḥ kṛtārtha iva mānayan .. 19 ..
5.242.d:
स वाग्भिर्मधुभिस्तस्य अभ्युत्थानासनादिभिः ..
उपचारैः पुनर्युक्तः कृतार्थ इव मानयन् .. 19 ..
5.242.m: He, welcoming him with sweet words, by rising to meet him, offering a seat, and the like, / along with services, deemed himself fulfilled. [19]

5.242.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma jātaṃ jīvitamuttamam ..
adya me saphalo dharmaḥ kuśalaścoddhṛtastvayā .. 6.243.20 ..
5.242.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जातं जीवितमुत्तमम् ..
अद्य मे सफलो धर्मः कुशलश्चोद्धृतस्त्वया .. 6.243.20 ..
5.242.m: 'Today my birth has become fruitful; my life has become excellent; / today my dharma has borne fruit, and my welfare has been elevated by you. [6.243.20]

5.242.s:
mama pāpasahasrāṇi dṛṣṭyā dagdhāni te mune ..
gṛhaṃ mama gṛhasthasya sakalaṃ pāvitaṃ tvayā .. 21 ..
5.242.d:
मम पापसहस्राणि दृष्ट्या दग्धानि ते मुने ..
गृहं मम गृहस्थस्य सकलं पावितं त्वया .. 21 ..
5.242.m: My thousands of sins have been burnt away by your sight, O sage; / my entire house as a householder has been purified by you.' [21]

5.242.s:
tasya bhaktyā prasanno'bhūdgatamārgapariśramaḥ ..
uvāca muniśārdūlaḥ sacchūdraṃ taṃ kṛtāṃjalim .. 22 ..
5.242.d:
तस्य भक्त्या प्रसन्नोऽभूद्गतमार्गपरिश्रमः ..
उवाच मुनिशार्दूलः सच्छूद्रं तं कृतांजलिम् .. 22 ..
5.242.m: Pleased with his devotion, his fatigue from the road gone, / the tiger among sages spoke to that virtuous śūdra whose hands were joined: [22]

5.242.s:
kaccitte kuśalaṃ saumya mano dharme pravartate ..
arthānubaṃdhāḥ satataṃ bandhudārasutādayaḥ .1 23 ..
5.242.d:
कच्चित्ते कुशलं सौम्य मनो धर्मे प्रवर्तते ..
अर्थानुबंधाः सततं बन्धुदारसुतादयः .1 23 ..
5.242.m: 'Is it well with you, gentle one? Does your mind turn to dharma? / Are your kinsmen, wife, sons, and others constantly attached to wealth? [23]

5.242.s:
govinde satataṃ bhaktistathā dāne pravartate ..
dharmārthakāma kāryeṣu saprabhāvaṃ manastava .. 24 ..
5.242.d:
गोविन्दे सततं भक्तिस्तथा दाने प्रवर्तते ..
धर्मार्थकाम कार्येषु सप्रभावं मनस्तव .. 24 ..
5.242.m: Does devotion continually turn toward Govinda, and likewise toward giving? / In the pursuits of dharma, wealth, and pleasure, is your mind powerful? [24]

5.242.s:
viṣṇupādodakaṃ nityaṃ śirasā dhāryate na vā ..
pādodbhavaṃ ca gaṃgodaṃ dvādaśābdaphalapradam .. 25 ..
5.242.d:
विष्णुपादोदकं नित्यं शिरसा धार्यते न वा ..
पादोद्भवं च गंगोदं द्वादशाब्दफलप्रदम् .. 25 ..
5.242.m: Is the water from Viṣṇu's feet constantly borne upon your head or not? / And the water of the Gaṅgā, originating from his foot, gives the fruit of twelve years; [25]

5.242.s:
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tatphalaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ..
haribhaktirharikathā haristotraṃ harernatiḥ .. 26 ..
5.242.d:
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण तत्फलं द्विगुणं भवेत् ..
हरिभक्तिर्हरिकथा हरिस्तोत्रं हरेर्नतिः .. 26 ..
5.242.m: especially during the four-month observance, that fruit becomes twofold. / Devotion to Hari, talk of Hari, praise of Hari, salutation to Hari, [26]

5.242.s:
haridhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjā supte deve ca mokṣakṛt ..
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ sa muniṃ punarāha natiṃ gataḥ .. 27 ..
5.242.d:
हरिध्यानं हरेः पूजा सुप्ते देवे च मोक्षकृत् ..
एवं ब्रुवाणं स मुनिं पुनराह नतिं गतः .. 27 ..
5.242.m: meditation on Hari, and worship of Hari bring liberation while the deity is asleep.' / To the sage speaking thus, he, having bowed, spoke again: [27]

5.242.s:
bhavaddṛṣṭyāśramaphalametajjātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
tathāpi śrotumicchāmi tava vāṇīmanāmayīm .. 28 ..
5.242.d:
भवद्दृष्ट्याश्रमफलमेतज्जातं न संशयः ..
तथापि श्रोतुमिच्छामि तव वाणीमनामयीम् .. 28 ..
5.242.m: 'By the sight of you, this fruit of the stage of life has certainly arisen, no doubt; / nonetheless, I wish to hear your faultless words. [28]

5.242.s:
bhavādṛśānāṃ gamanaṃ sarvārtheṣu prakalpate ..
tatastau sumudā yuktau saṃjātau hṛṣṭacetasau .. 29 ..
5.242.d:
भवादृशानां गमनं सर्वार्थेषु प्रकल्पते ..
ततस्तौ सुमुदा युक्तौ संजातौ हृष्टचेतसौ .. 29 ..
5.242.m: The arrival of people like you brings about all purposes.' / Then the two of them became filled with great joy, delighted in heart. [29]

5.242.s:
muniṃ paijavanonāma sacchūdraḥ prāha saṃmataḥ ..
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 6.243.30 ..
5.242.d:
मुनिं पैजवनोनाम सच्छूद्रः प्राह संमतः ..
किमागमनकृत्यं ते कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 6.243.30 ..
5.242.m: The virtuous, esteemed śūdra named Paijavana said to the sage: / 'Tell me kindly, what is the purpose of your arrival? [6.243.30]

5.242.s:
ko vā tīrthaprasaṃgaśca cāturmāsye samīpage ..
gālavaḥ prāha sacchūdraṃ dhārmikaṃ satyavādinam .. 31 ..
5.242.d:
को वा तीर्थप्रसंगश्च चातुर्मास्ये समीपगे ..
गालवः प्राह सच्छूद्रं धार्मिकं सत्यवादिनम् .. 31 ..
5.242.m: Or what sacred ford is the occasion for it, as the four-month observance draws near?' / Gālava said to the virtuous, righteous, truthful śūdra: [31]

5.242.s:
mama tīrthāvasiktasya māsā bahutarā gatāḥ ..
idānīmāśramaṃ yāsye cāturmāsye samāgate .. 32 ..
5.242.d:
मम तीर्थावसिक्तस्य मासा बहुतरा गताः ..
इदानीमाश्रमं यास्ये चातुर्मास्ये समागते .. 32 ..
5.242.m: 'Many months have passed while I have been bathing in sacred fords; / now, as the four-month observance has arrived, I shall go to my hermitage. [32]

5.242.s:
āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ kariṣye niyamaṃ gṛhe ..
nārāyaṇasya prītyarthaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ cātmanastathā ..
pratyuvāca munirdharmānvinayānatakandharam .. 33 ..
5.242.d:
आषाढशुक्लैकादश्यां करिष्ये नियमं गृहे ..
नारायणस्य प्रीत्यर्थं श्रेयोऽर्थं चात्मनस्तथा ..
प्रत्युवाच मुनिर्धर्मान्विनयानतकन्धरम् .. 33 ..
5.242.m: On the eleventh day of the bright half of Āṣāḍha, I will undertake my observance at home / for the pleasure of Nārāyaṇa and for the spiritual welfare of myself.' / Thus the sage, answering him whose neck was bowed with humility, explained the duties. [33]

5.242.s:
.. paijavana uvāca .. ..
māmanugrahajāṃ buddhiṃ brūhi tvaṃ dvijapuṃgava ..
vede'dhikāro naivāsti vedasārajapasya vā .. 34 ..
5.242.d:
.. पैजवन उवाच .. ..
मामनुग्रहजां बुद्धिं ब्रूहि त्वं द्विजपुंगव ..
वेदेऽधिकारो नैवास्ति वेदसारजपस्य वा .. 34 ..
5.242.m: Paijavana said: / 'Bestow on me understanding born of your grace, O eminent twice-born! / For I have no qualification in the Veda, nor in chanting the essence of the Veda, [34]

5.242.s:
purāṇasmṛtipāṭhasya tasmātkiṃcidvadasva me ..
tattvātmasadṛśaṃ kiṃcidbhāti rūpaṃ mahāphalam .. 35 ..
5.242.d:
पुराणस्मृतिपाठस्य तस्मात्किंचिद्वदस्व मे ..
तत्त्वात्मसदृशं किंचिद्भाति रूपं महाफलम् .. 35 ..
5.242.m: nor in reciting the Purāṇas and Smṛtis; therefore tell me something / appropriate to my nature, an essence that brings great fruit. [35]

5.242.s: cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa muktisaṃsādhakaṃ vada .. 36 ..
5.242.d: चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण मुक्तिसंसाधकं वद .. 36 ..
5.242.m: Tell me what accomplishes liberation, especially during the four-month observance.' [36]

5.242.s:
.. gālava uvāca .. ..
śāligrāmagataṃ viṣṇuṃ cakrāṃkita puṭaṃ sadā ..
ye'rcayanti narā nityaṃ teṣāṃ bhuktistvadūrataḥ .. 37 ..
5.242.d:
.. गालव उवाच .. ..
शालिग्रामगतं विष्णुं चक्रांकित पुटं सदा ..
येऽर्चयन्ति नरा नित्यं तेषां भुक्तिस्त्वदूरतः .. 37 ..
5.242.m: Gālava said: / Those men who constantly worship Viṣṇu present in the Śāligrāma stone, / whose cavity is always marked with the discus, enjoyment is indeed not far from them. 37

5.242.s:
śāligrāme mano yasya yatkiṃcitkriyate śubham ..
akṣayyaṃ tadbhavennityaṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 38
5.242.d:
शालिग्रामे मनो यस्य यत्किंचित्क्रियते शुभम् ..
अक्षय्यं तद्भवेन्नित्यं चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः .. 38
5.242.m: Whatever good deed is performed by one whose mind is fixed on the Śāligrāma / becomes imperishable forever, especially during the Cāturmāsya. 38

5.242.s:
śāligrāmaśilā yatra yatra dvārāvatī śilā ..
ubhayoḥ saṃgamaḥ prāpto muktistasya na durlabhā .. 39 ..
5.242.d:
शालिग्रामशिला यत्र यत्र द्वारावती शिला ..
उभयोः संगमः प्राप्तो मुक्तिस्तस्य न दुर्लभा .. 39 ..
5.242.m: Where there is a Śāligrāma stone, and where there is a Dvārāvatī stone, / liberation is not difficult to obtain for one where the union of the two is achieved. 39

5.242.s:
śāligrāmaśilā yasyāṃ bhūmau saṃpūjyate nṛbhiḥ ..
pañcakrośaṃ punātyeṣā api pāpaśatānvitaiḥ .. 6.243.40 ..
5.242.d:
शालिग्रामशिला यस्यां भूमौ संपूज्यते नृभिः ..
पञ्चक्रोशं पुनात्येषा अपि पापशतान्वितैः .. 6.243.40 ..
5.242.m: The ground on which a Śāligrāma stone is worshipped by men, / even by those endowed with hundreds of sins, purifies for five krośas around. 40

5.242.s:
taijasaṃ piṃḍametaddhi brahmarūpamidaṃ śubham ..
yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva sadyaḥ kalmaṣanāśanam .. 41 ..
5.242.d:
तैजसं पिंडमेतद्धि ब्रह्मरूपमिदं शुभम् ..
यस्याः संदर्शनादेव सद्यः कल्मषनाशनम् .. 41 ..
5.242.m: For this auspicious mass of light is the very form of Brahman; / merely by its sight, sin is instantly destroyed. 41

5.242.s:
sarvatīrthāni puṇyāni devatāyatanāni ca ..
nadyaḥ sarvā mahāśūdra tīrthatvaṃ prāpnuvaṃti hi ..42..
5.242.d:
सर्वतीर्थानि पुण्यानि देवतायतनानि च ..
नद्यः सर्वा महाशूद्र तीर्थत्वं प्राप्नुवंति हि ..42..
5.242.m: O great Śūdra, all sacred fords, meritorious places, and shrines of deities, / and all rivers indeed attain the nature of a sacred ford [from it]. 42

5.242.s:
sannidhānena vai tasyāḥ kriyā sarvatraśobhanāḥ ..
vrajaṃti hi kriyātvaṃ ca cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 43 ..
5.242.d:
सन्निधानेन वै तस्याः क्रिया सर्वत्रशोभनाः ..
व्रजंति हि क्रियात्वं च चातुर्मास्ये विशेषतः .. 43 ..
5.242.m: Truly, through its presence, all rites everywhere become splendid / and attain full efficacy, especially during the Cāturmāsya. 43

5.242.s:
pūjyate bhavane yasya śāligrāma śilā śubhā ..
komalaistulasīpatrairvimukhastatra vai yamaḥ .. 44 ..
5.242.d:
पूज्यते भवने यस्य शालिग्राम शिला शुभा ..
कोमलैस्तुलसीपत्रैर्विमुखस्तत्र वै यमः .. 44 ..
5.242.m: In whose house the auspicious Śāligrāma stone is worshipped / with tender tulasī leaves, Yama truly turns his face away from there. 44

5.242.s:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ sacchūdrāṇāmathāpi vā ..
śāligrāmādhikāro'sti na cānyeṣāṃ kadācana .. 45 ..
5.242.d:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां सच्छूद्राणामथापि वा ..
शालिग्रामाधिकारोऽस्ति न चान्येषां कदाचन .. 45 ..
